Editors kept naphthalenesulphonic in the word bank so readers can recognize that variant spelling. 這筆資料保留下來，是為了讓讀者辨認這種變體拼法。
The factory produces naphthalenic oil used in various industrial processes. 這家工廠生產用於各種工業製程的萘系油。
Engineers analyzed the naphthalenic content of the fuel sample in the lab. 工程師在實驗室分析了燃料樣本中的萘含量。
Chemists identified several naphthalenoid structures during the experiment. 化學家在實驗中鑑定出幾種萘類結構。
The properties of naphthalenoid substances are useful for making high-quality dyes. 萘類物質的特性對於製造高品質染料很有幫助。

meaning: 萘的、關於萘的、產生萘的或衍生自萘的
sentences: The chemical reaction produced a stable naphthalic compound. 化學反應產生了一種穩定的萘化合物。
Scientists are exploring the potential of naphthalic acids in new materials. 科學家正在探索萘酸在新材料中的潛力。
Safety protocols are strict because naphthalidine can be harmful to health. 由於萘胺可能危害健康，因此安全協定非常嚴格。
Industrial workers must wear protective gear when handling naphthalidine. 工人在處理萘胺時必須穿戴防護裝備。
Before modern chemicals, naphthalin was a common ingredient in household cleaning. 在現代化學品出現之前，萘是家庭清潔中常見的成分。
The technician measured the concentration of naphthalin in the soil. 技術員測量了土壤中萘的濃度。
The technician measured the concentration of naphthaline in the air near the factory. 技術員測量了工廠附近空氣中萘的濃度。
Workers stored the powdered naphthaline in sealed containers to prevent evaporation. 工人們將粉末狀的萘儲存在密封容器中，以防止蒸發。
The naphthalization of the gas improves its lighting quality. 氣體的萘化處理提高了其照明品質。
Engineers monitored the naphthalization process to ensure consistent results. 工程師監測萘化過程，以確保結果一致。
The company decided to naphthalize the fuel to make it burn more brightly. 公司決定對燃料進行萘化處理，使其燃燒得更亮。
You must carefully naphthalize the material before starting the next stage of production. 在開始下一個生產階段之前，你必須仔細地將材料進行萘化處理。
Doctors used to prescribe naphthalol as an internal antiseptic for patients. 醫生以前曾開立水楊酸萘酯作為病人的體內防腐劑。
The pharmacist explained how naphthalol interacts with other medications. 藥劑師解釋了水楊酸萘酯如何與其他藥物產生相互作用。
The textile factory used naphthamine dyes to create vibrant blue fabrics. 紡織廠使用萘胺染料來製造鮮艷的藍色布料。
Laboratory tests confirmed the presence of naphthamine in the liquid sample. 實驗室測試確認液體樣本中存在萘胺。
Scientists studied the structure of naphthanthracene to understand its properties. 科學家研究了苯駢蔥的結構以了解其特性。
The analysis showed that naphthanthracene is a common byproduct of burning coal. 分析顯示，苯駢蔥是燃煤常見的副產品。

meaning: 任何環烷烴（或烷基衍生物）。
sentences: Gasoline contains a certain percentage of naphthene to help it burn efficiently. 汽油含有一定比例的環烷烴，以助其高效燃燒。
The chemist separated the naphthene from the crude oil mixture. 化學家從原油混合物中分離出環烷烴。

meaning: 環烷烴的、關於環烷烴的或衍生自環烷烴的。
sentences: The refinery specializes in processing naphthenic crude oil for heavy machinery. 煉油廠專門加工用於重型機械的環烷基原油。
This naphthenic acid is used to produce specialized soaps and cleaners. 這種環烷酸被用於生產專用的肥皂和清潔劑。

meaning: 衍生自萘嗪的一類吲哚啉的任何一種。
sentences: The chemist developed a new method to synthesize naphthinduline for industrial use. 化學家開發了一種合成工業用萘引杜林染料的新方法。
Naphthinduline is known for its ability to dye silk a deep red color. 萘引杜林因其能將絲綢染成深紅色的能力而聞名。
The laboratory requires a fresh supply of sodium naphthionate for the test. 實驗室需要供應新鮮的萘胺磺酸鈉來進行測試。
Workers added the naphthionate powder to the large mixing tank. 工人們將萘胺磺酸粉末加入大型混合槽中。
The lab technician used a naphtho derivative for the chemical experiment. 實驗室技術員在化學實驗中使用了一種萘基衍生物。
Several naphtho compounds are essential in the production of high-quality dyes. 幾種萘基化合物在高品質染料的生產中是必不可少的。

meaning: 屬於或關於萘甲酸或其衍生物的
sentences: The chemist added a few drops of naphthoic acid to the flask. 化學家在燒瓶中加入了幾滴萘甲酸。
We need to synthesize the naphthoic compound for our next experiment. 我們需要合成這種萘甲酸化合物來進行下一個實驗。

meaning: 衍生自萘的兩種異構酚中的任一種；它們用於製備染料和許多其他化合物
sentences: The factory uses naphthol to produce bright red dyes for clothing. 這家工廠使用萘酚來生產顏色鮮豔的紅色衣物染料。
Please store the naphthol powder in a cool and dry cabinet. 請將萘酚粉末存放在陰涼乾燥的櫃子裡。

meaning: 衍生自萘酚的任何陰離子，或含有此類陰離子的任何鹽。
sentences: Sodium naphtholate dissolves easily in warm water. 萘酚鈉很容易溶解在溫水中。
The student measured the concentration of the naphtholate solution carefully. 學生仔細測量了萘酚鹽溶液的濃度。
The workers naphtholize the cotton fabric to prepare it for dyeing. 工人們用萘酚浸漬棉布，為染色做準備。
We must naphtholize the wood samples before applying the final chemical coat. 我們必須在塗上最後的化學塗層之前，先用萘酚浸透木材樣本。
The researcher crystallized a new type of naphtholsulphonate in the laboratory. 研究員在實驗室裡使一種新型的萘酚磺酸鹽結晶。
This specific dye requires sodium naphtholsulphonate as a main ingredient. 這種特定的染料需要萘酚磺酸鈉作為主要成分。
The worker carefully mixed the naphtholsulphonic acid in the factory tank. 工人在工廠儲罐中小心地混合萘酚磺酸。
Naphtholsulphonic compounds are widely used for making bright synthetic colors. 萘酚磺酸類化合物被廣泛用於製造鮮艷的合成顏料。

meaning: 衍生自萘的多環芳香酮的兩種異構體中的任一種。
sentences: Some types of naphthoquinone are found naturally in green leafy vegetables. 某些種類的萘醌天然存在於綠葉蔬菜中。
The team is testing a new naphthoquinone derivative to treat certain diseases. 該團隊正在測試一種新的萘醌衍生物來治療某些疾病。
The naphthoresorcinol test helps detect specific types of sugars in the sample. 萘間苯二酚測試有助於檢測樣本中特定類型的糖分。
Mix the fluid with a small amount of naphthoresorcinol and observe the color change. 將液體與少量的萘間苯二酚混合，然後觀察顏色的變化。
The chemist analyzed the molecular structure of naphthosalol in the laboratory. 化學家在實驗室分析了萘酚薩羅的分子結構。
Researchers studied naphthosalol for its potential medical applications years ago. 研究人員多年前研究過萘酚薩羅潛在的醫學應用。
The soil samples had a distinct naphthous smell near the old oil well. 舊油井附近的土壤樣本有一股明顯的石腦油味。
We must be careful when handling these naphthous liquids in the garage. 我們在車庫處理這些石腦油類液體時必須小心。
The researcher synthesized a new type of naphthoxide for the chemical test. 研究人員為化學測試合成了一種新型的萘氧化物。
Please keep the naphthoxide container in a cool and well-ventilated area. 請將萘氧化物容器存放在陰涼且通風良好的地方。

meaning: 兩個異構單價基團中的任何一個，透過除去氫原子而正式衍生自萘
sentences: The naphthyl group is attached to the central carbon atom. 萘基連接在中心的碳原子上。
These plastic materials contain several naphthyl compounds to improve heat resistance. 這些塑膠材料含有數種萘基化合物，以提高耐熱性。

meaning: 衍生自萘的兩種異構伯胺中的任一種；它們存在於原油中，用於製備染料和其他化合物
sentences: Exposure to naphthylamine vapor can be very dangerous for the workers. 暴露於萘胺蒸氣中對工人來說是非常危險的。
The company stopped using naphthylamine in their products due to safety concerns. 出於安全考量，該公司停止在他們的產品中使用萘胺。
The dye industry relies on naphthylaminesulphonic acids for various products. 染料工業的多種產品都依賴於萘胺磺酸。
Proper safety gear is mandatory when working with naphthylaminesulphonic solutions. 處理萘胺磺酸溶液時，必須穿戴適當的安全裝備。

meaning: 任何衍生自萘的亞芳基
sentences: The new polymer features a strong naphthylene backbone. 這種新聚合物具有堅固的亞萘基骨架。
Heating the mixture produces a stable naphthylene compound. 加熱混合物會產生一種穩定的亞萘基化合物。
The scientist identified a naphthylic group within the complex molecule. 科學家在複雜分子中識別出了一個萘基基團。
These naphthylic derivatives are known to be stable at room temperature. 眾所周知，這些萘基衍生物在室溫下是穩定的。
The supplier delivered two barrels of high-quality naphtol this morning. 供應商今天早上送來了兩桶高品質的萘酚。
You need to dissolve the naphtol in alcohol before mixing it with other ingredients. 你需要先將萘酚溶解在酒精中，然後才能與其他成分混合。

meaning: 約翰·納皮爾（JohnNapier，1550-1617年）的或與之相關的，蘇格蘭數學家，發現了對數。
sentences: The engineering software calculates results using Napierian logarithms. 這套工程軟體使用自然對數來計算結果。
We learned how to apply the Napierian base in our advanced math class today. 我們今天在高等數學課上學習了如何應用納皮爾底數。

meaning: 形狀像蘿蔔；頂部呈球形，但底部呈錐形。
sentences: The farmer harvested a large batch of vegetables with napiform roots. 農夫收成了一大批具有蘿蔔狀根部的蔬菜。
This rare plant is easily recognized by its unusual napiform seed pod. 這種稀有植物很容易藉由其不尋常的蘿蔔狀種莢辨認出來。
Please use a napkin to wipe your mouth after you finish your meal. 用餐後請用餐巾紙擦嘴。
The table was elegantly set with beautiful white linen napkins. 桌上優雅地擺放著漂亮的白色亞麻餐巾。
We need to buy more linen napkining to prepare for the grand opening. 我們需要購買更多的亞麻餐巾布料，為盛大的開幕做準備。
The tailor cut the white napkining into small, even squares. 裁縫將白色的餐巾布料剪成大小均勻的小方塊。

meaning: 沒有午睡；破舊或破舊的。
sentences: He threw away the napless jacket because it could no longer keep him warm. 他把那件破舊的夾克扔了，因為它已經無法保暖了。
The hotel hallway was covered in a cheap, napless carpet. 飯店的走廊上鋪著廉價且磨損的薄地毯。
Her constant naplessness during the day made her feel exhausted by the evening. 她白天總是無法小睡，導致傍晚時感到精疲力盡。
The doctor suggested that his naplessness might be caused by too much caffeine. 醫生認為他的失眠狀況可能是攝取過多咖啡因造成的。

meaning: 法郎生發：法國拿破崙一世時期發行的20法郎金幣。
sentences: My grandfather keeps a shiny gold napoleon in a small velvet box. 我爺爺在一個小絨布盒裡保存著一枚閃亮的拿破崙金幣。
The collector paid a high price for a rare silver coin and a well-preserved napoleon. 收藏家高價買下了一枚稀有的銀幣和一枚保存完好的拿破崙金幣。

meaning: 法郎生發：法國拿破崙一世時期發行的20法郎金幣。
sentences: My grandfather kept a shiny Napoleon in his old coin collection box. 我爺爺在舊硬幣收藏盒裡保存了一枚閃亮的拿破崙二十法郎金幣。
The antique dealer examined the Napoleon to confirm it was pure gold. 古董商仔細檢查了這枚金幣，以確認它是純金打造的。
Older sources sometimes write Napoleonana as an alternative form of Napoleoniana. 較早的資料有時會使用這個變體拼法。
Editors kept Napoleonana in the word bank so readers can recognize that variant spelling. 這筆資料保留下來，是為了讓讀者辨認這種變體拼法。
The museum features several Napoleonic uniforms from the early 19th century. 博物館展示了幾件十九世紀初的拿破崙時代軍服。
He studied Napoleonic history to understand the expansion of the French Empire. 他研究拿破崙時期的歷史，以了解法蘭西帝國的擴張。
The manager walked into the office and Napoleonically demanded everyone to work overtime. 經理走進辦公室，像拿破崙般專橫地要求大家加班。
He Napoleonically arranged his pieces on the chessboard before the game started. 比賽開始前，他以拿破崙般的氣勢在棋盤上佈置棋子。
His devotion to Napoleonism influenced his political views for many years. 他對拿破崙主義的忠誠多年來一直影響著他的政治觀點。
The rise of Napoleonism in the region led to a change in the local government. 該地區拿破崙主義的興起導致了地方政府的更迭。

meaning: 支持拿破崙王朝、與其相關或具有拿破崙王朝的特徵。
sentences: The Napoleonist group organized a parade to celebrate the historic victory. 拿破崙支持團體組織了一場遊行，以慶祝那場歷史性的勝利。
Her Napoleonist ideas were often debated by her classmates in history class. 她的拿破崙崇拜思想經常在歷史課上被同學討論。

meaning: 屬於拿破崙主義或與拿破崙主義有關。
sentences: The leader's Napoleonistic style of governance was both admired and feared. 領導人那拿破崙式的治理風格既受人欽佩也令人恐懼。
He had a Napoleonistic habit of putting his hand inside his vest during speeches. 他在演講時有一個拿破崙式的習慣，會把手伸進背心裡。

meaning: 以球狀結構為特徵的閃長岩品種。
sentences: The geologist identified the rock sample as napoleonite due to its circular patterns. 由於其圓形圖案，地質學家將這塊岩石樣本鑑定為球狀閃長岩。
Collectors traveled to the island to find pieces of rare napoleonite. 收藏家們前往該島尋找稀有的球狀閃長岩。
The general tried to Napoleonize the local administration to ensure total control. 將軍試圖徹底統治地方行政機構，以確保完全的掌控。
It is difficult to Napoleonize a modern economy because of its complexity. 由於現代經濟的複雜性，很難對其進行徹底統治。

meaning: 結束了，死了，不再了，消失了；不存在的。
sentences: The party was napoo once the music stopped and everyone left. 音樂停止且大家離開後，派對就宣告結束了。
All our hard work went napoo because of the sudden rainstorm. 由於突如其來的暴雨，我們所有的努力都付諸流水了。

meaning: 水體以垂直落差流過障礙物的輪廓。
sentences: The engineer observed the falling nappe of water at the edge of the spillway. 工程師觀察了溢洪道邊緣落下的溢流水舌。
The thickness of the nappe is important for calculating the flow rate of the river. 溢流水層的厚度對於計算河流的流量非常重要。

meaning: 午睡的簡單過去式和過去分詞
sentences: He napped for twenty minutes after lunch to regain his energy. 他午餐後小睡了二十分鐘以恢復精力。
The cat napped on the sunny windowsill all afternoon. 貓咪整個下午都在陽光充足的窗台上打盹。
My grandfather is a frequent napper who often falls asleep in his armchair. 我祖父是個經常打瞌睡的人，常在扶手椅上睡著。
As a light napper, she can be easily woken up by the slightest noise. 身為一個淺眠的午睡者，她很容易被最微小的噪音吵醒。
The absorbent layer improves the nappiness of the diaper for the baby. 吸收層改善了這款嬰兒尿布的使用效能。
Quality control ensures the nappiness of each batch meets the safety standards. 品質控制確保每一批尿布的狀態都符合安全標準。

meaning: 小睡或短暫睡眠的行為。
sentences: Napping during the day can help improve focus and productivity. 白天小睡有助於提高專注力和工作效率。
He was caught napping at his desk by the supervisor. 他在辦公桌前打瞌睡時被主管抓到了。
A feeling of nappishness often sets in right after a heavy meal. 吃完大餐後，往往會產生一種輕微的睡意。
Despite her nappishness, she forced herself to finish the homework. 儘管有些昏昏欲睡，她還是強迫自己完成功課。

meaning: 打個小盹（布料等）；柔軟的；毛茸茸。
sentences: The kitten likes to sleep on the nappy surface of the old rug. 小貓喜歡在舊地毯毛茸茸的表面上睡覺。
This sweater is made of a nappy wool that feels very cozy in winter. 這件毛衣是由柔軟的羊毛製成的，冬天穿起來非常舒服。
I felt much better after the naprapath treated my sore shoulder. 在納普拉帕斯療法醫師治療了我痠痛的肩膀後，我感覺好多了。
The naprapath recommended some exercises to improve my posture at work. 納普拉帕斯療法醫師建議了一些運動，以改善我在工作時的姿勢。

meaning: 替代醫學的一個分支，一種專注於評估和治療神經肌肉骨骼疾病的手法療法。
sentences: Many people turn to naprapathy to find relief from back pain without using drugs. 許多人轉向納普拉帕斯療法，希望在不使用藥物的情況下緩解背痛。
The clinic offers naprapathy as a holistic approach to physical health. 這間診所提供納普拉帕斯療法作為身體健康的整體治療方案。
The baker tied a clean napron around his waist before starting to work. 麵包師在開始工作前，在腰間繫了一條乾淨的圍裙。
She found an old linen napron that belonged to her grandmother in the kitchen. 她在廚房裡發現了一條屬於她祖母的舊亞麻圍裙。
The chemist added napthionic acid to the mixture to start the reaction. 化學家在混合物中加入萘胺磺酸以引發反應。
Napthionic compounds are often used to create vibrant red industrial dyes. 萘胺磺酸類化合物常用於製造鮮艷的紅色工業染料。
The napu is known for its small size and slender legs. 大鼷鹿以其體型小巧和腿部細長而聞名。
Researchers are studying the behavior of the napu in its natural habitat. 研究人員正在研究大鼷鹿在自然棲息地的行為。
The entry for nar explains that it means they (dual). 條目說明這個字表示「他們」。
Readers can still meet nar in dictionaries and specialized texts. 讀者仍可能在字典或專業文本中看到這個字。
The marine biologist observed the behavior of Narcaciontes in the shallow bay. 海洋生物學家在淺水灣觀察了電鰩類的行為。
Narcaciontes use powerful electric shocks to defend themselves from predators. 電鰩類利用強大的電擊來抵禦掠食者。
Biologists list Narcaciontidae in reference works on classification. 分類參考資料會列出這個名稱。
The museum label mentions Narcaciontidae when explaining the specimen's group. 標本標籤在說明所屬類群時也可能提到這個名稱。

meaning: 鴉片中含有的一種生物鹼，呈細小的白色絲狀晶體，微溶於水，用作嗎啡的替代品。
sentences: Doctors sometimes used narceine in the past as a mild sedative for patients. 過去醫生有時會將那碎因用作患者的輕度鎮靜劑。

As a dedicated nebelist, she spent years studying the patterns of mountain mists. 身為一名致力於雲霧研究的人，她花了多年時間研究山霧的規律。

meaning: 細胞核外細胞質中的染色質染色物質的團塊或碎片。
sentences: The scientist studied the structure of the nebenkern in the cell. 科學家研究了細胞中副核的結構。
A healthy nebenkern is essential for the proper function of the sperm. 健康的副核對於精子的正常功能至關重要。
Older sources sometimes write Nebiim as an alternative form of Nevi'im. 較早的資料有時會使用這個變體拼法。
Editors kept Nebiim in the word bank so readers can recognize that variant spelling. 這筆資料保留下來，是為了讓讀者辨認這種變體拼法。

meaning: 屬於內布拉斯加州或其文化的或與之相關的
sentences: My roommate is a Nebraskan who grew up on a farm. 我的室友是內布拉斯加州人，他在農場長大。
We enjoyed the warm Nebraskan hospitality during our visit. 訪問期間，我們享受了內布拉斯加州人熱情的款待。

meaning: 狄俄尼索斯所佩戴的小鹿皮，以及他的男性追隨者和女性追隨者（女巫）以及古希臘其他信徒為紀念他而佩戴的小鹿皮。在不同的情況下，它也被顯示為豹皮或狐狸皮。
sentences: The statue shows a hunter wearing a nebris over his shoulder. 雕像顯示一位獵人肩上披著鹿皮。
In ancient ceremonies, dancers often wore a nebris. 在古代儀式中，舞者經常穿戴著鹿皮。

meaning: 外太空中由氣體或塵埃組成的雲（例如恆星爆炸後形成的雲）。
sentences: The Orion Nebula is visible with a small telescope. 透過小型望遠鏡可以看到獵戶座星雲。
A nebula is a cloud of gas and dust in deep space. 星雲是深太空中由氣體和塵埃組成的雲團。
Astronomers study distant nebulae to learn how stars are born. 天文學家研究遙遠的星雲以了解恆星是如何誕生的。
The colors of the nebulae depend on the types of gases they contain. 星雲的顏色取決於其含有的氣體類型。
The nebular theory explains the origin of our solar system. 星雲假說解釋了我們太陽系的起源。
He captured high-resolution images of the nebular light. 他拍攝到了星雲光芒的高解析度影像。
The doctor used nebularization to deliver the medicine to the lungs. 醫生使用霧化方式將藥物送達肺部。
Nebularization converts the liquid into a very fine mist. 霧化將液體轉化為極細微的霧氣。
Gravity caused the giant gas cloud to nebularize. 重力導致巨大的氣體雲形成星雲。
Over time, the cosmic dust will nebularize into a new star system. 隨著時間推移，宇宙塵埃將形成星雲並產生新的星系。
The biologist examined the nebulated pattern on the butterfly's wings. 生物學家檢查了蝴蝶翅膀上模糊的斑紋。
The antique vase had a nebulated finish that looked like drifting smoke. 這只古董花瓶有一層模糊的裝飾，看起來像漂浮的煙霧。
The nebulation of the liquid medication allowed the child to breathe it in easily. 藥液的霧化讓孩子可以輕鬆吸入。
Engineers studied the nebulation of fuel in the engine to improve efficiency. 工程師研究了引擎中燃料的霧化過程，以提高效率。

meaning: 裝飾性的波浪形或捲曲圖案；波浪或波浪形狀的模製。
sentences: The old stone arch was decorated with a delicate nebule along its edge. 古老的石拱門邊緣裝飾著精緻的波浪形圖案。
Architects often used the nebule as a classic design element in medieval buildings. 建築師經常在中古世紀建築中將波浪形模製視為一種經典設計元素。
The sky became nebulescent as the evening fog began to roll in. 隨著晚霧開始湧入，天空變得朦朧起來。
In the lab, the clear solution turned nebulescent after the chemical was added. 在實驗室裡，加入化學物質後，透明的溶液變得混濁模糊。
The nebuliferous wind from the sea brought a heavy mist to the coastal town. 來自海上的帶霧微風給這座沿海小鎮帶來了大霧。
High in the mountains, the nebuliferous air made it difficult to see the trail. 在高山上，充滿雲霧的空氣讓人很難看清小徑。

meaning: 一種分晶石，其中一種結構元素出現在邊界不明顯的透鏡狀塊。
sentences: The geologist identified the rock sample as nebulite due to its blurry mineral boundaries. 地質學家因其模糊的礦物邊界，將該岩石樣本鑑定為分晶石。
Nebulite is often found in deep crustal zones where rocks have partially melted. 分晶石常發現於岩石部分熔化的深層地殼區域。

meaning: 根據對星雲光的光譜分析而提出的假定化學元素；現在已知有關的發射線是由雙電離氧引起的。
sentences: Early astronomers once believed that a mystery element called nebulium existed in space. 早期的天文學家曾一度認為太空存在一種名為「星雲素」的神秘元素。
Science eventually proved that the lines of nebulium were actually produced by oxygen. 科學最終證明，星雲素的光譜線實際上是由氧氣產生的。
Astronomers use advanced computers to model the nebulization of gas in space. 天文學家使用先進的電腦來模擬太空氣體的星雲形成過程。
The nebulization of the giant cloud took millions of years to complete. 這片巨大雲團的星雲形成過程花了數百萬年才完成。

meaning: 使用霧化器施用藥物治療患者
sentences: The nurse needed to nebulize the medicine to help the patient breathe better. 護士需要將藥物霧化，以幫助病人呼吸更順暢。
Doctors often nebulize antibiotics to treat serious lung infections directly. 醫生經常將抗生素霧化，以直接治療嚴重的肺部感染。

meaning: 一種用於將藥物注入肺部的裝置，將藥物從液態轉化為細小的氣霧劑噴霧，透過鼻子或嘴巴吸入。
sentences: The lab used a nebulizer while measuring subtle speech movements. 實驗室在測量細微動作時會使用這種儀器。
The technician checked the nebulizer before the recording session began. 技術員會在開始記錄前先檢查這個裝置。
The mountain peak was hidden behind a nebulose layer of grey clouds. 山頂隱藏在模糊的一層灰雲背後。
His nebulose explanation of the accident left everyone feeling confused. 他對這起事故模糊不清的解釋讓每個人都感到困惑。

meaning: 模糊的特徵；渾濁度（以八度為單位測量）。
sentences: The nebulosity of the lake water made it impossible to see the bottom. 湖水的渾濁度讓人無法看到湖底。
Astronomers measure the nebulosity of a gas cloud to understand its density. 天文學家測量星雲的模糊程度，以了解其密度。

meaning: 以雲或薄霧的形式出現；朦朧。
sentences: She had only a nebulous memory of what happened during the storm. 她對暴風雨期間發生的事只有模糊的記憶。
The company’s plans for the next year are still quite nebulous and undecided. 公司明年的計劃仍然相當模糊且尚未決定。

meaning: 以類似雲或薄霧的方式。
sentences: The smoke drifted nebulously across the empty stage before the performance. 表演開始前，煙霧如雲霧般飄過空蕩蕩的舞台。
The ink spread nebulously when the brush touched the wet paper. 毛筆接觸到濕紙張時，墨水如雲霧般暈染開來。
The nebulousness of the instructions caused a lot of mistakes in the factory. 指示的模糊性在工廠裡造成了許多錯誤。
We were surprised by the nebulousness of the shape moving in the dark. 我們對黑暗中移動的那個形狀的模糊感感到驚訝。

meaning: 皮質科中的一個分類屬—某些真菌。
sentences: Biologists list Necator in reference works on classification. 分類參考資料會列出這個名稱。
The museum label mentions Necator when explaining the specimen's group. 標本標籤在說明所屬類群時也可能提到這個名稱。
He packed all the necessar supplies for his long camping trip in the mountains. 他為長途山區露營旅行打包了所有必要的物資。
It is necessar to check the oil level before you go on a long drive. 在長途駕駛之前，檢查油位是必要的。

meaning: 必然主義的追隨者；必要性原則的倡導者。
sentences: As a strict necessarian, he believed that every event was determined by prior causes. 作為一名嚴格的必然主義者，他相信每一件事都是由先前的因果所決定的。
The philosopher debated with a necessarian about the existence of free will. 這位哲學家與一位必然主義者爭論自由意志的存在。

meaning: 決定論的一種極端形式，認為所有現象，包括意志，都受到不可改變的因果規則的約束；必然主義。
sentences: His belief in necessarianism meant he didn't feel responsible for his mistakes. 他對必然主義的信仰意味著他不覺得自己該為錯誤負責。
The lecture explored how necessarianism differs from other theories of fate. 這場講座探討了必然主義與其他命運理論有何不同。
A high price does not necessarily mean that the product is of high quality. 高價並不必然意味著產品品質精良。
You don't necessarily have to be an expert to use this simple software. 你不一定要成為專家才能使用這款簡單的軟體。
The necessariness of the new law was debated by the local community for months. 當地社區對這項新法律的必要性爭論了幾個月。
She understood the necessariness of regular exercise for maintaining good health. 她明白定期運動對於保持健康的重要性。
Is it necessary to bring a passport for this domestic trip? 這次國內旅行有必要帶護照嗎？
The doctor said surgery was necessary to save his life. 醫生說為了救他的命，手術是必要的。
Some people turn to necessism to explain why they cannot change their fate. 有些人轉向必然主義來解釋為什麼他們無法改變自己的命運。
The debate over necessism has lasted for centuries in the field of philosophy. 關於必然主義的辯論在哲學領域已經持續了幾個世紀。
A necessist would argue that our choices are just reactions to past events. 必然主義者會主張，我們的選擇只是對過去事件的反應。
Even as a child, he was a bit of a necessist, believing everything happened for a reason. 甚至在小時候，他就有一點必然主義者的傾向，相信每件事的發生都有其原因。

meaning: 屬於或關於必然性或必然主義：反對自由主義。阿米念派與加爾文主義者糾纏在一起，加爾文主義者又使阿民念派陷入矛盾的迷宮。自由意志的倡議者訴諸良心和本能──訴諸對公平應有的先驗意識。必然主義者依賴事實的經驗現實。弗勞德，加爾文主義。（《世紀字典》，世紀公司，紐約，1911年）。
sentences: The report uses necessitarian to describe a related feature. 報告用這個詞來描述某種相關特徵。
Readers may encounter necessitarian in descriptive or specialist writing. 讀者可能會在描述性或專業文本中看到這個詞。
Many students find the concept of necessitarianism difficult to grasp at first. 許多學生一開始發現必然主義的概念很難掌握。
The book explains why necessitarianism was popular among some early scientists. 這本書解釋了為什麼必然主義在一些早期科學家中很受歡迎。

meaning: 使必要；理應如此；要求（某事）發生。
sentences: The early departure of her plane necessitated her waking up at 4 a.m. 由於飛機提前起飛，她必須在凌晨 4 點起床。
People often necessitate when the situation calls for it. 當情況需要時，人們常常需要這樣做。
Due to the sudden heavy rain, the outdoor wedding was necessitatedly moved inside. 由於突降大雨，戶外婚禮被迫移至室內舉行。
He necessitatedly resigned from his position to take care of his sick mother. 他被迫辭去職務以照顧生病的母親。
The project budget was cut necessitatingly, leading to a smaller team. 專案預算被迫縮減，導致團隊規模變小。
The storm damaged the roof necessitatingly, so we had to call a repairman. 暴風雨損壞了屋頂，使得我們不得不叫修理工。

meaning: 必然性，被理解為邏輯或其他哲學原則，或自然律或力量。
sentences: The necessitation of logical rules is often discussed in philosophy classes. 邏輯規則的必然性經常在哲學課上被討論。
Natural laws imply the necessitation of certain physical events. 自然法則暗示了某些物理事件發生的必然性。

meaning: 是或與表明必要性的語法形式有關。
sentences: In some languages, the necessitative form of a verb shows that an action is required. 在某些語言中，動詞的必要語氣形式表示某個動作是必須執行的。
The student studied the necessitative markers in Finnish grammar. 這名學生研究了芬蘭語語法中的必要性標記。

meaning: 有需要的，貧困的，貧窮的，貧窮的。
sentences: The charity provides food and clothing to necessitous families in the area. 該慈善機構為該地區貧困的家庭提供食物和衣服。
The government launched a new program to help necessitous citizens. 政府啟動了一項新計劃來幫助有需要的公民。
The plan was necessitously changed due to the budget cuts. 由於預算削減，計劃不得不做出必要的更改。
He necessitously asked for help when the car broke down. 汽車拋錨時，他不得不尋求幫助。

meaning: 貧窮的狀況或狀況；物質需求，尤其是緊急的物質需求。
sentences: The report highlighted the extreme necessitousness of the refugees. 報告強調了難民極度貧困的狀況。
Social workers are trained to address the necessitousness of the homeless. 社工接受過處理流浪者物質需求的培訓。

meaning: 有需要的狀態或特徵；需要。
sentences: The sudden necessitude of the villagers moved the travelers to help. 村民們突然陷入困頓的狀態感動了旅人伸出援手。
Old age often brings a sense of necessitude and reliance on others. 高齡往往會帶來一種需要他人照顧的狀態。
A healthy diet and regular exercise are a necessity for a long life. 健康飲食與定期運動是長壽的必需（必要條件）。
Economic development is a necessity for the prosperity of any nation. 經濟發展是任何國家繁榮的必要條件。
She wore a beautiful gold necklace around her neck. 她在脖子上戴了一條漂亮的金項鍊。
He hurt his neck while sleeping in an awkward position. 他因為睡眠姿勢不當而弄傷了脖子。

meaning: 德國的一條河流，萊茵河的主要支流，大部分流經巴登-符騰堡州
sentences: We took a beautiful boat trip along the Neckar during our vacation in Germany. 我們在德國度假期間沿著內卡河進行了一次美麗的乘船旅行。
Heidelberg is a famous city located on the banks of the Neckar. 海德堡是位於內卡河畔的一座著名城市。

meaning: 護頸；戴在女人脖子上的手帕。
sentences: She wore a silk neckatee to protect her throat from the cold wind. 她戴著絲綢護頸，保護喉嚨不受冷風侵襲。
The old fashion required ladies to wear a decorative neckatee. 舊時的時尚要求女士們配戴裝飾性的小領巾。
The loose neckband of his shirt felt very comfortable. 他襯衫上寬鬆的領圈感覺非常舒適。
She sewed a colorful neckband onto the plain white dress. 她在純白色的洋裝上縫了一個彩色領圈。

meaning: 一種裝飾性領帶，通常為白色。
sentences: The gentleman tied his white neckcloth with great care before the party. 那位紳士在聚會前非常小心地繫好他的白色領巾。
He looked very formal in his dark suit and silk neckcloth. 他穿著深色西裝和絲綢領巾，看起來非常正式。

meaning: 具有某種特定類型的頸部或領口。
sentences: The long-necked bottles are difficult to clean without a special brush. 長頸瓶如果沒有專用刷子就很難清洗。
She prefers wearing V-necked sweaters in the winter. 她在冬天更喜歡穿 V 領毛衣。

meaning: 主要親吻脖子的人；一個吻脖子的人
sentences: The young couple was seen as a pair of neckers by the older neighbors. 這對年輕情侶被年長的鄰居視為喜歡親熱的人。
I don't like being around neckers in public places. 我不喜歡在公共場所待在那些互相親吻脖子的人身邊。
The sailor tied his neckercher in a traditional knot. 那名海員用傳統的結繫好了他的圍巾。
She used a red neckercher to add some color to her outfit. 她用一條紅圍巾為她的打扮增添了一些色彩。

meaning: 繞在脖子上或繫在脖子上的圍巾。
sentences: The boy scouts all wore bright yellow neckerchiefs. 童軍們都戴著鮮黃色的領巾。
She tied a patterned neckerchief around her neck to stay warm. 她在脖子上繫了一條有花紋的圍巾來保暖。
The worker poured a neckful of liquid into the narrow bottle. 工人向窄口瓶中倒入了一瓶頸的水量。
The pelican carries a neckful of small fish back to its nest. 鵜鶘銜著滿滿一喉嚨的小魚回到巢穴。
Older sources sometimes write neckguard as an alternative form of neck guard. 較早的資料有時會使用這個變體拼法。
Editors kept neckguard in the word bank so readers can recognize that variant spelling. 這筆資料保留下來，是為了讓讀者辨認這種變體拼法。

meaning: 雄性長頸鹿的一種行為，它們用脖子作為武器來爭奪社會統治地位。
sentences: Biologists observed the necking behavior of the male giraffes in the wild. 生物學家觀察了野外雄性長頸鹿互相甩頸爭鬥的行為。
Necking is a way for giraffes to determine who is the strongest in the herd. 甩頸爭鬥是長頸鹿決定誰是群體中最強壯者的一種方式。
He wrapped a warm neckinger around his neck before going out into the snow. 出門走進雪地前，他把一條溫暖的圍巾裹在脖子上。
The traditional neckinger was made of thick wool. 傳統的圍巾是用厚羊毛製成的。
She wore a beautiful gold necklace around her neck. 她在脖子上戴了一條漂亮的金項鍊。
He bought his wife a stunning diamond necklace for their anniversary. 他為太太買了一條絕美的鑽石項鍊慶祝週年。
The necklaced birds are easy to identify by the ring of feathers around their throats. 頸部有圈羽毛的鳥類很容易通過脖子周圍的羽毛環來辨認。
She stood in the garden, a necklaced lady ready for the evening banquet. 她站在花園裡，是一位戴著項鍊、準備參加晚宴的女士。
The glossary explains that necklaceweed means Synonym of baneberry. 詞彙表會說明這個詞的意思。
Readers may encounter necklaceweed in specialist books or historical writing. 讀者可能會在專業書籍或較早的文獻中看到這個詞。
The neckless statue looked strange without its upper part. 那尊沒有脖子的雕像少了上半部，看起來很奇怪。
He complained that the neckless design of the new shirt was uncomfortable. 他抱怨新襯衫沒領子的設計很不舒服。
She received a beautiful silver necklet as a birthday gift. 她收到一條漂亮的銀項鍊作為生日禮物。
The cat wore a small bell on its leather necklet. 那隻貓在皮製頸圈上繫了一個小鈴鐺。

meaning: 類似於頸部或具有頸部特徵。
sentences: The plant has a necklike stem that supports the large flower. 這種植物有一條像脖子一樣的莖，支撐著巨大的花朵。
The surgeon carefully examined the necklike structure of the bone. 醫生仔細檢查了骨骼中類似頸部的結構。
The dress has a high neckline decorated with lace. 這件連衣裙有著裝飾蕾絲的高領口。
She chose a top with a classic V-neckline. 她選了一件經典 V 領的上衣。
Older sources sometimes write neckmold as an alternative form of neckmould. 較早的資料有時會使用這個變體拼法。
Editors kept neckmold in the word bank so readers can recognize that variant spelling. 這筆資料保留下來，是為了讓讀者辨認這種變體拼法。

meaning: 戴在脖子上的一件衣服。
sentences: The dancer's costume included a heavy golden neckpiece. 舞者的服裝包括一件沉重的金色頸飾。
This fur neckpiece will keep you very warm during the winter. 這件毛皮護頸在冬天會讓你非常溫暖。
The soldier adjusted his stiff neckstock before the parade. 士兵在閱兵前調整了他僵硬的領口帶。
Historically, a neckstock was used to keep the collar upright. 從歷史上看，領圈是用來保持衣領挺直的。
He wore a clean white shirt and a blue silk necktie for the interview. 他穿了一件乾淨的白襯衫並繫上藍絲絨領帶去面試。
Could you please help me tie this complex knot in my necktie? 你能幫我繫好這個複雜的領帶結嗎？
He felt more relaxed in his necktieless outfit at the casual dinner. 在便宴上，他穿著沒打領帶的服裝感到更加放鬆。
The modern office often allows a necktieless dress code. 現代辦公室通常允許不繫領帶的著裝規範。
The massage therapist moved her hands neckward to release the tension. 按摩師將手移向頸部以緩解緊張。
He pulled the collar neckward to stay warm in the cold wind. 他把衣領往脖子方向拉，以便在寒風中保暖。

meaning: 掛在脖子上的衣物或珠寶，例如領帶或項鍊。
sentences: The department store has a large selection of neckwear, including silk ties and scarves. 這家百貨公司有大量的頸部飾品可供選擇，包括絲綢領帶和圍巾。
He chose a formal piece of neckwear to match his new suit for the wedding. 他選擇了一件正式的領部配件，用來搭配他參加婚禮的新西裝。

meaning: 一種美國一年生雜草（Veronicaperegrina），開小白花和圓豆莢。
sentences: The field guide identifies neckweed among similar living things. 野外圖鑑會用這個名稱區分相近的生物。
Researchers recorded neckweed during their survey of the area. 研究人員在調查時也可能記錄到這個名稱。

meaning: 接觸或圍繞攜帶者頸部的軛，而不僅僅是擱在肩膀上。
sentences: The farmer adjusted the neckyoke on the oxen before starting the field work. 農民在開始田間工作前，調整了牛隻脖子上的軛。
A heavy neckyoke was used to help carry the water buckets from the well. 為了幫忙從井裡提水桶，使用了沈重的護頸木擔。
The surgeon performed a necrectomy to remove the damaged tissue from the wound. 外科醫生進行了壞死組織切除術，以清除傷口上受損的部分。
Early necrectomy is often necessary to prevent the spread of serious infection. 為了防止嚴重感染擴散，通常需要儘早進行壞死組織切除。
The medical report discussed the rare condition of necremia in the patient. 醫療報告討論了患者血液壞死的罕見情況。
Scientific studies on necremia are limited due to its infrequent occurrence in clinics. 由於臨床上血液壞死發生頻率不高，相關的科學研究非常有限。
The vet identified a necrobacillary infection in the livestock last week. 獸醫上週在牲畜身上發現了壞死桿菌感染。
Specific antibiotics were prescribed to treat the necrobacillary disease. 醫生開了特定的抗生素來治療這種壞死桿菌病。
Necrobacillosis can cause severe lameness in sheep and cattle. 壞死桿菌病會導致牛羊嚴重的跛行。
Proper hygiene in the barn helps prevent the outbreak of necrobacillosis. 穀倉保持良好的衛生有助於防止壞死桿菌病的爆發。

meaning: 由於與年齡相關的變化而導致的細胞或組織的正常死亡。
sentences: Necrobiosis is a natural process where cells die and are replaced by new ones. 組織漸進性壞死是細胞死亡並由新細胞取代的自然過程。
The skin condition was caused by a specific type of necrobiosis in the legs. 這種皮膚狀況是由於腿部特定的組織漸進性壞死所引起的。
The doctor observed necrobiotic changes in the skin tissue during the exam. 醫生在檢查過程中觀察到皮膚組織的漸進性壞死變化。
A necrobiotic disorder can sometimes lead to visible spots on the skin. 漸進性壞死疾病有時會導致皮膚上出現明顯的斑點。
The spider's bite released a necrogenic toxin into the patient's arm. 蜘蛛的叮咬將一種致壞死毒素釋放到病人的手臂中。
Doctors had to quickly remove the tissue affected by the necrogenic bacteria. 醫生必須迅速清除受致壞死細菌感染的組織。
Some fungi are necrogenous and live on dead organic matter in the forest. 某些真菌是死物寄生的，生活在森林中死亡的有機物上。
The necrogenous bacteria were found in the decaying plants near the pond. 在池塘附近腐爛的植物中發現了壞死性細菌。
He worked as a necrographer for the local newspaper for many years. 他在當地的報社擔任多年的訃聞編寫員。
The necrographer interviewed the family to gather details for the life story. 訃聞編寫員採訪了家屬，以收集生平細節。

meaning: 崇拜或尊敬死者的習俗。
sentences: The ancient tribe practiced necrolatry to honor their ancestors. 這個古老部落實行亡靈崇拜以紀念他們的祖先。
Anthropologists studied the rituals of necrolatry in the remote village. 人類學家研究了那個偏遠村莊的死者崇拜儀式。
The newspaper published a necrologic notice for the prominent professor. 報紙刊登了這位著名教授的訃告通知。
He kept a necrologic record of all the members who passed away this year. 他記錄了今年所有去世成員的訃聞資料。
The church archives contain detailed necrological data from the last century. 教會檔案館保存了上個世紀詳細的死者名錄數據。
She spent the afternoon researching necrological entries in the local library. 她下午在當地的圖書館研究死者名冊的條目。
The damaged tissues were examined necrologically to understand the decay process. 實驗室從壞死學的角度檢查了受損組織，以了解腐爛過程。
Necrologically speaking, the cells showed an unusual pattern of rapid deterioration. 從壞死學方面來看，這些細胞呈現出不尋常的快速惡化模式。
As a necrologist, his job is to maintain the list of deceased community members. 作為一名死者名錄編纂者，他的工作是維護社區已故成員的名單。
The necrologist updated the records after the memorial service ended. 死者名錄編纂員在追思會結束後更新了紀錄。
The family requested a brief necrologue to be read at the funeral service. 家屬要求在葬禮上宣讀一份簡短的訃文。
He carefully prepared a necrologue for his late business partner. 他為已故的合夥人精心準備了一份悼詞。

meaning: 包含已故教會相關人員姓名的教會登記冊。
sentences: The monk updated the monastery's necrology with the names of the brothers who passed away. 修道士在修道院的死者名冊上更新了去世弟兄的名字。
We looked through the church's necrology to find information about our ancestors. 我們查看了教會的死者名冊，以尋找有關祖先的信息。

meaning: 練習或施展死靈術的人。
sentences: In the fantasy novel, the necromancer raised an army from the graveyard. 在這部奇幻小說中，死靈法師從墓地中召喚了一支軍隊。
The villagers feared the old man was a dark necromancer with forbidden magic. 村民們害怕那個老人是個擁有禁忌魔法的邪惡亡靈巫師。
The villain spent years necromancing in the dark tower to gain forbidden power. 反派在黑暗的高塔中修練死靈術多年，以獲取禁忌的力量。
She warned him that necromancing with the past would only bring trouble to his family. 她警告他，試圖用亡靈術與過去糾纏只會給他的家人帶來麻煩。

meaning: 涉及死者或死亡的占卜。
sentences: Ancient legends are full of stories about the dangers of practicing necromancy. 古老的傳說中到處都是關於練習死靈術之危險的故事。
He was accused of using necromancy to talk to his lost love in the woods. 他被指控在森林裡練習亡靈術，以與失去的愛人交談。

meaning: 屬於或與死靈術有關：死者的復活或與死者的交流，特別是透過使用黑魔法。
sentences: The wizard used a necromantic ritual to seek guidance from the spirits of the past. 巫師使用了一種死靈儀式來尋求往日神靈的指引。
Many people believe that necromantic arts are forbidden and dangerous to study. 許多人認為亡靈藝術是禁忌且研究起來很危險的。
He tried to necromantically summon the spirit of the ancient king for help. 他試圖通過亡靈術召喚古代國王的靈魂以尋求幫助。
The secret knowledge was passed down necromantically through the generations of the clan. 這些秘密知識通過亡靈術在家族中代代相傳。

meaning: 蛹：與成蟲相似，只是完全靜止，就像死了一樣。
sentences: The biologist observed a necromorphous pupa attached to the leaf. 生物學家觀察到葉子上附著一個外形像成蟲但靜止不動的蛹。
Some insects stay in a necromorphous state for several weeks before emerging. 某些昆蟲在破殼而出之前，會維持這種外表像成蟲且靜止的狀態數週。
The geologist identified the rock as necronite because of its strong, unpleasant smell. 地質學家因為這塊石頭發出的強烈臭味而判定它是死臭長石。
You might find necronite near these old limestone caves. 你可能會在這些古老的石灰岩洞穴附近發現這種有惡臭的長石。
Doctors monitored the patient closely to prevent necropathy after the severe burn. 醫生密切監測病人的情況，以防止嚴重燒傷後出現組織壞死。
The medical report detailed the signs of necropathy in the damaged limb. 醫療報告詳細描述了受損肢體出現局部組織病變死亡的跡象。
Necrophaga play a vital role in the ecosystem by consuming dead animals. 食屍性甲蟲藉由食用動物屍體，在生態系統中發揮重要作用。
Many species of Necrophaga are attracted to the smell of decaying organic matter. 許多食屍性甲蟲會被腐爛有機物的氣味吸引。

meaning: 甲蟲的前部落食屍蟲，以腐肉為食。
sentences: The necrophagan moved quickly across the forest floor toward the remains. 那隻食屍甲蟲在森林地表上快速移動，朝向殘骸前進。
Scientists studied how the necrophagan helps break down biological waste. 科學家研究了這種食屍蟲如何協助分解生物廢棄物。

meaning: 牠吃死的或腐爛的動物肉。
sentences: Vultures are necrophagous birds that search for animal remains from the sky. 禿鷹是食屍性鳥類，會從空中搜尋動物殘骸。
These necrophagous insects help clean up the environment naturally. 這些以腐肉為食的昆蟲有助於自然清理環境。
The psychiatrist discussed the behavior of a necrophile during the lecture. 精神科醫生在講座中討論了戀屍癖患者的行為。
Police arrested the necrophile who had been breaking into the local cemetery. 警察逮捕了那名闖入當地墓地的戀屍癖患者。
The thriller movie explores the dark and disturbing theme of necrophilia. 這部驚悚電影探討了戀屍癖這個黑暗且令人不安的主題。
Medical students learned about the psychological roots of necrophilia. 醫學生學習了關於戀屍癖的心理根源。

meaning: 屬於戀屍癖或與戀屍癖有關。
sentences: The suspect showed necrophilic tendencies during the police interview. 嫌疑人在警方偵訊期間展現出戀屍癖的傾向。
Some horror stories feature necrophilic characters to shock the audience. 有些恐怖故事會塑造具有戀屍傾向的角色來震驚觀眾。
Historically, cases of necrophilism have been extremely rare in clinical studies. 從歷史上看，臨床研究中關於戀屍癖的案例極其罕見。
The report focused on the legal implications of necrophilism. 該報告聚焦於戀屍癖所涉及的法律影響。
The artist created a series of necrophilistic paintings for the dark art gallery. 藝術家為這家黑暗藝廊創作了一系列具有戀屍傾向的畫作。
Experts examined the necrophilistic motifs found in the ancient ruins. 專家檢查了在古老遺跡中發現的關於死屍愛好的圖案。

meaning: 在死亡或死物上茁壯成長。
sentences: Some types of necrophilous fungi grow only on decaying wood. 某些種類的嗜死真菌僅生長在腐爛的木頭上。
The team studied necrophilous bacteria found in the soil samples. 團隊研究了在土壤樣本中發現的嗜死性細菌。
Necrophily is considered a severe psychological disorder in modern medicine. 在現代醫學中，戀屍癖被認為是一種嚴重的心理障礙。
The documentary investigates the history of necrophily in different cultures. 這部紀錄片調查了不同文化中關於戀屍癖的歷史。

meaning: 對死亡或屍體的異常恐懼。
sentences: His necrophobia is so severe that he cannot even walk past a funeral home. 他的死亡恐懼症非常嚴重，甚至無法走過殯儀館。
Therapy can help people overcome their necrophobia and live a normal life. 治療可以幫助人們克服對死亡的恐懼，過上正常的生活。
She had a necrophobic reaction when she saw the skeleton in the science lab. 當她在科學實驗室看到骨架時，產生了恐懼死亡的反應。
Many cultures have necrophobic rituals to protect the living from the dead. 許多文化都有避諱死亡的儀式，以保護生者不受死者影響。

meaning: Nicrophorus（“塞克斯頓甲蟲屬”）的同義詞。
sentences: Biologists list Necrophorus in reference works on classification. 分類參考資料會列出這個名稱。
The museum label mentions Necrophorus when explaining the specimen's group. 標本標籤在說明所屬類群時也可能提到這個名稱。
Archaeologists discovered several ancient necropoleis hidden in the desert. 考古學家在沙漠中發現了幾處隱藏的古代大墓地。
These necropoleis provide valuable information about how people lived thousands of years ago. 這些大型公墓為幾千年前人們的生活方式提供了寶貴的資訊。
The guide pointed out the different necropoles located around the ancient city. 導遊指出了位於這座古城周圍的不同大墓地。
We visited two historical necropoles during our trip to Egypt. 我們在埃及旅行期間參觀了兩處歷史悠久的大型墓地。

meaning: 墓地；尤其是在城市內或城市附近的大型建築。
sentences: The reference note explains who necropolis is in its historical setting. 參考資料會交代這個名字在歷史或文本中的身分。
Students came across necropolis while reading an older text. 學生閱讀較早的文本時，可能會遇到這個名字。

meaning: 屬於或關於大型墓地或墓地的。
sentences: The city planning includes a new necropolitan area on the outskirts of town. 城市規劃包括在鎮郊建立一個新的大型墓地區。
Workers are maintaining the necropolitan gardens to keep them peaceful and clean. 工人們正在維護這座大型公墓的花園，以保持那裡的寧靜與整潔。

meaning: 對屍體進行病理檢查，特別是確定死因。
sentences: The veterinarian performed a necropsy to find out why the family dog died suddenly. 獸醫進行了屍檢，以找出家犬突然死亡的原因。
The zoo requested a necropsy for the lion to rule out any infectious diseases. 動物園要求對這隻獅子進行屍體解剖，以排除任何傳染病。
The lab results confirmed the necroscopic findings from earlier today. 實驗室結果證實了今天早些時候的屍檢發現。
Doctors used necroscopic tools to examine the internal organs carefully. 醫生使用屍檢工具仔細檢查內臟器官。
Older sources sometimes write necroscopical as an alternative form of necroscopic. 較早的資料有時會使用這個變體拼法。
Editors kept necroscopical in the word bank so readers can recognize that variant spelling. 這筆資料保留下來，是為了讓讀者辨認這種變體拼法。
The hospital records showed that a necroscopy was performed last Tuesday. 醫院記錄顯示上週二進行了屍體檢驗。
Necroscopy is often necessary in criminal investigations to establish the time of death. 在刑事調查中，屍檢通常是確定死亡時間所必需的。
If the blood flow is not restored, the tissue will start to necrose within hours. 如果血液流動沒有恢復，組織將在幾小時內開始壞死。
The frostbite caused the skin on his toes to necrose and turn black. 凍傷導致他腳趾上的皮膚壞死並變黑。

meaning: 由於損傷、疾病或血液供應中斷而導致的細胞或組織的局部死亡。
sentences: The patient suffered from bone necrosis due to a lack of oxygen in the hip joint. 由於髖關節缺氧，患者患有骨壞死。
Smoking can increase the risk of skin necrosis after a major surgery. 吸菸會增加重大手術後皮膚壞死的風險。

meaning: 屬於或關於壞死，特別是組織的壞死。
sentences: The surgeon had to remove the necrotic tissue to prevent the infection from spreading. 外科醫生必須移除壞死組織，以防止感染擴散。
You should apply this cream to the area around the necrotic wound daily. 你應該每天在壞死傷口周圍的區域塗抹這種藥膏。
The doctor explained how the necrotization of the skin happened after the infection. 醫生解釋了感染後皮膚是如何發生壞死的。
Early treatment can prevent the necrotization of the surrounding tissues. 早期治療可以防止周圍組織壞死。
The damaged tissue will necrotize if it does not receive enough oxygen. 受損的組織如果得不到足夠的氧氣就會壞死。
Doctors are trying to stop the wound from beginning to necrotize. 醫生們正試圖阻止傷口開始壞死。
The medical student used necrotomic tools during the anatomy class. 醫學生在解剖課上使用了屍檢工具。
The lab assistant prepared the necrotomic reports for the senior pathologist. 實驗室助理為資深病理學家準備了屍檢報告。
The necrotomist carefully examined the body to find the cause of death. 屍檢人員仔細檢查了屍體以找出死因。
After working as a necrotomist for years, he became an expert in forensic science. 在擔任多年屍檢人員後，他成為了法醫學專家。
The students watched a necrotomy to learn about human internal organs. 學生們觀看了屍體解剖以了解人體內臟。
The police requested a necrotomy to determine if there was any poison in the body. 警方要求進行屍體解剖，以確定體內是否有毒物。
The museum recently acquired a rare necrotype of a bird from the island. 博物館最近獲得了一種來自該島的罕見已滅絕鳥類標本。
Scientists used the necrotype to study the genetics of the extinct species. 科學家利用這個已滅絕物種的標本來研究其遺傳學。
The scientist examined the necrotypic cells under a microscope in the lab. 科學家在實驗室的顯微鏡下檢查了壞死類型的細胞。
Certain infections can cause necrotypic damage to the leaves of the plant. 某些感染會對植物的葉片造成壞死類型的損傷。

meaning: 樟科的一個分類屬－某些南美樹木和灌木、甜木。
sentences: Biologists list Nectandra in reference works on classification. 分類參考資料會列出這個名稱。
The museum label mentions Nectandra when explaining the specimen's group. 標本標籤在說明所屬類群時也可能提到這個名稱。
In the stories, the gods ate ambrosia and drank sweet nectar. 在故事中，眾神吃著仙饌，喝著甜美的神酒。
The hero was granted a cup of nectar to regain his strength. 英雄獲賜一杯神酒以恢復體力。

meaning: 屬於或關於花蜜的；花蜜的；甜的。
sentences: The bees were attracted to the nectareal scent of the blooming flowers. 蜜蜂被盛開花朵的花蜜香氣所吸引。
This fruit juice has a natural nectareal sweetness that everyone likes. 這款果汁有一種大家都喜歡的天然花蜜甜味。

meaning: 屬於或關於花蜜的；花蜜的；甜的。
sentences: The chef added a nectarean glaze to the dessert to improve its flavor. 廚師在甜點上塗了一層花蜜般的糖衣，以增添風味。
We enjoyed the nectarean taste of the fresh honey from the farm. 我們品嚐了來自農場新鮮蜂蜜的花蜜般美味。
The nectared blossoms in the garden were full of busy insects. 花園裡含有花蜜的花朵上到處都是忙碌的昆蟲。
Hummingbirds prefer visiting nectared plants during the spring. 蜂鳥在春天更喜歡造訪含有花蜜的植物。
The air was filled with a nectareous perfume from the jasmine vines. 空氣中瀰漫著茉莉藤蔓散發出的花蜜般香氣。

meaning: 以消極的方式；因而造成損害或不積極。

meaning: 進行談判的人；談判者，代理人。
sentences: The company hired a skilled negotiant to handle the trade agreement with the overseas supplier. 公司聘請了一位熟練的交涉專家來處理與海外供應商的貿易協定。

This nemocerous insect is harmless to humans. 這種長角昆蟲對人類無害。

meaning: 阿芬那明的衍生物，曾用於治療梅毒和雅司病。
sentences: Doctors used neoarsphenamine to treat patients many decades ago. 幾十年前，醫生使用這種藥物來治療病人。
The clinic ordered a fresh supply of neoarsphenamine for the study. 診所為這項研究訂購了新的一批阿芬那明衍生物。
Scientists traveled to the Southern Ocean to study the Neobalaena in its natural habitat. 科學家們前往南冰洋，在自然棲息地研究小露脊鯨。
The Neobalaena is the smallest of all baleen whales and is rarely seen by humans. 小露脊鯨是所有鬚鯨中體型最小的，人類很少見到牠。

meaning: 十字花科中的一個分類屬，某些開花植物，現屬於羅裡帕屬。
sentences: Biologists list Neobeckia in reference works on classification. 分類參考資料會列出這個名稱。
The museum label mentions Neobeckia when explaining the specimen's group. 標本標籤在說明所屬類群時也可能提到這個名稱。

meaning: 構成或屬於新的生長物，如組織。
sentences: The lab results confirmed the presence of neoblastic cells in the tissue sample. 實驗室結果證實組織樣本中存在新生的細胞。
Doctors are monitoring the patient for any neoblastic changes after the surgery. 醫生正在監測病人在手術後是否出現任何新的組織生長變化。
The neobotanist discovered a new species of fern in the tropical rainforest. 這位新植物學家在熱帶雨林中發現了一種新的蕨類植物。
She works as a neobotanist at the university, focusing on how climate change affects local plants. 她在大學擔任新植物學家，專注於研究氣候變遷如何影響當地植物。

meaning: 植物學的一個分支，研究現代仍然存在的植物，而不是古生物學。
sentences: The field guide identifies neobotany among similar living things. 野外圖鑑會用這個名稱區分相近的生物。
Researchers recorded neobotany during their survey of the area. 研究人員在調查時也可能記錄到這個名稱。
The report uses Neocene to describe a related feature. 報告用這個詞來描述某種相關特徵。
Readers may encounter Neocene in descriptive or specialist writing. 讀者可能會在描述性或專業文本中看到這個詞。

meaning: 新角齒魚科的一個分類屬—某些肺魚。
sentences: Biologists list Neoceratodus in reference works on classification. 分類參考資料會列出這個名稱。
The museum label mentions Neoceratodus when explaining the specimen's group. 標本標籤在說明所屬類群時也可能提到這個名稱。
The lab technician measured the level of neocerotic acid in the beeswax sample. 實驗室技術員測量了蜂蠟樣本中新蠟酸的含量。
Researchers are studying how neocerotic compounds affect the stability of the protective coating. 研究人員正在研究新蠟類化合物如何影響保護層的穩定性。
The new library was built in a neoclassic style with tall white columns. 這座新圖書館是以新古典主義風格建造的，擁有高大的白色圓柱。
She prefers neoclassic furniture because it blends traditional designs with modern simplicity. 她偏好新古典主義家具，因為它結合了傳統設計與現代簡約感。

meaning: 藝術、建築、文學和音樂領域的任何運動，復興了早期幾個世紀的形式，特別是古希臘人和古羅馬人的形式。
sentences: Neoclassicism became popular in Europe during the late 18th century as a reaction against the decorative Rococo style. 十八世紀後期，新古典主義在歐洲流行起來，作為對裝飾華麗的洛可可風格的一種反動。
The museum's collection features several paintings that exemplify the principles of neoclassicism. 博物館的館藏展示了幾幅體現新古典主義原則的繪畫。
The architect, a dedicated neoclassicist, insisted on using symmetrical designs for the city hall. 這位建築師是位堅定的新古典主義者，堅持在市政廳的設計中使用對稱元素。
Every neoclassicist in the group admired the balance and restraint of ancient Roman architecture. 團體中的每位新古典主義者都欽佩古羅馬建築的平衡與節制。

meaning: 屬於或關於下格林沙的。
sentences: Geologists identified several fossil layers from the Neocomian period in the cliff side. 地質學家在懸崖邊發現了幾個來自新科姆階時期的化石層。
The Neocomian rocks in this region are known for their high iron content. 這個地區的新科姆階岩石以含鐵量高而聞名。

meaning: 超越傳統或現實的現實表現。
sentences: The artist's neocosmic paintings explore themes of deep space and spiritual existence. 這位藝術家的新宇宙風格繪畫探索了深太空與靈性存在的境界。
Some philosophers use neocosmic theories to explain the origins of the universe. 一些哲學家使用新宇宙理論來解釋宇宙的起源。

meaning: 政府由新人或缺乏經驗的人組成。
sentences: After the revolution, the country was briefly a neocracy led by young students. 革命之後，這個國家曾短暫由一群年輕學生領導，形成新人政治。
Critics argued that the neocracy lacked the political wisdom needed to handle the economic crisis. 批評者認為，這種由政治新人組成的政府缺乏處理經濟危機所需的政治智慧。

meaning: 一種拒絕康德本體的哲學，將知識限制在由先驗範疇所構成的現象
sentences: His latest paper examines the influence of neocriticism on modern ethical theories. 他最新的論文探討了新批判主義對現代倫理理論的影響。
Students in the advanced philosophy class debated the core principles of neocriticism. 高等哲學課的學生們辯論了新批判主義的核心原則。

meaning: 氪花青中發現的一種染料。
sentences: The scientist used neocyanine to sensitize the photographic plates to infrared light. 科學家使用新花青使照相乾版對紅外光產生感光。

An increase in neocyte levels in the blood can indicate that the body is recovering from an infection. 血液中新釋放細胞水平的增加可能表明身體正在從感染中康復。

The status of a neodamode granted certain rights but did not equal full Spartan citizenship. 新達莫德的身分賦予了某些權利，但並不等同於完全的斯巴達公民權。
The lab report refers to the element as neodidymium instead of its modern name. 實驗室報告將該元素寫成了釹的舊稱，而不是現代的名稱。

The factory uses neodymium to create high-strength components for electric motors. 工廠使用釹來製造電動馬達的高強度零件。

meaning: 皮科（Dermateaceae）中的一個分類屬－某些真菌。

Doctors monitor the health of the neofetus to ensure there are no early developmental issues. 醫生會監測初期胚胎的健康狀況，以確保沒有早期的發育問題。

meaning: 倉鼠科的一個分類屬－圓尾麝香鼠、佛羅裡達水鼠。
sentences: Biologists list Neofiber in reference works on classification. 分類參考資料會列出這個名稱。
The museum label mentions Neofiber when explaining the specimen's group. 標本標籤在說明所屬類群時也可能提到這個名稱。

meaning: 屬於新世界或西半球的或與之相關的。
sentences: Many Neogaean bird species have evolved vibrant colors to attract mates in the dense forest. 許多新熱帶界的鳥類演化出了鮮豔的顏色，以便在茂密的森林中吸引配偶。

The neogamous couple spent their first holiday together in a quiet mountain cabin. 這對新婚夫婦在安靜的山間小屋度過了他們的第一個假期。
Friends and family gathered to celebrate the neogamous pair at a small dinner party. 親朋好友聚集在一個小型晚宴上，為這對新婚佳偶慶祝。

The lab results showed neogenetic activity in the healing muscle tissue. 實驗結果顯示癒合中的肌肉組織有新生成的活動。
Engineers are testing neogenetic materials that can repair themselves. 工程師正在測試能夠自我修復的新生成材料。

meaning: 爬蟲類綱中的分類學下綱－幾乎所有活的、會飛的鳥類。
sentences: Most birds you see in the park, like sparrows, belong to the Neognathae. 你在公園看到的大多數鳥類（如麻雀）都屬於新顎類。

The study compared neognathic birds with their more primitive ancestors. 這項研究將新顎類鳥類與其更原始的祖先進行了比較。
Most modern birds belong to the neognathic group of species. 大多數現代鳥類都屬於新顎類物種。

meaning: 屬於新頜動物或與新頜有關。

Editors kept neogrammarian in the word bank so readers can recognize that variant spelling. 這筆資料保留下來，是為了讓讀者辨認這種變體拼法。

meaning: 與新語法學派的理論有關。
sentences: The student wrote a paper about the neogrammatical history of English verbs. 學生寫了一篇關於英語動詞新語法歷史的論文。
The professor used a neogrammatical model to explain the changes in pronunciation. 教授使用新語法模型來解釋發音的變化。

sentences: The artist used neographic symbols to decorate the cover of the notebook. 藝術家使用創新的書寫符號來裝飾筆記本的封面。

The mechanic checked the fuel to see if it contained any neohexane. 技工檢查了燃料，看看是否含有新己烷。
Neohexane is used in the factory to help make high-quality gasoline. 工廠使用新己烷來協助製造高品質的汽油。

meaning: 馬科的一個分類屬－來自北美洲和中美洲新近紀（中新世至上新世）的一種已滅絕的馬科動物。
sentences: Biologists list Neohipparion in reference works on classification. 分類參考資料會列出這個名稱。
The museum label mentions Neohipparion when explaining the specimen's group. 標本標籤在說明所屬類群時也可能提到這個名稱。
The chemical supply company delivered a small container of neoholmia to the lab. 化學供應公司向實驗室交付了一小瓶氧化鈥。
The scientist carefully weighed the neoholmia for the next experiment. 科學家為下一次實驗仔細稱量了氧化鈥。
Neoholmium is a metal that can be used to create very strong magnets. 新鈥是一種可以用來製造強力磁鐵的金屬。
The teacher showed the class a sample of neoholmium during the science lesson. 老師在科學課上向全班展示了新鈥的樣本。

meaning: 法國印象派藝術的一種流派，使用點畫法來實現更正式的構圖。
sentences: We analyzed several artworks from neoimpressionism during the art history lecture. 我們在藝術史講座中分析了幾件來自該法國藝術流派的作品。
The gallery features a special exhibition focused on neoimpressionism and its dotting techniques. 畫廊舉辦了一場特展，專門介紹這種運用點畫法的藝術風格。

meaning: 從事新印象派創作的藝術家。
sentences: A neoimpressionist painter might spend months finishing a single large picture. 一位新印象派畫家可能會花幾個月的時間來完成一幅大畫。
My sister wants to become a neoimpressionist and paint with colorful dots. 我妹妹想成為一名新印象派畫家，用彩色點點來作畫。

meaning: 有些精神病患者傾向於使用新詞或無意義的詞語進行交談
sentences: The nurse noticed the patient's neolalia and reported it to the doctor. 護理師注意到患者使用無意義的新語，並向醫生報告。
Neolalia is a symptom that can make communication very difficult. 使用新語是一種會讓溝通變得非常困難的症狀。

sentences: The reference note explains who Newfoundland is in its historical setting. 參考資料會交代這個名字在歷史或文本中的身分。

sentences: The friendly Newfoundlander offered to show us the best fishing spots in the area. 那位友善的紐芬蘭人主動提議帶我們去當地最棒的釣魚地點。

sentences: The newscaster interviewed the mayor about the new park project. 新聞播報員就新公園計劃採訪了市長。

meaning: 定期發送的出版物，包含當前事件等，通常針對特定主題或面向有限的受眾。
sentences: You can subscribe to our weekly newsletter to get the latest shop discounts. 你可以訂閱我們的每週通訊，獲取最新的商店折扣。

sentences: The veteran newsman covered the election from the front lines. 這位資深男記者在第一線報導了這場選舉。

meaning: 與報紙相似或具有報紙的特徵。

meaning: 可供閱讀報紙和雜誌的房間。
sentences: The university library has a spacious newsroom with newspapers from all over the world. 大學圖書館有一個寬敞的閱報室，提供來自世界各地的報紙。
He spent his morning in the newsroom, catching up on the latest sports events. 他在閱報室度過了他的早晨，了解最新的體育賽事。

Editors kept newssheet in the word bank so readers can recognize that variant spelling. 這筆資料保留下來，是為了讓讀者辨認這種變體拼法。

meaning: 通常在街上的露天攤位，向公眾出售報紙和雜誌。
sentences: The field guide identifies newsstand among similar living things. 野外圖鑑會用這個名稱區分相近的生物。

The project is nominally completed, though there are still a few minor bugs to fix. 這個專案名義上已經完成了，雖然還有幾個小錯誤需要修復。
The committee decided to nominate her for the position of senior manager. 委員會決定提名她擔任高級經理一職。
Several famous actors were nominated for an Academy Award this year. 幾位著名的演員在今年獲得了奧斯卡獎的提名。
The nominated candidates will give their speeches in the assembly hall tomorrow. 獲得提名的候選人明天將在大禮堂發表演說。
She felt deeply honored to be among the nominated students for the annual scholarship. 能成為年度獎學金的獲提名學生之一，讓她感到非常榮幸。
The manager nominately assigned the hardest task to the most experienced engineer. 經理指名將最困難的任務交給最有經驗的工程師。

The nomination process for the new committee members will start next week. 新委員會成員的提名過程將於下週開始。

meaning: 屬於或關於主格的；主格
sentences: The nominatival case in this language usually indicates the subject of a verb. 這種語言中的主格通常表示動詞的主詞。
Please identify the nominatival pronoun in the following sentence. 請找出下面句子中的主格代名詞。
The president has nominative power to select the new committee members. 總裁擁有選定新委員會成員的任命權。
They established a nominative system to keep track of everyone who entered the laboratory. 他們建立了一個實名登記系統，以追蹤每個進入實驗室的人。

meaning: 以主格的方式；作為主格。
sentences: The pronoun 'he' functions nominatively in a basic sentence. 代名詞 'he' 在基本句子中充當主格。
He marked the subject of the sentence nominatively. 他將句子的主詞標示為主格。
The nominator must fill out a detailed form explaining why the candidate deserves the award. 提名者必須填寫一份詳細的表格，說明候選人為何值得獲獎。
Each nominator is allowed to propose up to three people for the leadership position. 每位提名人最多可以為這個領導職位推薦三個人。
The nominatrix proudly introduced her colleague at the annual science convention. 這位女性提名人在年度科學大會上自豪地介紹了她的同事。
We need the signature of the nominatrix before we can process the award application. 我們需要這位女性推薦人的簽名，才能處理獎項申請。
The professor explained how to correctly use the nominature form in a speech. 教授解釋了如何在演講中正確使用呼格形式。
The nominature case is quite rare in modern English grammatical structures. 呼格在現代英語語法結構中非常罕見。
The nominees for the award attended a special ceremony in the city center. 該獎項的獲提名人出席了在市中心舉行的特別典禮。
The company announced the list of nominees for the new board of directors. 公司公佈了新任董事會成員的被提名者名單。

meaning: 政治裙帶關係的一種形式，政黨在成功選舉後用工作獎勵其支持者。
sentences: The political scandal revealed the deep-rooted nomineeism within the department. 這場政治醜聞揭露了部門內部根深蒂固的政黨分肥制度。

The local children learned a traditional nominy for the school festival. 當地孩子們為了學校慶典學習了一段傳統的順口溜。

meaning: 遵守宗教法律或戒律作為宗教的主要面向。
sentences: The ancient community practiced a strict form of nomism, following every rule written in their sacred texts. 這個古老的社區實行嚴格的律法主義，遵守神聖文本中寫下的每一條規則。
Modern members often debate whether simple faith is more important than rigid nomism. 現代成員經常爭論單純的信仰是否比僵化的教條主義更重要。
The traders exchanged local nomisma for goods at the bustling market. 商人們在熙熙攘攘的市場上用當地的貨幣交換商品。
The country decided to introduce a new digital nomisma to stabilize its economy. 該國決定發行一種新的數位貨幣以穩定其經濟。

meaning: nomisma的主格/受格/呼格複數形式
sentences: The merchant poured a bag of gold nomismata onto the table to pay for the spices. 商人把一袋金幣倒在桌上來支付香料的費用。
Archaeologists discovered several ancient nomismata buried near the ruins of the temple. 考古學家在寺廟廢墟附近發現了幾枚埋藏的古代錢幣。

meaning: 屬於唯名論或與唯名論有關。
sentences: The professor discussed the nomistic approach to understanding abstract concepts in philosophy class. 教授在哲學課上討論了理解抽象概念的唯名論方法。
Her research focuses on nomistic theories and how they challenge traditional views of universal truth. 她的研究主要集中在唯名論理論以及它們如何挑戰普世真理的傳統觀點。

meaning: 教會法的集合，包含民法和教會法的要素。
sentences: The medieval scholars spent years compiling a comprehensive nomocanon for the empire. 中世紀的學者花了數年時間為帝國編寫了一部全面的教會與世俗法典。
During the trial, the judge referred to the ancient nomocanon to resolve the dispute between the farmers and the monks. 在審判期間，法官參考了古老的教會法典來解決農民和僧侶之間的爭端。

meaning: 理性法律和公民權利主權之下的政治體系。
sentences: The citizens demanded a true nomocracy where no politician would be above the law. 公民要求建立一個真正的法治國家，在這樣的體制下沒有任何政治人物能凌駕於法律之上。
In a functional nomocracy, the constitution guarantees equal rights and protections for everyone. 在一個運作良好的法治社會中，憲法保障每個人的平等權利和保護。
The passionate nomogenist argued that complex organisms evolved through predictable physical processes. 這位熱情的自然發生論支持者認為，複雜的生物是透過可預測的物理過程演化而來的。
As a leading nomogenist, the biologist published several papers rejecting the idea of miraculous creation. 身為一位頂尖的自然起源論者，這位生物學家發表了幾篇拒絕奇蹟創造論的論文。
The team discovered a nomogenous pattern in how the bacteria adapted to the extreme heat. 研究團隊在細菌適應極端高溫的方式中發現了自然起源的模式。
His new research explores the nomogenous development of early single-celled organisms in the ocean. 他的新研究探討了海洋中早期單細胞生物的自然法則演化。

meaning: 生命的起源是根據自然法則，而不是奇蹟。
sentences: The documentary explains the concept of nomogeny by showing how basic chemicals can form living cells. 這部紀錄片透過展示基本化學物質如何形成活細胞來解釋自然發生的概念。
Many modern scientists support nomogeny as the most logical explanation for the beginnings of life on Earth. 許多現代科學家支持自然法則起源說，認為這是對地球生命起源最合乎邏輯的解釋。
The software allows engineers to nomogram the complex thermal equations easily. 這款軟體能讓工程師輕鬆地將複雜的熱方程式繪製成列線圖。
If we nomogram these variables, it will be much faster for the nurses to calculate the correct drug dosage. 如果我們將這些變數繪製成列線圖，護士計算正確藥物劑量的速度就會快得多。
The doctor used a specialized nomograph to quickly estimate the patient's body surface area. 醫生使用專門的列線圖來快速估算患者的體表面積。
Before computers became common, engineers relied heavily on a nomograph for structural calculations. 在電腦普及之前，工程師在進行結構計算時非常依賴列線圖。
The company hired an expert nomographer to simplify their data visualization process. 該公司聘請了一位專家級的列線圖繪製者來簡化他們的數據視覺化流程。
A skilled nomographer can turn pages of complex mathematical tables into a single easy-to-read chart. 熟練的列線圖專家可以將好幾頁複雜的數學表格變成一張容易閱讀的圖表。
The engineer designed a new nomographic tool to help technicians align the laser beams perfectly. 工程師設計了一種新的列線圖工具，以幫助技術人員完美對齊雷射光束。
By using a nomographic approach, the team successfully reduced the time needed for the daily risk assessment. 透過使用列線圖的方法，團隊成功減少了日常風險評估所需的時間。
The engineer used a nomographical chart to quickly estimate the fluid pressure. 工程師使用圖表來快速估算流體壓力。
We can find the approximate values through a nomographical method instead of complex calculations. 我們可以透過圖解方法而非複雜的計算來找出近似值。
The engineer solved the complex equation nomographically to save time. 工程師用列線圖解法解出複雜的方程式以節省時間。
We can determine the final value nomographically rather than using a calculator. 我們可以透過列線圖來求出最終數值，而不需要使用計算機。
His latest publication on nomography offers a detailed look at how local regulations are drafted. 他最新出版的法律專論詳細探討了地方法規是如何起草的。
The professor spent years studying nomography to understand the evolution of the city's legal system. 教授花了多年時間研究法制史與專著，以了解該城市法律體系的演變。

meaning: 涉及或表達缺乏邏輯必要性的一般法則。
sentences: The researchers developed a nomological framework to explain the relationship between these psychological traits. 研究人員發展出一個法則框架，用以解釋這些心理特徵之間的關聯。
Her theory lacks a solid nomological basis, making it difficult to predict future outcomes. 她的理論缺乏堅實的法則基礎，導致很難預測未來的結果。
The nomologist argued that the new policy violated fundamental principles of justice. 這位法理學者認為新政策違反了基本的正義原則。
As a respected nomologist, she was frequently asked to consult on constitutional reforms. 作為一位受人尊敬的法則學專家，她經常受邀為憲法改革提供諮詢。
His keen interest in nomology led him to pursue a career as a legal scholar. 他對法理學的濃厚興趣驅使他成為一名法律學者。
The university offers a new course on nomology for students who want to understand the philosophy behind our legal system. 大學為想了解法律體系背後哲學的學生提供了一門全新的法學理論課程。

meaning: 有一個單獨且簡單的肌腱來彎曲第一個腳趾或拇趾。
sentences: The biologist identified the bird by its nomopelmous foot structure during the field study. 生物學家在野外調查時，透過其特殊的足部肌腱結構辨識出這隻鳥。
Nomopelmous characteristics are often found in specific species of waterfowl. 這種腳趾肌腱單一的特徵通常見於特定種類的水禽。

meaning: 古希臘的一位地方法官，負責法律文本的保管人。
sentences: In ancient times, the nomophylax played a crucial role in ensuring that the laws were preserved and followed. 在古代，這位守法官在確保法律被保存與遵守方面扮演了關鍵角色。
The citizens respected the nomophylax because he guarded the founding documents of their city. 市民們非常尊敬這位法規保管人，因為他守護了他們城市的建城文獻。
This evergreen shrub is nomophyllous and keeps its leaves all winter long. 這種常綠灌木具有正常葉，且整個冬天都保留著葉子。
The botanist classified the plant as nomophyllous based on its leaf structure. 植物學家根據葉片結構將該植物歸類為正常葉型。

meaning: 法律體系，尤其是規範人類行為的法律體系。
sentences: The ancient community was governed by a strict nomos that guided everyone's daily actions. 那個古老的社群受到一套嚴格的規範體系所治理，指引著每個人的日常行為。
Understanding the cultural nomos of a society helps anthropologists explain its traditions. 了解一個社會的文化法則有助於人類學家解釋其傳統。

meaning: 相信上帝是遍及宇宙的法則。
sentences: His philosophy leans towards nomotheism, viewing the laws of physics as a divine presence. 他的哲學偏向這種信仰，將物理定律視為一種神聖的存在。
The ancient text describes a form of nomotheism where moral rules and the universe's order are one. 這份古老文獻描述了一種將道德規範與宇宙秩序合而為一的信仰。
The wise nomothete drafted a set of rules that brought peace to the warring factions. 這位充滿智慧的立法者起草了一套規則，為交戰各方帶來了和平。
As a dedicated nomothete, he spent his life improving the legal code of his country. 作為一位盡責的法規制定者，他終其一生都在改善國家的法典。
The assembly of nomothetes gathered in the great hall to debate the new constitution. 這些立法者聚集在大廳裡，針對新憲法進行辯論。
Ancient cities often relied on a group of nomothetes to establish fair trade regulations. 古代城市通常仰賴一群法規制定者來建立公平的貿易規範。

meaning: 與主體的基本規律相關。
sentences: A nomothetic study aims to discover the universal laws of the natural world. 規律性研究旨在發現自然界的普遍規律。
The research used a nomothetic framework to analyze recent social trends. 這項研究使用規律性框架來分析近期的社會趨勢。

She adjusted the sample non to match the description in the manual. 她依照手冊描述調整樣本時，用上了這個副詞。
She volunteers at a local non-profit organization that rescues stray animals. 她在當地一家拯救流浪動物的非營利組織擔任志工。
The community center operates on a non-profit basis to provide free meals for the homeless. 該社區中心以不營利為原則，為無家可歸的人提供免費餐點。

We took a non-stop flight from New York to London. 我們搭乘從紐約直飛倫敦的航班。

meaning: 寧（克羅埃西亞的一個小鎮）
sentences: We visited the beautiful historical churches when we traveled to Nona last summer. 去年夏天我們去這座克羅埃西亞小鎮旅遊時，參觀了美麗的歷史教堂。
Nona is famous for its ancient salt pans and rich cultural heritage. 這座城鎮以其古老的鹽田和豐富的文化遺產而聞名。

meaning: 不存在遺棄情況；未能放棄某事。
sentences: The lawyer argued that the owner's frequent visits proved the nonabandonment of the property. 律師主張屋主頻繁的探視證明了該財產並未遭到遺棄。

His nonabdication of responsibility showed his commitment to fixing the company's mistakes. 他沒有推卸責任，展現了他彌補公司錯誤的決心。

meaning: 在日常生活中（冥想時除外）避免心理構造的做法。
sentences: The monk explained that nonabiding helps free the mind from unnecessary daily worries. 僧侶解釋說，這種不執著的修行有助於讓心靈擺脫不必要的日常煩惱。
She practices nonabiding to stay focused on the present moment during her busy work schedule. 她練習這種避免心理束縛的方法，以便在繁忙的工作日程中專注於當下。
The worker was compensated for his temporary nonability to perform physical labor after the accident. 這名工人在意外發生後，因暫時喪失從事體力勞動的能力而獲得補償。
Her nonability to speak French made the business trip to Paris quite challenging. 她不會說法語，這讓巴黎的出差充滿挑戰。
The prisoner's nonabjuration of his beliefs surprised the court guards. 囚犯拒絕背棄其信仰，這讓法庭守衛感到驚訝。
Her nonabjuration of the agreement led to a lengthy legal dispute. 她拒絕撤回該協議，導致了一場漫長的法律糾紛。
The nonabjurer was respected by his peers for standing by his principles. 那位不肯背教的人因堅持其原則而受到同儕的尊敬。
Historical records mention several nonabjurers who remained loyal to their faith. 歷史記錄提到了幾位對信仰保持忠誠而不肯背教的人。

meaning: 沒有廢除；未能廢除某事。
sentences: The nonabolition of the tax law sparked protests in the capital city. 該項稅法未遭廢除，在首都引發了抗議活動。
Some citizens support the nonabolition of the old building, arguing it has historical value. 一些市民支持保留這棟舊建築而不予拆除，認為它具有歷史價值。
The nonabridgment of civil liberties is a key feature of a healthy democracy. 不削減公民自由是健全民主制度的一個關鍵特徵。
The fans insisted on the nonabridgment of the movie's original ending. 影迷們堅持電影的原版結局不能被刪節。
The manager praised his nonabsentation during the entire busy season. 經理表揚他在整個繁忙季節期間全程參與、從未缺席。
Consistent nonabsentation is required for students to pass this advanced course. 學生必須保持全勤不缺席才能通過這門進階課程。
Scientific results are often nonabsolute and change as new evidence is discovered. 科學結果通常不是絕對的，會隨著新證據的發現而改變。
The judge gave a nonabsolute order that allows for adjustments in the future. 法官給出了一項非絕對的命令，允許在未來進行調整。
The prisoner's nonabsolution meant he had to serve his full sentence in jail. 囚犯未獲赦免，這意味著他必須在監獄裡服完所有刑期。
He felt a sense of nonabsolution even after his friends said they moved on. 即使在他的朋友們說已經不再計較後，他仍感到一種未受寬恕的沉重感。

meaning: 那是無法被吸收的；不可吸收
sentences: The surgeon used nonabsorbable thread to close the deep cut on his arm. 外科醫生使用不可吸收的線來縫合他手臂上的深層傷口。
This nonabsorbable material is perfect for making long-lasting water pipes. 這種不可吸收的材料非常適合用來製作耐用的水管。
Use a nonabsorbent cloth to wipe away the spilled oil. 使用不吸水的布來擦拭濺出的油脂。
The floor is made of a nonabsorbent material for easy cleaning. 地板是由不吸水的材質製成，以便於清潔。
The nonabsorptive surface of the floor tiles prevents spills from leaving stains. 地磚的不吸收表面可以防止液體潑灑後留下污漬。
Scientists use nonabsorptive containers to store these sensitive chemical liquids. 科學家使用不具吸收性的容器來儲存這些敏感的化學液體。
As a nonabstainer, he usually enjoys a small glass of wine with his dinner. 作為一個不戒酒的人，他通常在晚餐時享受一小杯紅酒。
The health study compared the habits of both abstainers and nonabstainers. 這項健康研究比較了戒酒者與不戒酒者的生活習慣。
The nonabstaining members of the board voted in favor of the new project. 董事會中未棄權的成員投票贊成這項新計畫。
All nonabstaining participants must submit their final scores before the deadline. 所有不棄權的參與者必須在截止日期前提交最終評分。
His nonabstemious eating habits eventually led to several health problems. 他那不節制的飲食習慣最終導致了一些健康問題。
The party was filled with nonabstemious drinking and very loud music. 派對上充滿了不節制的飲酒和非常吵鬧的音樂。

meaning: 沒有棄權；未能放棄某事。
sentences: The high rate of nonabstention showed that students cared about the election. 高投票率（無棄權）顯示學生們非常關心這次選舉。
Her nonabstention ensured that every member's opinion was officially recorded. 她沒有棄權，確保了每位成員的意見都被正式記錄下來。
Teachers should use nonabstract objects to help kids understand basic math. 老師應該使用不抽象的實物來幫助孩子理解基礎數學。
The instructions provide nonabstract steps to build the model. 說明書提供了具體且不抽象的步驟來組裝模型。
He decided to look for a nonacademic job in a local tech company. 他決定在當地的科技公司找一份非學術性的工作。

sentences: The lab assistant carefully measured the sodium sulfide nonahydrate for the experiment. 實驗室助理仔細測量了實驗所需的九水合硫化鈉。

The committee separated the nonaid budget from the emergency relief funds. 委員會將非援助預算與緊急救濟資金分開。

sentences: Kids can enjoy the nonalcoholic sparkling cider during the toast. 孩子們可以在舉杯慶祝時享用不含酒精的氣泡蘋果汁。
The party menu includes several nonalcoholic options for the guests. 派對菜單為賓客準備了幾種無酒精選擇。
The math professor explained nonalgebraic functions in today's lecture. 數學教授在今天的課程中解釋了非代數函數。
He struggled to solve the nonalgebraic components of the equation. 他在解決方程式中的非代數部分時遇到了困難。

The project promotes nonalienation by bringing different communities together. 該計畫透過將不同社區聚集在一起，促進彼此不再疏遠。

The researcher found several nonalkaloidal compounds in the leaf extract. 研究人員在葉片萃取物中發現了幾種非生物鹼化合物。

A nonallegation of misconduct allowed the employee to keep his job. 由於並未指控有不當行為，該員工得以保住工作。

The nonalliterated prose felt more direct and honest to the reader. 沒有押頭韻的散文讓讀者感到更加直接與誠懇。
He preferred a nonalliterative style for his formal essays. 他在正式論文中偏好不使用頭韻的風格。

The nonalluvial terrain was difficult to plow because of the rocks. 由於岩石多，這種非沖積地形很難耕種。

meaning: 不是按字母順序排列的。
sentences: The password must contain at least one nonalphabetic character. 密碼必須包含至少一個非字母字元。
The system failed to recognize the nonalphabetic symbols in the file. 系統無法辨識檔案中的非字母符號。

The nonamalgamable metals remained separate even at high temperatures. 即使在高溫下，這些不可融合的金屬仍保持分離。
The final contract includes several nonamendable clauses. 最終合約包含幾項不可修改的條款。
The board decided that the project deadline is nonamendable. 董事會決定計畫的截止日期是不可更改的。
The lab identified a nonamino acid in the chemical mixture. 實驗室在化學混合物中鑑定出一種非氨基酸。
The nonamino parts of the protein structure were analyzed in detail. 蛋白質結構中的非氨基部分被詳細分析。

Legal documents confirmed the nonamotion of the property rights. 法律文件確認了財產權並未被移轉或撤銷。
The nonamphibious vehicles had to wait for the ferry to cross the river. 這些非兩棲車輛必須等待渡輪才能過河。
This species of lizard is nonamphibious and lives strictly on land. 這種蜥蜴並非兩棲類，完全生活在陸地上。
The doctor recommended a treatment plan focused on nonamputation. 醫生建議了一項以不截肢為重點的治療方案。
Early intervention in the infection resulted in nonamputation of the toe. 對感染的早期介入使得腳趾免於被截肢。
The logic fails because there is a clear nonanalogy between these two situations. 由於這兩種情況之間明顯不具備類比關係，該邏輯是不成立的。
The professor pointed out the nonanalogy to clarify the scientific concept. 教授指出了兩者之間不具類比性，以釐清科學概念。
Sometimes a nonanalytical and intuitive guess is the best way to start. 有時，不經分析的直覺猜測是最好的開始方式。
His nonanalytical approach to art focuses on how the colors feel. 他對藝術那種不追求分析的方式，重點在於色彩給人的感覺。
The complex data was nonanalyzable because some files were corrupted. 這些複雜的數據因部分檔案損毀而無法分析。

Teachers often explain the difference between anaphoric and nonanaphoric words. 老師經常解釋詞彙在照應與非照應用法上的差異。

meaning: 任何具有9個碳原子的環烷烴。
sentences: Scientists found nonanaphthene in the soil near the oil refinery. 科學家在煉油廠附近的土壤中發現了九碳環烷。

Patients might feel nonanatomical pain that doesn't follow typical nerve paths. 患者可能會感到不符合解剖路徑的疼痛，也就是並非沿著典型的神經路徑。

meaning: 烷烴的任何一種異構體，通式為C9H20，具有九個碳原子。
sentences: Nonane is a colorless liquid often used as a component in engine fuel. 壬烷是一種無色液體，常用作引擎燃料的成分。

The little boy's nonangelic behavior at the party surprised everyone. 這小男孩在派對上那種不像天使的行為讓每個人都很驚訝。

meaning: 不參加釣魚或釣魚活動。
sentences: The park offers many nonangling activities like hiking and bird watching. 公園提供許多不涉及釣魚的活動，例如健行和賞鳥。

The stock price dropped after the nonannouncement of quarterly earnings. 在沒有發布季度收益公告後，股價下跌了。

Nonanoic acid has a strong odor and is used in some organic solvents. 壬酸有一種強烈的氣味，被用於某些有機溶劑中。
The chemical factory produces nonanoic compounds used in the fragrance industry. 這間化工廠生產用於香料工業的壬酸化合物。
The website enforces nonanonymity to prevent online harassment and bullying. 該網站強制執行非匿名制，以防止網路騷擾和霸凌。

The politician gave a long nonanswer when asked about the budget cuts. 當被問及預算削減時，這位政治家給出了一個冗長卻避而不答的回覆。

Engineers designed a nonanticipative controller for the stable robot arm. 工程師為穩定的機器人手臂設計了一個非預見性的控制器。

The medical implant is made of nonantigenic materials to avoid rejection. 醫療植入物是由不具抗原性的材料製成的，以避免產生排斥反應。
Scientists are searching for nonantigenic proteins for the new vaccine. 科學家正在為新疫苗尋找不具抗原性的蛋白質。
She remained nonapologetic about her controversial comments on the news. 她對自己在新聞中發表的爭議性言論仍不打算道歉。
His nonapologetic attitude during the meeting made his colleagues very angry. 他在會議中那種不道歉的態度讓同事們非常生氣。
The community honored the nonapostatizing elders for their loyalty. 社區表彰了那些不背棄信仰的長輩，以紀念他們的忠誠。

The Supreme Court issued a nonappealable decision regarding the property dispute. 最高法院對這起財產糾紛做出了不可上訴的裁決。
Once the deadline has passed, the administrative order becomes nonappealable. 一旦超過期限，該行政命令就變得不可上訴。

meaning: 未能出庭，尤其是在法律審判中。
sentences: The judge issued a warrant for his arrest following his nonappearance in court. 由於他未能出庭，法官簽發了逮捕令。

meaning: 未能出庭的人，尤其是在法律審判中。
sentences: The clerk recorded the names of each nonappearer during the morning court session. 書記官記錄了上午庭審中每一位未能出庭者的姓名。

The doctor confirmed that the abdominal pain was caused by a nonappendicular infection. 醫生確認腹痛是由非闌尾感染引起的。
The medical report described the mass as being nonappendicular in origin. 醫療報告將該腫塊描述為非闌尾來源。

meaning: 未能適用現行法律、法規、規章等。
sentences: The lawyer argued that the nonapplication of the safety rule led to the accident. 律師辯稱，安全法規未能適用是導致事故的原因。

Investors were concerned about the nonappraisal of the company's long-term assets. 投資者對公司長期資產缺乏評價感到擔憂。
His nonappreciation of classical music made the concert a boring experience. 他對古典音樂缺乏鑑賞力，使得這場音樂會變得很乏味。
She was disappointed by his nonappreciation of all the effort she put into the dinner. 他對她為晚餐所付出的所有努力缺乏感激，這讓她感到失望。
The student's nonapprehension of the basic concepts resulted in low test scores. 學生對基本概念未能領會，導致考試成績低。
There was a general nonapprehension of the new policy among the staff members. 員工們普遍未能理解這項新政策。
The project was canceled due to the nonappropriation of funds by the city council. 由於市議會沒有撥款，該計畫被取消了。
The nonappropriation of the necessary budget delayed the start of the construction. 必要預算沒有撥款延誤了工程的啟動。

meaning: 未經批准；未能批准某事。
sentences: The building plan faced nonapproval from the local planning department. 建築計劃未獲得當地規劃部門的批准。

The legal team argued that the dispute was nonarbitrable under the current contract. 法律團隊辯稱，根據現有合約，該糾紛是不可仲裁的。
Some family law matters are considered nonarbitrable in this jurisdiction. 在該司法管轄區，某些家事法事務被認為是不可仲裁的。
The technician installed a nonarcing switch to prevent electrical fires. 技術人員安裝了一個不拉弧開關，以防止電氣火災。
This relay is designed with nonarcing contacts for safe use in high-voltage circuits. 這種繼電器採用不拉弧接點設計，以便在高壓電路中安全使用。
The miners discovered a large deposit of nonargentiferous lead ore. 礦工們發現了大量的非含銀鉛礦床。
