meaning: 不屬於或與職業無關；非職業性的。
sentences: The government appointed several noncareer diplomats to serve in foreign embassies. 政府任命了幾位非職業外交官在駐外使館任職。
He played as a noncareer athlete in the local league during his college years. 他在大學期間以非職業運動員的身分參加當地聯賽。
Giraffes are noncarnivorous animals that spend most of their time eating leaves. 長頸鹿是非肉食性動物，大部分時間都在吃樹葉。
The biologist studied the teeth of noncarnivorous mammals in the rainforest. 生物學家研究了雨林中非肉食性哺乳動物的牙齒。

meaning: 不是（疾病等）攜帶者的人
sentences: The clinic provides counseling for every noncarrier of the virus. 診所為每一位病毒非帶原者提供諮詢。
The test results confirmed that she is a noncarrier of the trait. 測試結果證實她並非該特徵的攜帶者。
The government prefers a noncartelized industry to ensure fair competition. 政府更偏好非壟斷性的產業，以確保公平競爭。
The noncartelized nature of the market keeps prices low for consumers. 市場的非卡特爾化性質使消費者的價格保持在低位。
They promote noncaste equality in all their recruitment processes. 他們在所有招聘過程中都推崇不分種姓的平等。
The noncaste movement gained momentum in the rural villages. 這場非種姓運動在農村地區獲得了動力。
The child responded well to the teacher's noncastigation policy. 這孩子對老師不予嚴懲的政策反應良好。
He was surprised by the noncastigation he received after the accident. 他對事故發生後受到的寬大處理感到驚訝。
The office hired a noncataloguer to help with general filing. 辦公室雇用了一名不負責編目的人員來協助一般歸檔。
Even as a noncataloguer, she knew where every document belonged. 即使不是編目員，她也知道每份文件該放在哪裡。
The patient showed noncatarrhal symptoms during the initial exam. 患者在初步檢查中表現出非卡他性的症狀。
The study focused on noncatarrhal infections of the respiratory tract. 該研究專注於呼吸道的非卡他性感染。
The philosopher argued that certain personal truths are noncatechizable. 那位哲學家主張某些個人真理是無法透過教義問答來傳授的。
She found the deep emotions in the poem to be noncatechizable. 她覺得這首詩中深沉的情感無法簡單地用問答方式來解釋。
The witness gave a noncategorical statement about what she saw. 證人對她所見之物做出了非絕對性的陳述。
The manager's noncategorical support made the team feel uncertain. 經理那非斷然的支持讓團隊感到不確定。

meaning: 不屬於或與大教堂無關。
sentences: The choir performed at a noncathedral venue for the first time. 合唱團首次在非大教堂的場地演出。
The priest oversees several noncathedral parishes in the region. 該神父負責管理該地區的幾個非主教座堂教區。
The noncatholicity of the appeal limited the number of donations. 該呼籲缺乏普遍性，限制了捐款的數量。
He argued that the noncatholicity of the theory made it useless in practice. 他認為該理論缺乏廣泛適用性，使其在實務中毫無用處。

meaning: 非因果關係的替代拼法。
sentences: Older sources sometimes write noncausality as an alternative form of non-causality. 較早的資料有時會使用這個變體拼法。
Editors kept noncausality in the word bank so readers can recognize that variant spelling. 這筆資料保留下來，是為了讓讀者辨認這種變體拼法。
The researchers emphasized the possibility of noncausation in their report. 研究人員在報告中強調了缺乏因果關係的可能性。
A logic error led to a false assumption of noncausation between the events. 邏輯錯誤導致對事件之間缺乏因果關係的錯誤假設。

meaning: 一次性；為單一場合或用途而生產或創造。表示某事發生一次。
sentences: He used a nonce word that he made up on the spot. 他使用了一個當場臨時編造的詞。
This tool was created for a nonce purpose and will not be needed again. 這個工具是為了單一用途而製作的，之後將不再需要。

meaning: 缺乏慶祝活動；未能慶祝。
sentences: The team's noncelebration of the goal showed their lack of unity. 球隊在進球後沒有慶祝，顯示出他們缺乏凝聚力。
The noncelebration of the anniversary was a personal choice of the couple. 不慶祝週年紀念日是這對夫婦的個人選擇。
These rocks are of noncelestial origin and came from a local volcano. 這些岩石並非來自天外，而是源自當地的火山。
The scientist focused on noncelestial phenomena like weather patterns on Earth. 科學家專注於非天文現象，例如地球上的天氣模式。
The tablet is a noncellular model and only connects to Wi-Fi. 這台平板電腦是非蜂窩網路機型，只能連接無線網路。
Noncellular communication systems are often used in remote areas. 非蜂窩式通訊系統常用於偏遠地區。
This jacket is made from noncellulosic fibers like nylon. 這件夾克是由尼龍等非纖維素纖維製成的。
The factory specializes in producing noncellulosic materials for construction. 這家工廠專門生產用於建築的非纖維素材料。
The reporter shared a noncensored version of the video online. 記者在網路上分享了未經審查的影片版本。
You can find noncensored news on several independent websites. 你可以在幾個獨立網站上找到未經刪減的新聞。
She has a noncensorious attitude toward people with different lifestyles. 她對生活方式不同的人抱持著不批判的態度。
He gave a noncensorious review of the student's imperfect work. 他對學生不完美的作品給予了不帶挑剔的評價。

meaning: 沒有進行或與人口普查相關。
sentences: The group collected noncensus data to understand local shopping habits. 該小組收集了非人口普查數據，以了解當地的購物習慣。
These noncensus statistics are updated every month by the company. 這些非普查統計數據由公司每月更新。
The hotel is located in a noncentral part of the city. 飯店位於城市的非中心區域。
The problem was caused by a noncentral part of the engine. 問題是由引擎的一個非核心部件引起的。
The farm only grows noncereal crops like beans and potatoes. 該農場只種植豆類和馬鈴薯等非穀類作物。
She chose a noncereal breakfast to avoid extra carbohydrates. 她選擇了非麥片類的早餐，以避免攝取額外的碳水化合物。
The comedy was criticized for being noncerebral and silly. 這部喜劇被批評為沒大腦且愚蠢。
He prefers noncerebral activities like hiking after a long day of work. 在漫長的一天工作後，他更喜歡徒步旅行等不費腦力的活動。
They signed the contract in a nonceremonial meeting at the office. 他們在辦公室的一次非正式會議上簽署了合約。
The king wore nonceremonial clothes during his private visit. 國王在私人訪問期間穿著非禮儀服裝。
The future of the company remains noncertain due to the market crash. 由於市場崩盤，公司的未來仍然不確定。
His arrival time is noncertain because of the heavy snow. 由於大雪，他的到達時間並不確定。
The noncertainty of the weather made it hard to plan the outdoor wedding. 天氣狀況的不確定性使得戶外婚禮很難規劃。
There is a sense of noncertainty regarding the new policy's impact on small businesses. 關於新政策對小企業的影響，目前還存在一種不確定感。
We decided not to buy the noncertified organic vegetables from the local market. 我們決定不買當地市場那些未經認證的有機蔬菜。
The technician warned that using noncertified parts could damage the car's engine. 技師警告說，使用未經認證的零件可能會損壞汽車引擎。
These running shorts are made of a nonchafing material to prevent skin irritation. 這些慢跑短褲是用不會磨傷皮膚的材質製成的，以防止皮膚過敏。
He applied a nonchafing cream to his feet before starting the marathon. 在開始馬拉松之前，他在腳上塗抹了一層防磨膏。

meaning: 冷漠、漠不關心；疏忽;涼爽；漠視、疏離。
sentences: He handled the difficult situation with surprising nonchalance. 他以令人驚訝的淡定態度處理了那個困難的局面。
Her nonchalance about the exam results worried her parents. 她對考試成績那副滿不在乎的樣子讓父母很擔心。
The cat gave a nonchalant yawn before going back to sleep. 那隻貓在繼續睡覺前隨意地打了個哈欠。
She tried to appear nonchalant even though she was very nervous about the interview. 儘管她對面試感到非常緊張，但仍試圖表現得很從容。

meaning: 以一種漫不經心的方式。
sentences: He nonchalantly leaned against the wall while waiting for the bus. 他等公車時漫不經心地靠在牆上。
"I've seen better," she said nonchalantly, looking at the expensive painting. 她看著那幅昂貴的畫作，若無其事地說：「我看過更好的。」
His nonchalantness during the crisis was mistaken for a lack of concern. 他在危機期間表現出的從容被誤解為不關心。
Despite the pressure, she maintained an air of nonchalantness throughout the game. 儘管壓力很大，她在整個比賽過程中仍保持著一種悠然自得的神態。
This new sunscreen has a nonchalky texture that blends easily into the skin. 這款新防曬乳質地不粉澀，很容易在皮膚上抹勻。
The soil in this area is nonchalky, making it suitable for growing certain flowers. 這個地區的土壤不含白堊成分，適合種植某些花卉。
As a nonchallenger, he was happy to support the current team captain. 作為一個不參與競爭的人，他很樂意支持現任隊長。
The nonchallenger in the group preferred to follow instructions rather than question them. 團體中那位不愛挑戰現狀的人，寧願聽從指令也不願提出質疑。
Even a nonchampion can show great sportsmanship during a match. 即使不是冠軍，也能在比賽中展現出極佳的運動家精神。
The club welcomes both champions and nonchampions to participate in the friendly tournament. 該俱樂部歡迎冠軍和非冠軍選手一起參加這場友誼賽。
The date for the final exam is nonchangeable once it has been announced. 期末考試的日期一旦公布就不可更改。
Most of the settings on this basic microwave are nonchangeable. 這台基礎型微波爐的大多數設定都是無法變動的。
The nonchanging rhythm of the waves helped the baby fall asleep. 海浪規律不變的節奏幫助寶寶入睡。
Despite the passing years, his nonchanging habits remained a comfort to his family. 儘管多年過去，他那始終如一的習慣仍是家人的一種慰藉。
Her angry outburst was noncharacteristic of her usually calm personality. 她憤怒的大爆發與她平時冷靜的性格完全不符。
The cold weather in July was noncharacteristic for this tropical island. 七月的寒冷天氣對於這個熱帶島嶼來說是非常罕見的。
The police released the suspect because the evidence was for a nonchargeable act. 警方釋放了嫌犯，因為證據顯示該行為不構成可起訴的罪名。
His actions were considered nonchargeable by the court due to a lack of intent. 由於缺乏意圖，他的行為被法院判定為不可指控的。
The policy of nonchastisement was intended to encourage honesty among the students. 不採取懲罰的政策是為了鼓勵學生誠實。
He was surprised by the nonchastisement he received after making a small mistake. 在犯了一個小錯誤後，他對自己沒有受到懲戒感到驚訝。
The play explores the consequences of nonchastity in a traditional society. 這齣戲探討了傳統社會中缺乏貞潔觀念所帶來的後果。
In some historical periods, nonchastity was a common theme in romantic poetry. 在某些歷史時期，不貞是浪漫詩歌中常見的主題。
We use nonchemical methods to keep pests away from our vegetable garden. 我們使用非化學的方法來防止害蟲進入菜園。
The company promotes nonchemical cleaning products that are safe for pets. 該公司推廣對寵物安全的非化學清潔產品。
The manual was written so that a nonchemist could easily understand the safety procedures. 手冊的編寫方式讓非化學專業人士也能輕鬆理解安全程序。
As a nonchemist, he found the complex formulas in the report quite confusing. 作為一名非化學家，他覺得報告中複雜的公式相當令人困惑。
His nonchivalrous behavior at the party upset many of the guests. 他在聚會上不紳士的行為讓許多客人感到不快。
Letting the elderly woman carry heavy bags alone was seen as a nonchivalrous act. 讓老婦人獨自提重物被視為一種不體貼、缺乏俠義精神的行為。
This kitchen sink features a nonchokable drain to prevent water from backing up. 這個廚房水槽配備了防堵塞的排水口，以防止積水。
The toy was designed with nonchokable parts to ensure the safety of young children. 這款玩具的零件設計成不會導致窒息的大小，以確保幼兒的安全。
He preferred using a nonchokebore shotgun for hunting at close range. 他偏好在近距離狩獵時使用無縮口槍管的散彈槍。
The gunsmith explained the difference between a chokebore and a nonchokebore barrel. 槍匠解釋了縮口槍管與無縮口槍管之間的區別。
The movie tells the story in a nonchronological order, jumping between past and present. 這部電影不按時間先後發展來敘述故事，在過去與現在之間跳躍。
I prefer organizing my files by project type rather than using a nonchronological system. 我比較喜歡依照專案類型來整理檔案，而不是採用不按時間順序的系統。
The group held their meetings in a nonchurch building to remain neutral. 該小組在非教會建築中舉行會議，以保持中立。
She works for a nonchurch organization that provides aid to refugees. 她在一家為難民提供援助的非教會組織工作。
The community center offers programs designed to reach the nonchurched population. 社區中心提供一些旨在接觸不去教堂的人群的計畫。
Many nonchurched people still enjoy singing traditional Christmas carols. 許多不去教堂的人仍然喜歡唱傳統的聖誕頌歌。

meaning: 不去教堂的人，不去教堂的人。
sentences: My neighbor is a nonchurchgoer who prefers to stay home on Sunday mornings. 我的鄰居是不去教堂的人，他週日早上更喜歡待在家裡。
As a lifelong nonchurchgoer, he rarely enters a religious building. 作為一個終生不去教堂的人，他很少進入宗教建築。
The biologist found nonciliate cells in the water sample under a microscope. 生物學家在顯微鏡下發現水樣中含有沒有纖毛的細胞。
These nonciliate organisms cannot move on their own in the fluid. 這些沒有纖毛的生物無法在液體中自行移動。
The technician replaced the noncircuit plastic cover on the electronic device. 技術員更換了電子設備上不屬於電路的塑膠蓋。
He carefully separated the metal circuit boards from the noncircuit parts. 他小心地將金屬電路板與非電路零件分開。
The power supply uses a noncircuital path for grounding the system. 電源供應器使用一條非環路路徑來讓系統接地。
Engineers checked the noncircuital wiring for any signs of heat damage. 工程師檢查了非環路佈線是否有任何受熱損壞的跡象。
I bought a noncircular rug that fits perfectly in the corner of the room. 我買了一塊非圓形的地毯，剛好可以放在房間的角落。
The child used a ruler to draw a noncircular shape on the paper. 孩子用尺在紙上畫了一個不是圓形的形狀。
Opening the window fixed the noncirculation of fresh air in the office. 打開窗戶解決了辦公室新鮮空氣不流通的問題。
The noncirculation of blood in his leg caused some swelling and pain. 他腿部血液循環不良引發了一些腫脹和疼痛。

meaning: 不是引文表格或與引文表格無關。
sentences: This section contains noncitation data that we collected through our own survey. 本節包含我們透過自行調查收集的非引用數據。
Please move all noncitation notes to the end of the technical report. 請將所有不屬於引文的筆記移到技術報告的末尾。
The local government provides essential health services for every noncitizen. 地方政府為每一位非公民提供基本的醫療服務。
As a noncitizen, he needs a valid visa to work and live in this city. 作為非公民，他在這座城市工作和生活需要有效的簽證。
They were shocked by the noncivilized conditions in the remote mountain camp. 他們對偏遠山區營地裡不文明的環境感到震驚。
His noncivilized behavior at the formal dinner table was quite embarrassing. 他在正式餐桌上不文明的行為令人感到非常尷尬。
The nonclaim of his inheritance within the time limit led to legal problems. 他在時限內未能對遺產提出索賠，導致了法律問題。
A nonclaim of insurance benefits will result in a loss for the family. 未能提出保險福利索賠將導致該家庭遭受損失。
Damage from the recent flood is nonclaimable under this specific insurance policy. 根據這項特定的保險，最近洪水造成的損害是不可索賠的。
The clerk explained that personal travel costs are nonclaimable expenses. 店員解釋說，個人的旅費是不可索賠的費用。
This rare flower species is nonclassable within existing botanical categories. 這種稀有花卉物種在現有的植物類別中無法歸類。
He wrote a nonclassable book that mixes mystery, cooking, and history. 他寫了一本融合了懸疑、烹飪與歷史，難以歸類的書。
The band plays nonclassical music using a variety of modern instruments. 該樂隊使用多種現代樂器演奏非古典音樂。
We chose a nonclassical design for our new kitchen to make it look modern. 我們為新廚房選擇了非古典風格的設計，讓它看起來很現代。
The doctor found several nonclassifiable symptoms during the physical exam. 醫生在體檢中發現了幾種無法分類的症狀。
This strange object found on the beach is nonclassifiable by current standards. 在海灘上發現的這個奇怪物體按目前的標準是無法分類的。
The nonclassification of these files caused a lot of confusion in the office. 這些文件缺乏分類，在辦公室裡造成了很大的混亂。
Due to nonclassification, the computer system could not find the specific record. 由於未經分類，電腦系統找不到該筆特定記錄。
This nonclastic material is very brittle and will break if you bend it. 這種不具有彈性的材料非常脆弱，如果你彎曲它就會斷裂。
The floor tiles are nonclastic and might crack if a heavy tool is dropped. 地磚不具有彈性，如果有重型工具掉落可能會破裂。

meaning: 沒有許可；未能清除某些東西。
sentences: The nonclearance of the drain pipe caused the kitchen sink to overflow. 排水管未能清通導致廚房水槽溢水。
The flight was delayed for hours due to the nonclearance of snow on the runway. 由於跑道上的積雪未能清除乾淨，航班延誤了數小時。
Noncleistogamic flowers must open their petals to be pollinated by insects. 非閉花受粉的花朵必須開放花瓣才能由昆蟲傳粉。
The scientist studied several noncleistogamic plant species in the garden. 科學家在花園裡研究了幾種非閉花受粉的植物物種。
The court decided that the crime was nonclergyable under the old laws. 法院判定根據舊法，這項罪行是不適用神職人員豁免權的。
He held a nonclergyable position in the local town administration. 他在當地的鎮政廳擔任一個非神職人員的職位。

meaning: 不屬於教會組織的一部分；躺著。
sentences: The organization has many nonclerical members who help with community service. 該組織有許多非教會職務的成員，協助社區服務。
He prefers to wear nonclerical clothes when he is off duty on weekends. 他週末下班後喜歡穿著非神職人員的普通衣服。
We installed a nonclimbable fence to keep the young children safe near the pool. 我們在泳池旁安裝了不可攀爬的圍欄，以確保幼童的安全。
The smooth surface of the wall is nonclimbable without using special equipment. 牆面平滑，沒有使用特殊裝備是無法攀爬的。
She works in a nonclinical role, managing the hospital's budget and records. 她擔任非臨床職務，管理醫院的預算和記錄。
The report focuses on the nonclinical costs of running a medical lab. 報告重點關注運營醫學實驗室的非臨床成本。
The two cousins have a nonclose relationship and only see each other once a year. 這兩位表親關係不親近，一年才見一次面。
Our nonclose neighbors rarely say hello when we see them on the street. 我們那些不親近的鄰居在街上見到我們時很少打招呼。
The nonclosure of the container lid caused the milk to spoil quickly. 容器蓋子沒關好導致牛奶很快就變質了。
Doctors expressed concern about the nonclosure of the deep wound on his arm. 醫生對他手臂上深層傷口無法癒合的情況表示擔憂。
The doctor used a nonclotting agent to keep the blood flowing during the test. 醫生在測試過程中使用了一種不凝結劑以保持血液流動。

The referee's nondecision during the final minutes of the game was controversial. 裁判在比賽最後幾分鐘未作判定，引發了爭議。
The customs officer directed the nondeclarant passengers to the green exit. 海關官員引導未申報乘客前往綠色通道出口。
As a nondeclarant, she did not need to submit the additional financial disclosure forms. 作為非聲明者，她不需要提交額外的財務披露表格。
The passenger faced a fine for the nondeclaration of expensive jewelry at customs. 該乘客因在海關未申報昂貴珠寶而面臨罰款。
Intentional nondeclaration of income is considered a serious legal offense. 故意未申報收入被視為嚴重的違法行為。
The tax office identified every nondeclarer of offshore bank accounts. 稅務局識別出了每一位未申報離岸銀行帳戶的人。
The nondeclarer was required to pay back taxes plus a significant penalty. 該未申報者被要求補繳稅款，並支付高額罰金。
The extremely dry air in the tomb led to the nondecomposition of the ancient scrolls. 墳墓中極其乾燥的空氣導致古代卷軸沒有分解。
Chemists studied why certain conditions lead to the nondecomposition of plastic waste. 化學家研究了為什麼某些條件會導致塑膠廢棄物不分解。
The modern office design focuses on simplicity and nondecoration. 現代辦公室設計注重簡約與不加裝飾。
He appreciated the nondecoration of the simple wooden furniture in the room. 他很欣賞房間裡簡單木製家具那種不加修飾的感覺。

meaning: 缺乏奉獻精神；未能奉獻某事。
sentences: The coach was disappointed by the nondedication shown by some of the players. 教練對部分球員表現出的缺乏奉獻精神感到失望。
The failure of the local library was blamed on the nondedication of the staff. 當地圖書館的失敗歸咎於工作人員缺乏投入。
The payroll error resulted in the nondeduction of health insurance premiums. 薪資計算錯誤導致醫療保險費未被扣除。
The policy of nondeduction for minor mistakes encouraged the workers to be honest. 對小錯誤不扣分的政策鼓勵工人們保持誠實。
The audit confirmed nondefalcation of the community funds. 經理的查帳確認了社區資金沒有被挪用。
Good accounting practices ensure nondefalcation in the office. 良好的會計實務確保了辦公室內的資金安全，沒有發生侵佔。
The reporter made sure that the article was nondefamatory and legally sound. 記者確保這篇文章不具誹謗性且在法律上站得住腳。
The judge ruled that the statements were nondefamatory expressions of opinion. 法官裁定，這些陳述是不具誹謗性的意見表達。
The landlord returned the security deposit to the nondefaulting tenant. 房東將押金退還給了沒有違約的租客。
The bank offers better loan terms to nondefaulting customers with good credit. 銀行為信用良好且無違約記錄的客戶提供更好的貸款條件。
The leader was relieved by the nondefection of his allies during the crisis. 領導人對盟友在危機期間沒有倒戈感到寬慰。
The unity of the team was proven by the nondefection of its core members. 核心成員沒有叛逃，證明了團隊的團結。
The court heard testimony from a nondefendant party who witnessed the accident. 法庭聽取了一位目睹意外的非被告方證詞。
She was listed as a nondefendant witness in the corporate lawsuit. 她在該公司訴訟中被列為非被告證人。
The city council voted to allocate more money to nondefense infrastructure projects. 市議會投票決定撥款更多資金給非國防基礎設施項目。
He works for a government agency that focuses on nondefense issues like education. 他在一個專注於教育等非國防事務的政府機構工作。
The team played a nondefensive game, focusing entirely on scoring goals. 球隊採取了非防守型的打法，全力專注於進球。
Even in a nondefensive position, the player must remain alert to the ball. 即使處於非防守位置，球員也必須對球保持警覺。
His nondeference toward the local customs offended many residents. 他對當地習俗的不尊重冒犯了許多居民。
The student's nondeference to the teacher's instructions led to a warning. 學生對老師指令的缺乏尊重導致他受到一次警告。
The student spoke in a nondeferential tone to the principal. 那位學生以不恭敬的口氣對校長說話。
His nondeferential attitude during the meeting surprised everyone. 他在會議中那種不謙恭的態度讓每個人都感到驚訝。
Their nondefiance in the face of unfair rules was disappointing to the leaders. 面對不公平的規則，他們缺乏反抗精神，這讓領導者感到失望。
The general mistook their quiet nondefiance for total agreement. 將軍誤以為他們沉默的不反抗就是完全同意。
The monk spoke about the path to nondefilement of the mind. 僧侶談到了達到心靈無雜染境界的路徑。
Scientists are working to ensure the nondefilement of the sterile laboratory environment. 科學家們正致力於確保無菌實驗室環境不受到任何污染。
She added a nondefining clause to give more details about the house. 她加入了一個非限定子句來提供更多關於這房子的細節。
In grammar, a nondefining relative clause is set off by commas. 在語法中，非限定關係子句會用逗號隔開。

meaning: 不是定義或未能正確定義的內容。
sentences: The critic argued that the statement was a nondefinition of the artistic movement. 評論家認為該陳述並非對這場藝術運動的正確定義。
His vague explanation resulted in a nondefinition of the project's main goals. 他含糊的解釋導致無法明確定義計畫的主要目標。
The initial test results were nondefinitive and required more research. 初步測試結果並不確定，還需要更多研究。
He gave a nondefinitive answer when asked if he would join the team. 當被問及是否會加入球隊時，他給出了一個不確定的回答。
The government is promoting nondeforestation policies to protect the local rainforest. 政府正在推廣不砍伐森林的政策，以保護當地的雨林。
This company only buys wood from regions where nondeforestation is strictly monitored. 這家公司只購買嚴格監控且未發生毀林現象地區的木材。
The doctor was pleased to find that the patient's condition was nondegenerate. 醫生很高興發現病人的病情沒有惡化。
The experiment focused on the nondegenerate states of the particles in the lab. 實驗專注於實驗室中微粒的不退化狀態。
The focus of the therapy is the nondegeneration of the patient's nerve cells. 治療的重點是讓病人的神經細胞不退化。
Scientists are studying why some species show nondegeneration in extreme environments. 科學家正在研究為什麼某些物種在極端環境中不會出現退化現象。
Using a nondegerming soap may not be effective during a flu outbreak. 在流感爆發期間，使用不具備殺菌功能的肥皂可能沒有效果。
The laboratory requires specialized cleaners instead of simple nondegerming solutions. 實驗室需要專門的清潔劑，而不是簡單的無殺菌作用溶液。
Environmentalists are concerned about the nondegradation of plastic waste in the ocean. 環保人士對海洋中塑膠廢棄物無法降解的情況感到擔憂。
The chemical was chosen for its nondegradation under extremely high heat. 選擇這種化學物質是因為它在極高溫下也不會降解。
The mechanic used nondegreased parts, which caused the machine to slip. 技工使用了未經脫脂處理的零件，導致機器打滑。
These nondegreased wool blankets feel much heavier than the processed ones. 這些未脫脂的羊毛毯感覺比處理過的重得多。
This type of bean is nondehiscent, meaning the pods stay closed when ripe. 這種豆類是不開裂的，這意味著豆莢成熟時會保持閉合。
Farmers prefer nondehiscent crops because they are easier to harvest without losing seeds. 農民更喜歡不開裂的作物，因為這樣收割時種子不容易掉落。

meaning: 一個不是自然神論者的人。
sentences: As a nondeist, he prefers to focus on scientific explanations for the universe. 作為一個不相信自然神論的人，他更傾向於關注宇宙的科學解釋。
The philosopher discussed the differences between a deist and a nondeist in his lecture. 哲學家在演講中討論了自然神論者與非自然神論者之間的差異。
Ensuring the safety of the workplace is a nondelegable duty of the employer. 確保工作場所的安全是雇主不可轉嫁的責任。
The judge ruled that the signing of the legal document was a nondelegable task. 法官裁定簽署該法律文件是不可委託他人代勞的任務。
Several nondelegates attended the conference just to listen to the speeches. 幾位非代表的人員參加了會議，只是為了聽演講。
The security guard asked the nondelegate to wait outside the meeting room. 保安要求那名非代表的人在會議室外等候。
His nondelegation of tasks led to a huge workload for himself. 他拒絕授權任務，導致自己承擔了巨大的工作量。
The manager’s nondelegation of power frustrated the junior staff. 經理不願下放權力的做法讓基層員工感到挫折。
The test confirmed that the chemical had a nondeleterious effect on the crops. 測試證實該化學物質對農作物無害。
Parents were relieved to hear that the toy's paint was nondeleterious to children. 父母們聽說玩具的油漆對孩子無害，都感到鬆了一口氣。
The mistake was nondeliberate and was corrected as soon as it was found. 這個錯誤並非故意的，一經發現就立即糾正了。
She apologized for her nondeliberate rudeness during the stressful meeting. 她為自己在壓力巨大的會議中無意間表現出的粗魯行為道歉。
The manager's nondeliberation in making the decision led to many problems later on. 經理在做決定時缺乏深思熟慮，導致後來出現許多問題。
Buying a car after only one day of searching showed a certain nondeliberation. 只找了一天就買車，顯示出某種程度的欠缺考慮。
The artist used soft colors that resulted in a nondelineation of shapes in the painting. 藝術家使用了柔和的顏色，導致畫中的形狀缺乏清晰的輪廓。
The foggy weather caused a nondelineation of the mountain range in the distance. 霧茫茫的天氣使得遠處的山脈輪廓模糊不清。
This salt is nondeliquescent, so it stays dry even in humid weather. 這種鹽不會潮解，所以即使在潮濕的天氣裡也能保持乾燥。
The laboratory stores crystals that are nondeliquescent in airtight jars. 實驗室將不會潮解的晶體儲存在密封罐中。
Even with a high fever, the child remained nondelirious and could talk to his parents. 即使發高燒，孩子神智依然清醒，還能跟父母說話。
The nurse noted that the patient was nondelirious and followed all instructions. 護理師記錄下病患神智清楚，並配合所有指示。
The nondeliverance of the legal documents delayed the start of the trial. 法律文件未能交付，延誤了審判的開始。
We were concerned about the nondeliverance of the equipment required for the project. 我們對專案所需的設備未能按時交貨感到擔憂。
You should contact the seller if there is a nondelivery of your package. 如果包裹未能送達，你應該聯繫賣家。
The company apologized for the nondelivery of the newspapers due to the heavy snow. 公司為因大雪導致報紙未能送達而道歉。

meaning: 不是需求或與需求無關。
sentences: The report focuses on nondemand factors like supply chain efficiency. 報告重點關注供應鏈效率等與需求無關的因素。
He studied nondemand variables that might affect the price of gold. 他研究了可能影響金價的非需求變項。

meaning: 缺乏死亡；未正式轉讓所有權。
sentences: The contract guarantees the nondemise of the family land to third parties. 合約保證家族土地不會轉讓給第三方。
There was a sense of relief at the nondemise of the legendary company during the crisis. 危機期間這家傳奇公司並未走入歷史，眾人都感到如釋重負。
The peace talks failed because of the nondemobilization of the local militia. 由於當地民兵未能復員，和平談判宣告失敗。
Citizens protested the nondemobilization of the army after the conflict ended. 衝突結束後，公民抗議軍隊遲遲未能復員。
Some citizens were unhappy with the nondemocratic decision made by the council. 一些市民對議會做出的非民主決策感到不滿。
The group protested against the nondemocratic rules of the organization. 該團體抗議該組織不符合民主原則的規章。

meaning: 不採取行動或充當示範。
sentences: The scientist chose a nondemonstration method to avoid influencing the test results. 科學家選擇了一種不進行示範的方法，以免影響測試結果。
The nondemonstration of the new features left the audience confused. 新功能未能現場展示，讓觀眾感到困惑。
The lab results showed that the cells had nondendroid shapes. 實驗室結果顯示，這些細胞不具備樹枝狀的外型。
This species is nondendroid and looks more like a flat moss. 這個物種並非樹狀，看起來更像扁平的苔蘚。

meaning: 不是否認的（可能是迴避的）陳述。
sentences: The celebrity's nondenial of the rumors fueled more gossip in the media. 那位名人並未否認傳聞，這引發了媒體更多流言蜚語。
His nondenial was seen as an admission of guilt by the public. 他的不否認被大眾視為承認有罪。

meaning: 沒有宗派；不特定於特定宗教或教派。
sentences: They held a nondenominational service that people of all faiths could attend. 他們舉行了一場不分教派的儀式，讓各種信仰的人都能參加。
The hospital has a nondenominational chapel for patients and their families. 醫院設有一間不限教派的小教堂，供病患及其家屬使用。
The school promotes nondenominationalism to respect the diversity of its students. 學校推崇非宗派主義，以尊重學生的多樣性。
Many modern weddings embrace nondenominationalism to focus on the couple's personal story. 許多現代婚禮採納非宗派主義，以將重點放在新人的個人故事上。
The bird preferred to nest in the nondense areas of the forest. 這種鳥偏好在森林中不茂密的地方築巢。
Using a nondense brush makes it easier to clean the small gaps. 使用不濃密的刷子更容易清潔微小的縫隙。
The professor explained that the set of all real numbers is nondenumerable. 教授解釋說，所有實數的集合是不可數的。
Students struggled to understand the concept of nondenumerable infinity. 學生們很難理解不可數無窮大的概念。
The politician's nondenunciation of the scandal was criticized by the media. 那位政治人物未對醜聞發表譴責，遭到了媒體的批評。
Silence can sometimes be seen as a nondenunciation of wrong behavior. 沉默有時會被視為對錯誤行為的默許而非譴責。

meaning: 與特定部門或學科無關。
sentences: The university offers nondepartmental courses that cover several different fields. 大學提供不屬於特定學系的課程，涵蓋了數個不同的領域。
She applied for a nondepartmental grant that supports interdisciplinary research. 她申請了一項支持跨學科研究的非系所專屬補助金。
The nondeparture of the train was caused by a technical fault on the tracks. 火車未能如期出發是由於軌道技術故障造成的。
Travelers were frustrated by the nondeparture of their flight during the storm. 暴風雨期間班機未能起飛，讓旅客感到非常沮喪。
The young man worked hard to achieve financial nondependence. 那個年輕人努力工作以實現經濟自主。
We are aiming for energy nondependence by using solar power. 我們的目標是透過使用太陽能來達成能源自給自足。
The new software is nondependent on any specific operating system. 這款新軟體不依賴任何特定的作業系統。
She wants to be financially nondependent and pay for her own expenses. 她希望能達成經濟獨立，自行負擔個人支出。
Sustainable farming ensures the nondepletion of soil nutrients over time. 永續耕作能確保土壤養分隨著時間推移也不會耗盡。
The engineers monitored the nondepletion of the battery during the long flight. 工程師們在長途飛行中監控電池，確保電力不會耗盡。

meaning: 沒有被驅逐出境；未能驅逐出境。
sentences: The court ruled for the nondeportation of the witness for safety reasons. 出於安全考量，法院裁定不將該證人驅逐出境。
The policy of nondeportation helped many families stay together. 不驅逐出境的政策幫助了許多家庭團聚。
The nondeported families were given a chance to apply for residency. 未被驅逐出境的家庭獲得了申請居留權的機會。
He felt lucky to be nondeported after the legal review was finished. 在法律審查結束後，他對自己未被驅逐出境感到很幸運。

meaning: 不存款的行為；缺乏沉積。
sentences: The nondeposition of the required funds led to the cancellation of the order. 由於未存入所需資金，訂單被取消了。
The geologist noted the nondeposition of layers in this part of the cliff. 地質學家注意到懸崖的這個部分沒有地層沉積。
The bank charges a fee for any nondepositor who uses their services. 銀行對任何使用其服務的非存款戶收取手續費。
As a nondepositor, he had to pay a small fee to use the local ATM. 作為一名非該行客戶，他必須支付小額手續費才能使用當地的自動提款機。
The monk lived a life of nondepravity and strictly followed the religious rules. 這位僧侶過著不墮落的生活，並嚴格遵守宗教戒律。
His character was defined by a sense of nondepravity that everyone in the office admired. 他的品格以一種不墮落的正直感為特徵，辦公室的每個人都很佩服。
Gold is considered a nondepreciating asset during times of global economic crisis. 黃金在全經濟危機時期被視為一種不會貶值的資產。
Some rare coins are nondepreciating and even increase in value over time. 某些稀有硬幣不會貶值，甚至會隨著時間增加價值。
The doctor compared the brain activity of depressed and nondepressed patients. 醫生比較了憂鬱症患者與非憂鬱症患者的腦部活動。
She felt lucky to be in a nondepressed state after such a difficult week at work. 在工作如此艱難的一週後，她覺得自己還能保持心情不悶悶不樂是很幸運的。
The doctor explained the role of nondepression during the consultation. 醫師說明時會提到這個部位或概念的作用。
The training diagram labels nondepression beside the related anatomy. 教學圖示也可能把這個名稱標在相關解剖部位旁邊。
Human rights are considered nondeprivable even in times of national emergency. 人權被認為是不可剝奪的，即使在國家緊急狀態下也是如此。
The citizen fought to protect his nondeprivable right to express his opinions. 這位公民為了守護他不可被剝奪的意見表達權而奮鬥。
Older sources sometimes write nonderivable as an alternative form of non-derivable. 較早的資料有時會使用這個變體拼法。
Editors kept nonderivable in the word bank so readers can recognize that variant spelling. 這筆資料保留下來，是為了讓讀者辨認這種變體拼法。
The company prefers to invest in nonderivative assets like physical real estate. 這家公司偏好投資實體房地產等非衍生性資產。
The linguist studied nonderivative words that do not come from other stems. 語言學家研究了那些並非由其他詞幹衍生出的非派生詞。
It is important to use nonderogatory language when discussing sensitive topics. 討論敏感話題時，使用非貶低性的語言非常重要。
The teacher corrected the student and suggested a more nonderogatory term to use. 老師糾正了學生，並建議使用一個更不具貶義的詞彙。

meaning: 沒有描述（在學術文獻中）。
sentences: The biologist found a nondescript plant species deep in the tropical forest. 生物學家在熱帶雨林深處發現了一種尚未被描述的植物物種。
The scientific paper mentioned several nondescript minerals found at the site. 這篇科學論文提到了在該遺址發現的幾種未經描述的礦物。
The local community celebrated the nondesecration of the ancient temple. 當地社區慶祝這座古老寺廟免遭褻瀆。
Strict security measures ensured the nondesecration of the national monument. 嚴格的安全措施確保了國家紀念碑不受到任何褻瀆。
The area remained nondesignate for parking until the signs were put up. 在標誌立起來之前，該區域一直未被指定為停車區。
Visitors should not enter nondesignate rooms in the laboratory. 訪客不應進入實驗室中未指定的房間。
The pattern on the stone was a nondesigned result of natural erosion. 石頭上的圖案是自然侵蝕下非刻意設計的結果。
Scientists studied the nondesigned structures formed by cooling volcanic lava. 科學家研究了冷卻火山岩漿形成的非人工設計結構。
He practiced meditation every morning to reach a state of complete nondesire. 他每天早晨練習冥想，以達到完全無欲無求的境界。
Her nondesire for fame and fortune made her a very grounded person. 她對名聲和財富的淡泊，讓她成為一個非常踏實的人。
The monk remained nondesirous of material wealth throughout his entire life. 這位僧侶一生都對物質財富無所渴求。
She was nondesirous of a promotion because she truly loved her current role. 她並不渴望晉升，因為她真心喜歡目前的職位。
The nondesisting noise from the construction site kept us awake. 工地持續不斷的噪音讓我們無法入睡。
Despite the warnings, his nondesisting efforts finally paid off. 儘管有警告，他不肯罷休的努力最終得到了回報。
The country flourished under a nondespotic and fair government system. 這個國家在一個不專制且公平的政府體制下繁榮昌盛。
He was known for his nondespotic leadership style while managing the office. 他在管理辦公室時以不專橫的領導風格而聞名。
The nurse noted in the chart that the patient's skin rash was nondesquamative. 護理師在病歷中記錄了病人的皮疹並未出現脫屑現象。
This specific skin condition is usually nondesquamative but can be quite itchy. 這種特定的皮膚狀況通常不會脫皮，但可能會非常癢。

meaning: 這不會導致破壞或損壞。
sentences: Engineers used nondestructive testing to check the bridge for internal cracks. 工程師使用非破壞性檢測來檢查橋樑是否有內部裂縫。
The museum uses nondestructive methods to analyze the composition of ancient pottery. 博物館使用不具破壞性的方法來分析古代陶器的成分。
The factory was fined for burning nondesulphurized coal in its boilers. 該工廠因在鍋爐中燃燒未脫硫的煤炭而被罰款。
Using nondesulphurized fuel in ships can cause significant air pollution. 在船隻中使用未脫硫的燃料會造成嚴重的空氣污染。
The travel suitcase comes with a nondetachable shoulder strap for convenience. 為了方便起見，這款旅行行李箱附帶一條不可拆卸的肩帶。
For safety reasons, the power cord on this kitchen appliance is nondetachable. 出於安全考量，這款廚房電器的電源線是不可拆除的。
The report provided only a nondetailed summary of the long meeting. 報告僅提供了那場冗長會議的一個不詳細摘要。
He gave a nondetailed map of the forest to the lost hikers. 他給了迷路的登山客一張並不詳盡的森林地圖。
The lawyer argued for the nondetention of the suspect before the trial started. 律師在審判開始前，爭取不扣押該名嫌疑人。
The policy of nondetention was applied to many non-violent first-time offenders. 針對許多非暴力的初犯者實施了不予拘留的政策。
His nondetermination led to many missed opportunities in his early career. 他的優柔寡斷導致他在早期職業生涯中錯失了許多機會。
The project failed due to the team's nondetermination to finish the tasks on time. 由於團隊缺乏按時完成任務的決心，該項目失敗了。

meaning: 一個不是決定論者的人。
sentences: As a nondeterminist, he believes that people have the free will to choose. 作為一名非決定論者，他相信人類擁有選擇的自由意志。
The philosopher debated with both determinists and nondeterminists at the conference. 這位哲學家在會議上與決定論者和非決定論者都進行過辯論。
The low fines proved to be a nondeterrent to the large chemical companies. 事實證明，低額罰款對大型化工公司沒有威懾作用。
Many experts argue that the current law is nondeterrent to potential criminals. 許多專家認為，目前的法律對潛在的犯罪分子沒有阻嚇作用。
The boy’s nondetest of vegetables made mealtime very easy. 那個男孩並不討厭蔬菜，這讓用餐時間變得很輕鬆。
His nondetest of the rainy weather was a surprise to his friends. 他並不討厭下雨天的態度讓他的朋友們感到意外。
The demolition crew used nondetonating chemicals to crack the concrete safely. 拆除小組使用不會引爆的化學物質來安全地破開混凝土。
These nondetonating materials are safer to store in a standard warehouse. 這些不引爆的材料存放在普通倉庫中比較安全。
Regular exercise has a nondetrimental effect on your joints if done correctly. 如果方式正確，規律運動對關節是無害的。
The minor software bug was nondetrimental to the overall system performance. 這個小軟體錯誤對系統整體效能是無害的。
The steep hillside is classified as nondevelopable land by the city council. 市議會將這片陡峭的山坡歸類為不可開發土地。
Because of environmental protections, the marsh remains nondevelopable. 由於環境保護，這片沼澤地仍然不可開發。
The nondevelopment of the local library led to complaints from the residents. 當地圖書館缺乏發展，引發了居民的抱怨。
Years of nondevelopment have left the rural village without modern infrastructure. 多年的缺乏發展使得這個偏遠村莊沒有現代化的基礎設施。

meaning: 缺乏偏差；未能偏離某事。
sentences: The pilot's nondeviation from the flight path ensured a safe landing. 飛行員沒有偏離航線，確保了飛機安全降落。
Strict nondeviation from the experiment protocol is necessary for accurate results. 實驗結果要準確，必須嚴格遵守協議，不得有任何偏差。
The class studied the Bible from a nondevotional and historical perspective. 這門課從非虔誠且歷史的角度來研究聖經。
He enjoys visiting old churches for their nondevotional architectural beauty. 他喜歡參觀古老教堂，是為了欣賞其建築美感而非出於宗教虔誠。
The worker was nondexterous and struggled to assemble the tiny mechanical parts. 那個工人手不靈巧，在組裝微小的零件時感到很吃力。
Wearing thick gloves makes even a skilled person feel nondexterous. 戴上厚手套會讓即使手巧的人也感到不靈巧。
Doctors compared the blood samples of diabetic patients with those of nondiabetic volunteers. 醫生將糖尿病患者的血樣與非糖尿病志願者的血樣進行了比較。
This sugar-free snack is suitable for both diabetic and nondiabetic individuals. 這種無糖零食適合糖尿病患者和非糖尿病人士食用。
Despite his scary appearance, the neighbor turned out to be a nondiabolic and kind man. 儘管鄰居外表嚇人，但結果證明他不是個惡魔，而是一個善良的人。
The story portrays the character as a nondiabolic figure who made a simple mistake. 故事將這個角色塑造成一個犯了簡單錯誤而非邪惡的人。
The nondiagnosis of his condition led to months of unnecessary pain. 由於缺乏診斷，他的病情導致了數月不必要的痛苦。
A quick screening can prevent the nondiagnosis of common respiratory illnesses. 快速篩檢可以防止對常見呼吸道疾病缺乏診斷的情況。
Please place the tiles in a nondiagonal pattern to keep the floor looking simple. 請以非對角線的圖案鋪設磁磚，讓地板看起來簡潔一些。
The computer screen showed several nondiagonal lines crossing each other. 電腦螢幕上顯示了幾條互相交錯的非對角線。
The artist preferred a nondiagrammatic style that focused on emotion rather than structure. 這位藝術家偏好非圖解式的風格，著重於情感而非結構。
The manual's nondiagrammatic explanations were difficult for the novice to follow. 手冊中沒有圖解的說明讓新手很難遵循。
The news anchor used a nondialectal form of the language for clarity. 為了清晰起見，新聞主播使用了非方言的語言形式。
Teachers encourage students to use nondialectal grammar in their formal essays. 老師鼓勵學生在正式論文中使用非方言的語法。
The professor criticized the essay for its nondialectical approach to complex social issues. 教授批評這篇論文對複雜的社會問題採用了非辯證的方法。
Her logic was nondialectical and failed to account for opposing viewpoints. 她的邏輯不具辯證性，沒能考慮到相反的觀點。
The lab tested a nondialyzing membrane to see if it could filter the toxins. 實驗室測試了一種不透析的薄膜，看它是否能過濾毒素。
In this specific medical procedure, a nondialyzing solution is required. 在這個特定的醫療程序中，需要一種不透析的溶液。
The engineer measured several nondiametral points on the circular base. 工程師測量了圓形底座上幾個非直徑的點。
Moving the sensor to a nondiametral position might yield different results. 將感應器移動到非直徑位置可能會產生不同的結果。

meaning: 不糖化。具體來說，就是水解酶已失活的麥芽穀物。
sentences: Bakers use nondiastatic malt powder to add flavor to bread without affecting the rise. 烘焙師使用不糖化的麥芽粉來增加麵包的風味，而不會影響發酵。
This recipe calls for nondiastatic malt syrup for a subtle sweetness. 這個食譜要求使用不糖化的麥芽糖漿以獲得微弱的甜味。
The research team studied nondiathermanous substances that block heat radiation. 研究團隊研究了能阻擋熱輻射的不透熱物質。
This nondiathermanous glass helps keep the building cool during the summer. 這種不透熱的玻璃有助於在夏天保持建築物涼爽。
The chemist discovered that the new compound was nondiazotizable under standard conditions. 化學家發現這種新化合物在標準條件下不可重氮化。
These pigments are nondiazotizable and remain stable during the dyeing process. 這些顏料不可重氮化，在染色過程中保持穩定。
In nondichogamous flowers, the pollen and the stigma mature at the same time. 在非雌雄同熟的花朵中，花粉和柱頭在相同的時間成熟。
Farmers prefer nondichogamous crops for easier self-pollination. 農民偏好非雌雄同熟的作物，以便於自花授粉。
The study focuses on nondichogamy in certain tropical plant species. 這項研究著重於某些熱帶植物物種中的雌雄同熟現象。
Nondichogamy ensures that the plant can produce seeds even without insects. 雌雄同熟確保了植物即使在沒有昆蟲的情況下也能產生種子。
The survey used nondichotomous questions to allow for more nuanced answers. 該調查使用了非二分法的問題，以便收集更細緻的答案。
Life choices are often nondichotomous and involve many different possibilities. 人生的選擇通常不是二分法的，而是涉及許多不同的可能性。
The manager's style of nondictation encouraged employees to share their own ideas. 經理不發號施令的風格鼓勵了員工分享自己的想法。
The treaty ensures the nondictation of terms by any single nation. 該條約確保了任何單一國家都不能強行加註條款。
The new leader promised a nondictatorial government that respects civil rights. 新領導人承諾建立一個尊重民權的非獨裁政府。
She appreciated his nondictatorial tone during the group discussion. 她很欣賞他在小組討論中那種非獨裁的語氣。

meaning: 不屬於、不屬於或不存在於字典中。
sentences: The report uses nondictionary to describe a related feature. 報告用這個詞來描述某種相關特徵。
Readers may encounter nondictionary in descriptive or specialist writing. 讀者可能會在描述性或專業文本中看到這個詞。
The professor's lecture style is nondidactic and encourages discussion. 這位教授的授課風格並非說教式，而是鼓勵學生討論。
The movie is nondidactic, letting viewers reach their own conclusions. 這部電影不帶說教意味，讓觀眾自行得出結論。
She follows a nondieting approach to health, focusing on balanced meals. 她採行非節食的健康方式，專注於均衡飲食。
The study compared a dieting group with a nondieting control group. 這項研究比較了節食組與非節食的對照組。
The nondifferentation of cells at this stage is normal. 細胞在此階段不具差異性是正常的。
The product's nondifferentation from its competitors made it hard to sell. 該產品與競爭對手缺乏區別，使其難以銷售。
The report uses nondifferentiable to describe a related feature. 報告用這個詞來描述某種相關特徵。
Readers may encounter nondifferentiable in descriptive or specialist writing. 讀者可能會在描述性或專業文本中看到這個詞。
This special lens is designed to be nondiffractive for clearer images. 這款特殊鏡片設計為不產生繞射，以提供更清晰的影像。
Scientists are testing a nondiffractive laser beam in the lab. 科學家正在實驗室測試一種不發生繞射的雷射光束。
The chemist used a nondiffusing liquid for the experiment. 化學家在實驗中使用了一種不擴散的液體。
This ink is nondiffusing, so it won't blur on the paper. 這種墨水不會擴散，所以不會在紙上化開。
Her stomach pain was caused by the nondigestion of certain proteins. 她的胃痛是由於無法消化某些蛋白質引起的。
The doctor explained that nondigestion can lead to a lack of nutrients. 醫生解釋說，消化不良可能導致營養缺乏。
The surgeon found that the artery was nondilatable during the procedure. 外科醫生在手術中發現這條動脈無法擴張。
This material is nondilatable and maintains its shape under heat. 這種材料不可膨脹，在受熱時仍能保持形狀。
The recipe requires the nondilution of the sauce to keep its flavor. 這份食譜要求醬汁不可稀釋，以保持其風味。
Scientists observed the nondilution of chemicals in the cold water. 科學家觀察到化學物質在冷水中未被稀釋的現象。
He works for a nondiocesan organization that helps the poor. 他在一家非教區所屬的組織工作，幫助窮人。
The school is nondiocesan and welcomes students of all faiths. 這所學校不隸屬於教區，歡迎所有信仰的學生。
The test confirmed that the sore throat was nondiphtheritic. 檢驗確認這次喉嚨痛並非由白喉引起。
The doctor treated the child for a nondiphtheritic infection. 醫生為孩子治療了一種非白喉性的感染。
The linguist analyzed the nondiphthongal vowel sounds in the dialect. 語言學家分析了該方言中的非雙元音。
Some words in this language use a nondiphthongal pronunciation. 這種語言中的某些單詞使用非雙元音的發音。
His nondiplomatic comments offended many guests at the party. 他那些不委婉的評論冒犯了派對上的許多客人。
She gave a nondiplomatic answer when asked about her boss. 當被問及她的老闆時，她給了一個非常直接且不委婉的回答。
This insect is nondipterous, meaning it has four wings instead of two. 這種昆蟲不是雙翅類的，這意味著它有四隻翅膀而非兩隻。
The biology student studied the characteristics of nondipterous bugs. 生物系學生研究了非雙翅類昆蟲的特徵。
The project suffered from a complete nondirection of leadership. 該專案因為領導層完全缺乏方向而受阻。
He felt a sense of nondirection after quitting his long-term job. 辭掉那份做了很久的工作後，他感到失去了生活目標。
The antenna provides a nondirectional signal that covers the whole area. 天線提供無方向性的信號，覆蓋了整個區域。
The microphone is nondirectional and picks up sound from all sides. 這款麥克風是無方向性的，可以收錄來自四面八方的聲音。
There was a general nondisagreement among the board members. 董事會成員之間普遍沒有異議。
Her silence was taken as a sign of nondisagreement with the plan. 她的沉默被視為對該計畫沒有不同意見的跡象。

meaning: 是那種不是消失的砲車。
sentences: The fort was equipped with a nondisappearing carriage for the heavy gun. 要塞配備了不可消失式的砲架，用來支撐重型火砲。
Unlike modern tanks, old cannons often used nondisappearing mounts. 與現代坦克不同，舊式火砲通常使用非隱藏式的砲座。

meaning: 沒有解除武裝；未能解除武裝。
sentences: The treaty failed because of the nondisarmament of several nations. 由於幾個國家未能解除武裝，該條約宣告失敗。
Nondisarmament remains a major concern for global peace. 未能解除武裝仍是全球和平的一個主要隱憂。
The bank will hold the nondisbursed funds until the project starts. 銀行將保留這筆未支付的資金，直到專案啟動。
Please check the report for any nondisbursed amounts from last year. 請檢查報告中去年是否有任何未支出的款項。
His nondiscernment of the risks led to a big financial loss. 他對風險缺乏辨別力，導致了重大的財務損失。
The child's nondiscernment between right and wrong is expected at this age. 孩子在這個年紀無法辨別是非是預料之中的事。
The battery is nondischarging because it is disconnected. 因為電源已斷開，這顆電池目前不放電。
Engineers designed a nondischarging circuit for the safety device. 工程師為這項安全裝置設計了一種不放電的電路。

meaning: 不遵守紀律；與懲罰無關或不以懲罰為目的。
sentences: The supervisor's meeting with the staff was nondisciplinary and aimed at improvement. 主管與員工的會議與懲戒無關，旨在尋求改進。
The teacher noticed the nondisciplinary behavior of the children during lunch. 老師注意到孩子們午餐時不守紀律的行為。
The company’s nondisclaim of the warranty reassured the customers. 公司沒有拒絕承認保固責任的態度讓客戶感到安心。
His nondisclaim of the ownership rights ended the family legal battle. 他沒有放棄所有權的決定結束了家族的法律糾紛。
Both parties signed a nondisclosure agreement before the meeting. 雙方在會議前都簽署了保密協議。
The company was sued for its nondisclosure of the product's defects. 該公司因未揭露產品缺陷而被起訴。

meaning: 沒有中斷；未能停止某事。
sentences: The nondiscontinuance of the project surprised the team. 專案沒有中斷，讓團隊感到驚訝。
We were concerned about the nondiscontinuance of the noise throughout the night. 我們很擔心噪音整晚都沒停下來。
Their opinions on the matter were nondiscordant. 他們對這件事的意見並不衝突。
The colors in the room are nondiscordant and create a peaceful atmosphere. 房間裡的顏色很和諧，營造出寧靜的氣氛。
These luxury items are nondiscountable even during the sale. 這些奢侈品即使在促銷期間也不打折。
The membership fee is nondiscountable and must be paid in full. 會費不能減免，必須全額繳納。
The nondiscovery of the missing files delayed the investigation. 沒能找到失蹤的檔案，使調查延遲。
Scientists were frustrated by the nondiscovery of water on the planet. 科學家因為沒能在該行星上發現水而感到沮喪。
Rent is a nondiscretionary expense that must be paid every month. 房租是每個月必須支付的固定開銷。
The rules for safety are nondiscretionary for all employees. 安全守則對所有員工來說都是強制性的。

meaning: 不參與歧視的行為或政策。
sentences: Our company has a strict policy of nondiscrimination in hiring. 我們公司在招聘時有嚴格的不歧視政策。
Nondiscrimination is essential for a fair workplace. 職場公平必須落實不歧視。

meaning: 不歧視；不影響或導致歧視。
sentences: The new law ensures nondiscriminatory access to healthcare. 新法律確保大眾能公平地獲得醫療服務。
We use nondiscriminatory tests to evaluate all applicants. 我們使用公平的測試來評估所有應徵者。

meaning: 討論毫無結果，就等於沒有討論過。
sentences: Their meeting ended in nondiscussion as neither side would speak. 他們的會議最後毫無結果，跟沒討論過一樣。
The nondiscussion of the core problem led to further confusion. 核心問題沒被拿出來討論，導致了更多的困惑。
The nondisestablishment of the old system preserved many traditions. 舊體制的存續保留了許多傳統習俗。
Some citizens argued for the nondisestablishment of the local council. 一些公民主張不應撤銷地方議會。
The surgery was a success, resulting in nondisfigurement of the patient's face. 手術很成功，病人的臉部沒有留下損傷。
We hope for the nondisfigurement of the landscape after the construction. 我們希望施工結束後，當地的景觀不會遭到破壞。
Every nondisfranchised citizen is encouraged to vote. 每一位擁有權利的公民都被鼓勵去投票。
The nondisfranchised workers demanded better working conditions. 這些享有基本權益的工人們要求更好的工作條件。
Her apology seemed nondisingenuous and was accepted by the group. 她的道歉看起來很真誠，因此得到了大家的接受。
He gave a nondisingenuous answer to the manager's question. 他對經理的問題給出了坦誠的回答。
The nondisintegration of the old bridge after the storm was a relief. 暴風雨後老橋沒有崩塌，讓人鬆了一口氣。
Proper storage ensures the nondisintegration of these chemicals. 適當的存放可以確保這些化學物質不會分解。
Since he owns shares in the company, he is a nondisinterested party. 既然他持有公司的股份，他就是有利益關係的一方。
Her nondisinterested advice made me question her motives. 她那帶有偏見的建議讓我懷疑她的動機。
The nondisjunct parts of the machine must be oiled regularly. 機器相連的部分必須定期上油。
These nondisjunct areas of the forest are home to many animals. 森林中這些相連的區域是許多動物的家。

meaning: 減數分裂或有絲分裂期間染色體二分體或四分體未能正確分離。
sentences: Nondisjunction during cell division can lead to genetic disorders. 細胞分裂過程中的染色體不分離現象可能會導致遺傳疾病。
Doctors explained that nondisjunction was the cause of the condition. 醫生解釋說，染色體未正確分離是導致該狀況的原因。
The nondisjunctional event happened early in the development. 染色體不分離的現象發生在發育早期。
Research focuses on nondisjunctional errors in older cells. 研究重點在於較老細胞中與染色體不分離相關的錯誤。
The report described the nondisjunctive nature of the process. 報告描述了該過程不分離的特性。
We observed nondisjunctive behavior in the experiment. 我們在實驗中觀察到了不分離的行為。
The policy guarantees nondismemberment of the organization's assets. 這項政策保證了組織資產的完整性。
Nondismemberment of the team is crucial for finishing the task on time. 團隊不解體對於準時完成任務至關重要。

meaning: 沒有被解僱的情況；未能解僱。
sentences: The nondismissal of the lazy employee upset the rest of the staff. 沒把那個懶惰的員工開除，讓其他員工很不滿。
His nondismissal was due to a lack of evidence. 因為證據不足，他才沒有被解僱。
Please try to use nondisparaging language during the debate. 辯論期間請儘量使用不帶貶義的言語。
Her nondisparaging remarks helped keep the meeting professional. 她那不具攻擊性的言論有助於保持會議的專業性。
The two groups showed nondisparate results in the test. 這兩個小組在測試中顯示出了相似的結果。
These nondisparate views helped the committee reach a quick decision. 這些並不分歧的觀點幫助委員會快速做出了決定。
The nondispensation of the medicine caused the patient's condition to worsen. 藥物沒能配發，導致病人的病情惡化。
Due to the nondispensation of funds, the project was put on hold. 由於資金未能撥發，專案被暫停了。

meaning: 不存在分散現象；未能驅散。
sentences: The nondispersal of the crowd led to several arrests. 群眾沒有散去，導致幾個人被逮捕。
The nondispersal of seeds prevents the plant from spreading. 種子沒有散播出去，阻止了植物的蔓延。
High-quality lenses are designed to achieve nondispersion of light for clearer images. 高品質鏡頭的設計旨在防止光線色散，使影像更清晰。
The experiment showed a nondispersion of sound waves in the vacuum chamber. 實驗顯示聲波在真空室中沒有發生色散現象。
The company signed a contract regarding the nondisposal of toxic waste in the ocean. 公司簽署了一份關於禁止將有毒廢棄物排入海洋的合約。
Investors were concerned about the nondisposal of old assets before the merger. 投資者擔心合併前舊資產未能及時處理。
The athlete was relieved to hear that the minor injury was nondisqualifying. 運動員聽說這點輕傷不會讓他失去參賽資格，感到鬆了一口氣。
A small mistake on the application form was considered nondisqualifying by the office. 辦公室認為申請表上的一個小錯誤不至於導致取消資格。
The board members reached a nondissenting vote on the new safety rules. 董事會成員對新的安全規定達成了無異議的投票結果。
Employees remained nondissenting during the announcement of the holiday schedule. 在宣布假期安排時，員工們都沒有表示異議。
The scientist explained the nondissolution of the salt in the cold liquid. 科學家解釋了鹽在冷液體中沒有溶解的原因。
Both parties agreed on the nondissolution of their partnership for the next three years. 雙方同意在未來三年內不解散他們的合夥關係。
We plan to spend our summer vacation in a nondistant mountain resort. 我們計劃在不遠處的山區度假村度過暑假。
The grocery store is in a nondistant location, so I usually walk there. 雜貨店就在附近，所以我通常走路過去。
The plain white building was nondistinctive and easy to miss. 那棟純白的建築沒有特色，很容易被遺漏。
He wore a nondistinctive gray suit to the job interview. 他穿了一套沒什麼特色的灰色西裝去參加工作面試。
This microphone is famous for the nondistortion of sound even at high volumes. 這款麥克風以在高音量下聲音也不會失真而聞名。
The special glass ensures the nondistortion of colors in the photograph. 特種玻璃確保了照片中的顏色不會發生偏差。
The nondistribution of food supplies led to protests in the city center. 糧食供應未能分配引發了市中心的抗議活動。
The judge ordered the nondistribution of the company's funds during the trial. 法官下令在審判期間不得分配公司資金。
The math student struggled to understand why some operations are nondistributive. 這個數學系的學生很難理解為什麼某些運算不具備分配性質。
The association maintains a nondistributive policy for its annual surplus. 該協會對其年度盈餘採取不分配的政策。

meaning: 不打擾住宅內租戶的協議。
sentences: The bank required a nondisturbance agreement to protect the shop owners. 銀行要求簽署一份不干擾協議，以保護店主的權益。
The landlord promised a nondisturbance clause in the new lease agreement. 房東承諾在新的租賃合約中加入不得干擾的條款。
The scientists were surprised by the nondivergence of the two data sets. 科學家對這兩組數據沒有出現分歧感到驚訝。
The teacher focused on the nondivergence of the light rays in the experiment. 老師在實驗中專注於光線不發散的現象。
The engineer adjusted the antenna to ensure a nondivergent signal beam. 工程師調整了天線，以確保信號波束不會發散。
This mathematical series is nondivergent and settles at a specific value. 這個數學級數是不發散的，並穩定在一個特定的數值上。
The nondiversification of their investments made the family vulnerable to the crash. 他們的投資缺乏多元化，使得這個家庭在金融崩潰中顯得脆弱。
Farmers were concerned that the nondiversification of crops would damage the soil. 農民擔心作物種類過於單一會損害土壤。
The lecture discussed the nondivinity of ancient kings in historical records. 講座討論了歷史記錄中古代國王的非神聖屬性。
Some people find comfort in the nondivinity and pure humanity of historical figures. 有些人從歷史人物的平凡人性而非神性中獲得慰藉。
The company shares are nondivisible and must be sold as a single block. 公司股份是不可分割的，必須整塊出售。
The land was declared nondivisible to prevent it from being broken into small pieces. 這塊土地被宣佈為不可分割，以防止被切成碎片。
The nondivisiblity of the family farm prevented it from being sold in parts. 這座家族農場的不可分割性使得它無法被分塊出售。
Lawyers argued over the nondivisiblity of the shared assets. 律師們就共同資產的不可分割性展開了辯論。

meaning: 不屬於或不屬於某個部門。
sentences: The staff held a nondivision meeting to talk about the company's general goals. 員工們召開了一場不分部門的會議，討論公司的總體目標。
He was chosen for a nondivision task force to handle the emergency. 他被選入一個非部門專責小組來處理緊急情況。
The school organized several nondivisional sports events for all students. 學校為所有學生組織了幾場不分年級的體育活動。
The manager was responsible for nondivisional tasks that affect the whole office. 經理負責處理影響整個辦公室的非部門性事務。

meaning: 不屬於離婚、與離婚有關或受離婚影響。
sentences: They sought counseling to maintain a nondivorce status and save their marriage. 他們尋求諮商以維持婚姻狀態，挽救他們的關係。
The lawyer handled various nondivorce matters, such as drafting simple wills. 這位律師處理各種與離婚無關的事務，例如起草簡單的遺囑。

meaning: 一種粗糙的繖形花科北美洲植物，屬於藁屬植物，具有大的芳香根。
sentences: Biologists list nondo in reference works on classification. 分類參考資料會列出這個名稱。
The museum label mentions nondo when explaining the specimen's group. 標本標籤在說明所屬類群時也可能提到這個名稱。
The charity provides aid on a nondoctrinal basis to people of all faiths. 該慈善機構在不涉及教義的基礎上，向所有信仰的人提供援助。
The professor gave a nondoctrinal lecture on the history of ethics. 教授做了一場關於倫理學歷史的非教義式講座。

meaning: 不是紀錄片，或本質上不是紀錄片
sentences: The TV station decided to air a nondocumentary series about space travel. 電視台決定播放一部關於太空旅行的非紀錄片系列劇。
The museum displayed nondocumentary evidence like tools and pottery. 博物館展示了工具和陶器等非文書證據。
The team appreciated the leader's nondogmatic approach to new ideas. 團隊很欣賞領導者對新想法採取的非教條式態度。
He is known for his nondogmatic views on political and social issues. 他以對政治和社會問題持非武斷的觀點而聞名。
Older sources sometimes write nondoing as an alternative form of non-doing. 較早的資料有時會使用這個變體拼法。
Editors kept nondoing in the word bank so readers can recognize that variant spelling. 這筆資料保留下來，是為了讓讀者辨認這種變體拼法。
The government imposed higher taxes on various nondomestic products. 政府對各種國外產品徵收更高的稅。
You may need an adapter to use your hairdryer in nondomestic regions. 你可能需要轉接器才能在國外地區使用吹風機。

meaning: 未被馴化；不具備家庭生活的品質或習慣。
sentences: Scientists studied the behavior of nondomesticated wolves in the forest. 科學家們研究了森林中未經馴化之狼群的行為。
He has a nondomesticated personality and prefers living alone in the wild. 他有一種不習慣家庭生活的個性，更喜歡獨自住在荒野中。
Please try to write your name with your nondominant hand. 請嘗試用你的非慣用手寫下你的名字。
Small companies often operate in nondominant positions within the global market. 小公司在全球市場中通常處於不佔主導地位的位置。
The charity project was cancelled due to the nondonation of expected funds. 由於預期資金未能捐贈，這項慈善計畫被取消了。
The system recorded a nondonation when the credit card payment failed. 當信用卡支付失敗時，系統記錄了一次捐贈失敗。

meaning: 不戲劇化；不令人興奮；世俗的。
sentences: Most of his daily office work consists of nondramatic and routine tasks. 他大部分的日常辦公工作都是由平淡且例行的任務組成。
The doctor explained the test results in a nondramatic and calm voice. 醫生用一種不帶戲劇色彩且冷靜的聲音解釋了化驗結果。
The party provided many delicious juices for the nondrinking guests. 聚會為不喝酒的客人提供了許多美味的果汁。
He chose to sit in the nondrinking section of the restaurant. 他選擇坐在餐廳的非飲酒區。
The patient's leg swelling was diagnosed as a nondropsical condition. 病人的腿部腫脹被診斷為非水腫性狀況。
Further tests confirmed that the tissue enlargement was nondropsical in nature. 進一步的檢查確認了組織腫大在性質上並非水腫。
This moisturizing cream uses a nondrying formula to protect your skin. 這款保濕霜使用不乾燥配方來保護你的肌膚。
Artists prefer nondrying oils when they need to work on a painting for many days. 當藝術家需要花很多天創作一幅畫時，他們更喜歡使用不會變乾的油。
The monk gave a lecture on the concept of nonduality between mind and body. 僧侶講解了身心不二（非二元性）的概念。
Many eastern philosophies emphasize the nonduality of all existing things. 許多東方哲學強調萬物的一體性與非二元性。

meaning: 不允許傾倒廢物的地方。
sentences: The park is a strict nondumping zone to protect the local environment. 為了保護當地環境，這座公園是嚴格的禁止傾倒廢物區。
New regulations established nondumping areas along the coastline. 新法規在海岸線一帶設立了禁止傾倒廢物的區域。
The unique serial number ensures the nonduplication of each security certificate. 獨特的序號確保了每份安全憑證都不會重複。
Engineers checked the data logs to confirm the nonduplication of the error codes. 工程師檢查了數據日誌，以確認錯誤代碼沒有重複。
Personal gifts under a certain value are usually nondutiable at customs. 低於一定價值的個人禮物在海關通常是不需課稅的。
You should check which items are nondutiable before crossing the border. 在過境之前，你應該檢查哪些物品是免稅的。
The transition to a nondynastic government marked the beginning of a new era. 轉向非王朝式的政府標誌著一個新時代的開始。
The historian studied the nondynastic leaders who rose to power during the revolution. 歷史學家研究了在革命期間掌權的非王朝體系領導人。
The stomach pain was found to be nondyspeptic and caused by a muscle strain. 胃痛被發現並非由消化不良引起，而是由肌肉拉傷造成的。
He felt relieved to learn that his symptoms were nondyspeptic in origin. 得知他的症狀並非源於消化不良，他感到鬆了一口氣。
None of the students managed to solve the difficult problem. 沒有一位學生設法解決那個難題。
I have none of the information you are looking for. 我沒有任何你要找的資訊。
The company decided to sell its nonearning assets to save money. 公司決定出售其不盈利的資產以節省資金。
During the first year, the new branch remained a nonearning part of the business. 在第一年，新分店仍是業務中不賺錢的部分。
The store specializes in noneastern spices imported from Europe and Africa. 這家店專門販售從歐洲和非洲進口的非東方香料。
The researcher focused on noneastern cultures in the southern hemisphere. 研究人員將焦點放在南半球的非東方文化。
Be careful not to let children play with noneatable parts of the toy. 小心不要讓小孩玩耍玩具中不可食用的部分。
Some wild mushrooms look delicious but are actually noneatable and toxic. 一些野生蘑菇看起來很美味，但實際上是不可食用且有毒的。
The old building is now used for nonecclesiastical purposes like concerts and art shows. 這棟舊建築現在被用於音樂會和藝術展覽等非教會用途。
He preferred reading nonecclesiastical history books about ancient kings and wars. 他更喜歡閱讀關於古代君王和戰爭的非宗教歷史書。
Scientists use a nonechoic chamber to test the sound of new microphones. 科學家使用無響室（不產生迴聲的房間）來測試新麥克風的聲音。
The padded walls created a nonechoic environment for the recording session. 鋪有墊子的牆壁為錄音工作創造了一個無迴聲的環境。
Her fashion style is noneclectic and always sticks to a classic look. 她的時尚風格並不混雜，總是堅持經典造型。
The architect chose a noneclectic design that focused purely on modern materials. 建築師選擇了一種風格純粹而不混雜的設計，專注於現代材料。
Astronomers observed a noneclipsing binary star system in the distant galaxy. 天文學家在遙遠的星系中觀察到了一個非食雙星系統。
The brightness of the noneclipsing binary star stayed constant during our observation. 在我們的觀察期間，這組非食雙星的亮度保持穩定。
The volunteer worked for months with nonecompense for her time. 那位志工工作了幾個月，完全沒有因為投入的時間而獲得報酬。
He felt hurt by the nonecompense for his hard work at the clinic. 他因在診所辛苦工作卻沒得到回報而感到難過。
The lawsuit sought noneconomic damages for pain and suffering. 這起訴訟為痛苦和折磨尋求非經濟性質的賠償。
Volunteering provides many noneconomic benefits like personal growth and happiness. 志工服務提供了許多非經濟利益，例如個人成長和快樂。
The wax fruit on the table is strictly nonedible and for decoration only. 桌上的蠟製水果完全不可食用，僅供裝飾。
Modern glue is usually made from nonedible chemicals. 現代膠水通常由不可食用的化學物質製成。
The feedback from a noneditor can provide a fresh perspective on the story. 來自非編輯人員的反饋可以為故事提供一個新鮮的視角。
Even a noneditor can spot simple spelling mistakes in the draft. 即使是非專業編輯也能發現草稿中的簡單拼字錯誤。
The magazine includes several noneditorial pages for advertisements. 這本雜誌包含幾個非社論的頁面用來刊登廣告。
Her job involves managing the noneditorial staff at the newspaper office. 她的工作涉及管理報社內的非編務人員。
In the past, children with severe disabilities were often labeled as noneducable. 在過去，患有嚴重身心障礙的兒童常被標籤為不可教育。
The school refuses to classify any student as noneducable, believing everyone can learn. 學校拒絕將任何學生歸類為不可教育，相信每個人都能學習。
The government allocated a large budget to noneducation sectors like defense. 政府撥款了大量預算給國防等非教育部門。
Many employees in the department handle noneducation tasks such as facility maintenance. 該部門的許多員工處理設備維修等非教育性任務。

meaning: 沒有教育意義；與教育無關或不以教育為目的。
sentences: The children spent too much time watching noneducational videos on the internet. 孩子們花了太多時間在網路上觀看沒有教育意義的影片。
The trip was purely for fun and had a noneducational focus. 這次旅行純粹是為了好玩，並非以教育為目的。
The old cleaning spray proved noneffective against the stubborn stains. 事實證明，舊的清潔噴霧對付頑固污漬沒有效果。
His leadership style was noneffective in boosting the team's morale. 他的領導風格在提升團隊士氣方面沒有效果。
I prefer noneffervescent water over carbonated drinks. 比起碳酸飲料，我更喜歡不含氣泡的水。
This medicine is available in a noneffervescent tablet form. 這種藥物有不泡騰的錠劑形式。
The young leader brought a noneffete energy to the aging political party. 這位年輕領導人為老化的政黨帶來了不衰弱的活力。
We need noneffete strategies to revitalize the local economy. 我們需要不軟弱的策略來振興當地經濟。
The doctors found the initial treatment to be nonefficacious for the rare disease. 醫生髮現最初的治療方法對這種罕見疾病沒有效果。
Testing showed that the low dose was nonefficacious in preventing the infection. 測試顯示低劑量在預防感染方面沒有效果。
The nonefficacy of the new pesticide caused the crops to fail. 新農藥的缺乏功效導致作物歉收。
Patients complained about the nonefficacy of the pain relief cream. 病人抱怨這種止痛膏缺乏功效。
The nonefficiency of the old boiler led to high heating bills. 舊鍋爐的低效率導致暖氣費用高昂。
We must address the nonefficiency of the current delivery system. 我們必須解決目前配送系統效率不高的問題。
Replacing the nonefficient light bulbs saved the company a lot of money. 更換效率不高的燈泡為公司節省了大量資金。
The nonefficient layout of the kitchen makes cooking difficult. 廚房佈局效率不高，讓烹飪變得困難。
The X-ray confirmed noneffusion in the patient's lungs. X光片確認病人的肺部沒有積液。
After a week of treatment, the doctor noted the noneffusion of the joint. 經過一週的治療，醫生注意到關節處已無積液。

meaning: 排除自我的那部分心靈
sentences: In philosophy, the nonego represents everything external to the self. 在哲學中，「非我」代表自我之外的一切事物。
Meditation helps one distinguish between the ego and the nonego. 冥想有助於區分自我與非自我。
Her nonegoistical decision to share the prize money surprised everyone. 她分享獎金的不自私決定讓每個人都感到驚訝。
We should strive to be more nonegoistical when working in a team. 在團隊工作時，我們應該努力變得更不自私。
The pilot survived despite the nonejection of the escape pod. 儘管逃生艙彈出失敗，飛行員還是倖存了下來。
The printer error was caused by the nonejection of the finished paper. 印表機錯誤是由於完成的紙張沒有彈出造成的。

The darkroom is a nonfenestrated space used for developing film. 暗房是一個沒有開窗的空間，用於沖洗底片。
The nonfenestrated design of the warehouse keeps the temperature stable. 倉庫的無窗設計保持了溫度的穩定。
The nonfermentability of the plastic means it will not rot in the ground. 這種塑膠具有不可發酵的特性，這意味著它不會在土壤中腐爛。

The factory uses a nonfermentation technique to produce this vinegar. 該工廠使用非發酵技術來生產這款醋。
This nonfermentation approach keeps the tea leaves from turning brown. 這種非發酵方式能防止茶葉變褐色。
The doctor identified the bacteria as a nonfermentative strain. 醫生認定該細菌為不發酵的菌株。
Nonfermentative processes are often used in modern chemical labs. 不發酵過程常用於現代化學實驗室中。
Aluminium is a common nonferrous metal used in soda cans. 鋁是一種常用於汽水罐的非鐵金屬。
The scrap yard buys nonferrous materials like copper and brass. 廢料場收購銅和黃銅等不含鐵的材料。
The farmer added fertilizer to the nonfertile land to help crops grow. 農夫在貧瘠的土地上施肥以幫助作物生長。
This hybrid plant is nonfertile and cannot produce seeds. 這種雜交植物不具生育能力，無法產生種子。
Scientists are studying the causes of nonfertility in certain animal species. 科學家正研究某些動物物種不育的原因。
The report discussed the nonfertility of the soil after the flood. 報告討論了洪水過後土壤貧瘠的情況。
The room looked nonfestive after all the decorations were taken down. 拆掉所有裝飾後，房間看起來一點也不喜慶。
He chose a nonfestive tie for the serious business meeting. 他為那場嚴肅的商務會議挑選了一條不具節慶氣息的領帶。
The professor explained the transition to a nonfeudal social system. 教授解釋了向非封建社會制度的轉型。
Many regions developed nonfeudal land laws during that century. 許多地區在那個世紀制定了非封建的土地法。
This nonfibrous material is easier to clean than wool. 這種非纖維材料比羊毛更容易清潔。
The doctor recommended eating more nonfibrous foods during the recovery. 醫生建議在康復期間多吃非纖維類的食物。

meaning: 旨在提供事實或真實事物和事件的真實描述的書面作品。常用於定語。
sentences: I prefer reading nonfiction about history and science. 我比較喜歡閱讀關於歷史和科學的非虛構類書籍。

The researchers identified a nonfilamentous type of algae in the pond. 研究人員在池塘中發現了一種非絲狀的藻類。
This medicine is effective against nonfilamentous bacteria. 這種藥物對非絲狀細菌有效。
The botanist noted that the petals were nonfimbriate and smooth. 植物學家注意到花瓣邊緣不是流蘇狀的，而且很光滑。
This species of orchid has nonfimbriate leaves. 這種蘭花的葉子不具流蘇邊緣。
The company offers nonfinancial rewards like extra vacation days. 公司提供非金錢獎勵，例如額外的休假天數。
Safety is a crucial nonfinancial factor in our operations. 安全是我們運營中一個關鍵的非財務因素。

meaning: 未找到的內容，例如由評審團或作為學術研究成果。
sentences: The jury returned a nonfinding due to a lack of evidence. 由於缺乏證據，陪審團做出了未發現事實的裁決。

Several athletes were listed as nonfinishing in the official race results. 幾位運動員在正式比賽結果中被列為未完賽。
Nonfinite verbs like infinitives do not show tense. 不定詞等非限定動詞不會顯示時態。
He explained the difference between finite and nonfinite clauses. 他解釋了限定子句和非限定子句之間的區別。
Do not store gasoline in a nonfireproof container. 不要將汽油儲存在不防火的容器中。
The old building was built with nonfireproof materials. 這棟舊建築是用不防火的材料建造的。
The government introduced nonfiscal measures to reduce pollution. 政府採取了非財政手段來減少污染。

The safety rules on the boat are explained clearly to every nonfisherman passenger. 船上的安全守則向每一位不是漁夫的乘客都解釋得很清楚。
Uranium-238 is a nonfissile isotope commonly found in nature. 鈾-238 是自然界中常見的非裂變同位素。
The waste material consists mostly of nonfissile components. 廢料主要由非裂變成分組成。
The nonfixation of the bone after surgery caused some pain. 手術後骨骼未能固定導致了一些疼痛。
Chemical nonfixation can occur if the solution is too weak. 如果溶液太稀，可能會發生化學固定不全的情況。
This brand of paint provides a nonflaky finish for outdoor walls. 這個品牌的油漆能為室外牆壁提供不剝落的塗層。
I prefer a nonflaky crust for my apple pie. 我比較喜歡蘋果派的派皮不要太容易掉屑。
These curtains are made of nonflammable fabric for safety. 為了安全起見，這些窗簾是用不可燃纖維製成的。
Wear nonflammable clothing when working near the campfire. 在營火附近工作時，請穿著不可燃的衣物。
The lab report analyzed the nonfloatation of the particles in the solution. 實驗室報告分析了溶液中顆粒不浮起的現象。
We observed the nonfloatation of the heavy materials at the bottom of the tank. 我們觀察到重質材料在水槽底部不浮起的狀況。
The diver checked the nonfloating equipment at the bottom of the pool. 潛水員檢查了水池底部不浮動的設備。

The gardener noticed that some nonfloriferous plants were still very healthy. 園丁注意到有些不開花的植物依然非常健康。
We studied the growth patterns of nonfloriferous shrubs in the forest. 我們研究了森林中不開花灌木的生長模式。

meaning: 屬於植物，不開花；以花授粉以外的方式繁殖。
sentences: Ferns are common examples of nonflowering plants. 蕨類是不開花植物的常見例子。

meaning: 不屬於或與取消抵押品贖回權有關。
sentences: The bank agreed to a nonforeclosure settlement with the homeowner. 銀行同意與屋主達成一項不涉及沒收房產的結案協議。

The map shows nonforest areas being used for farming. 地圖顯示非森林區域正被用於農業。
The biologist studied the nonforest animals living in the grasslands. 生物學家研究了生活在草原上的非森林動物。
Large parts of the province are nonforested due to urban development. 由於城市發展，該省的大部分地區都沒有森林。

The employees were happy to learn their pension rights were nonforfeitable. 員工們很高興得知他們的退休金權益是不可被剝奪的。
Once you reach a certain age, your membership benefits become nonforfeitable. 一旦你達到一定年齡，你的會員福利就會變成不可被取消的。
The team remained nonforfeiting despite being far behind in the game. 儘管在比賽中落後很多，這支隊伍依然堅持不放棄比賽資格。

meaning: 缺乏沒收；未能放棄或免除放棄。
sentences: The insurance policy includes a nonforfeiture option for the policyholder. 這份保險單為投保人提供了一項不喪失權利的選擇。

meaning: 缺乏形式的東西；一些不成熟的東西。
sentences: The artist’s early sketches were just a nonform of lines and shadows. 藝術家早期的素描只是一些沒有固定形狀的線條和陰影。

He gained most of his technical skills through nonformal training at work. 他的大部分技術能力都是透過工作中的非正式訓練獲得的。
The nonformal meeting allowed the staff to share their ideas more freely. 這場非正式會議讓員工能更自由地分享他們的想法。
The nonformation of ice on the lake this winter surprised the locals. 今年冬天湖面上未能結冰的情況讓當地人感到驚訝。
Doctors are investigating the nonformation of certain cells in the patient. 醫生正在調查病人體內某些細胞未能形成的原因。

meaning: 缺乏配方；未能製定某事。
sentences: The project stalled due to the nonformulation of a clear strategy. 由於未能制定出清晰的策略，該計畫停滯不前。
The chemist explained the nonformulation of the drug under low temperatures. 化學家解釋了在低溫下該藥物未能成功配製的情況。
The treaty required the nonfortification of the border areas. 該條約要求邊境地區不得設置防禦工事。
Historical records show the nonfortification of the city during that period. 歷史記錄顯示該城市在那個時期並沒有建立防禦工事。
The success of the project was nonfortuitous and resulted from months of hard work. 專案的成功並非偶然，而是數月努力工作的成果。
We believe the pattern of errors is nonfortuitous and suggests a system bug. 我們認為這些錯誤的模式並非巧合，顯示系統存在漏洞。
The geologist identified this layer of rock as nonfossiliferous. 地質學家認定這層岩石不含化石。
We searched the canyon, but the soil there is mostly nonfossiliferous. 我們搜尋了峽谷，但那裡的土壤大多不含化石。

The lab uses nonfouling pipes to prevent mineral buildup. 實驗室使用不結垢的管線來防止礦物質堆積。

meaning: 非兄弟會（兄弟會成員）的人。
sentences: He was a nonfrat student who preferred joining the hiking club. 他是一名非兄弟會的學生，更喜歡參加登山社。

The background check proved that the applicant was a nonfrauder. 背景調查證明該申請人並非詐騙者。

We must protect citizens from entering a condition of nonfreedom. 我們必須保護公民不陷於缺乏自由的境地。

History books describe the difficult lives of a nonfreeman in that ancient society. 歷史書描述了在那個古老社會中非自由人的艱辛生活。
This liquid is nonfreezable even at extremely low temperatures. 這種液體即使在極低溫下也不會凍結。

meaning: 這不會凍結，或不涉及凍結。
sentences: The plumber installed a nonfreeze faucet outside the house. 水管工在屋外安裝了一個防凍龍頭。

The teacher showed us how to pronounce a nonfricative sound correctly. 老師向我們示範了如何正確發出非摩擦音。

We studied the movement of objects in a nonfriction environment. 我們研究了物體在無摩擦環境下的運動。
I prefer nonfrosted glass because it is easier to see through. 我比較喜歡非磨砂玻璃，因為比較容易看穿。
The bakery sold nonfrosted donuts for customers who dislike sugar. 麵包店為不喜歡糖的人販售沒抹糖霜的甜甜圈。
Their plans for a new park came to nonfruition due to lack of funds. 由於缺乏資金，他們建立新公園的計劃未能實現。
The deal reached nonfruition after weeks of difficult negotiations. 經過數週艱難的談判後，這項交易最終沒有結果。
The new software focuses on nonfrustration for beginning users. 這款新軟體專注於不讓初學者產生挫敗感。
Exercise can help maintain a state of nonfrustration during stressful weeks. 在壓力大的日子裡，運動有助於保持平靜而不感到沮喪。
The contract was canceled due to nonfulfillment of the delivery terms. 由於未能履行交貨條款，合約被取消。
Nonfulfillment of the agreement will lead to a heavy fine. 未能履行協議將導致巨額罰款。

meaning: 不具備功能；無用;破碎的。
sentences: The elevator has been nonfunctional since the power outage. 自從停電以來，這部電梯一直無法運作。

Each piece of hand-made jewelry is unique and nonfungible. 每一件手工珠寶都是獨一無二且不可替代的。
The lawyer explained that the land title is a nonfungible asset. 律師解釋說，土地所有權是一項不可互換的資產。
The lab test showed the sample contained a nonfuroid substance. 實驗室測試顯示樣本中含有一種非呋喃類物質。

The glossary explains that nonfuturition means rare or specialized English term. 詞彙表會說明這個詞的意思。
Readers may encounter nonfuturition in specialist books or historical writing. 讀者可能會在專業書籍或較早的文獻中看到這個詞。

meaning: 遠離星系；不與星系相互作用。
sentences: The telescope captured images of a nongalactic object drifting in deep space. 望遠鏡捕捉到了在深空漂流的非星系天體的影像。

meaning: 以一種不是無限的方式。
sentences: The battery powers the device noninfinitely, so it will eventually run out completely. 電池供電並非永無止境，所以最終還是會完全耗盡電力。

meaning: 不易燃的品質，即不易著火。
sentences: The noninflammability of this new plastic makes it very safe for building houses. 這種新型塑膠不易燃的特性，使其非常適合用於建造房屋。

sentences: The glossary explains that noninterventionalist means Synonym of noninterventionist. 詞彙表會說明這個詞的意思。

sentences: The nonintrusionist argued that the community should choose its own minister. 這位不干涉政策支持者主張，社區應該自行挑選牧師。
