The doctor confirmed that the patient was in a nonmalarious region. 醫生確認病人當時身處非瘧疾疫區。
This medication is only for patients with nonmalarious fevers. 這種藥物僅適用於非瘧疾引起發燒的患者。
His comment was nonmalicious, although it sounded a bit rude. 他的評論雖然聽起來有點粗魯，但並沒有惡意。
The software error was nonmalicious and did not steal any user data. 這個軟體錯誤並非惡意程式，也沒有竊取任何用戶資料。
The test results showed that the tumor was nonmalignant. 化驗結果顯示該腫瘤為良性。
He suffered from a nonmalignant growth on his skin. 他的皮膚上長了一個非惡性的增生物。
Cast iron is nonmalleable and will crack if you try to bend it. 鑄鐵不具延展性，如果你試圖彎曲它，它會裂開。
The artist found the cold clay too nonmalleable to shape by hand. 藝術家覺得冰冷的黏土太硬，無法用手塑形。
The biology class studied various nonmammalian species, such as frogs and snakes. 生物課研究了各種非哺乳類物種，例如青蛙和蛇。
Sharks are nonmammalian creatures that live in the ocean. 鯊魚是生活在海洋中的非哺乳類生物。
Attendance at the staff party is nonmandatory for all employees. 所有員工都可以自願參加員工派對，並非強制性。
The update is nonmandatory, but it provides several useful features. 這次更新不是強制的，但它提供了幾個實用的功能。
The symptoms of the illness were nonmanifest during the early stages. 這種疾病的症狀在早期並不明顯。
There are many nonmanifest dangers in this abandoned factory. 這座廢棄工廠裡隱藏著許多看不見的危險。
The nonmanifestation of symptoms made the disease hard to diagnose. 症狀未顯現使得這種疾病難以診斷。
His nonmanifestation of grief surprised his family. 他沒有表現出悲傷的樣子，這讓他的家人感到驚訝。
We ordered nonmanila envelopes for the wedding invitations. 我們訂購了非馬尼拉紙製的信封來裝婚禮請帖。
The storage room is full of nonmanila boxes. 儲藏室裡堆滿了非馬尼拉纖維製的箱子。

meaning: 非甘露醇的同義詞（「不涉及或與甘露醇有關」）。
sentences: The report uses nonmannite to describe a related feature. 報告用這個詞來描述某種相關特徵。
Readers may encounter nonmannite in descriptive or specialist writing. 讀者可能會在描述性或專業文本中看到這個詞。
Many employees prefer nonmanual jobs that involve working in an office. 許多員工偏好在辦公室工作的非體力勞動職位。
The factory introduced nonmanual controls to improve safety. 工廠引進了非手動的控制系統以提高安全性。
The nonmanufacture of parts during the strike halted the assembly line. 罷工期間零件停止生產，導致裝配線停工。
Local laws led to the nonmanufacture of certain chemicals in the city. 當地法律導致該城市停止生產某些化學品。
The store sells nonmanufactured goods like raw wool and honey. 這家店販售未經加工的商品，如原毛和蜂蜜。
Nonmanufactured materials are often used in traditional crafts. 未經工業製造的材料常用於傳統工藝。
Most of the town's residents work in nonmanufacturing sectors like tourism. 鎮上大多數居民在旅遊業等非製造業部門工作。
The report shows growth in nonmanufacturing industries last year. 報告顯示去年的非製造業有所增長。
The geologist found fossils of nonmarine plants in the desert. 地質學家在沙漠中發現了非海洋植物的化石。
Freshwater turtles are nonmarine animals. 淡水龜是非海洋生物。

meaning: 沒有婚姻關係；彼此未婚
sentences: The couple decided to maintain a nonmarital relationship for now. 這對情侶決定暫時維持非婚姻的關係。
The lawyer explained the laws regarding nonmarital property. 律師解釋了關於非婚生財產的法律。
The company handles nonmaritime transport like trucking and rail. 這家公司處理卡車和鐵路等非海運的運輸業務。
The logistics firm expanded its nonmaritime services to cover land routes. 這家物流公司擴展了其非海運服務，以覆蓋陸路。

meaning: 不以市場為基礎；通常特別缺乏自由市場的開放性。
sentences: The government provides some nonmarket services for the public good. 政府為公共利益提供了一些非市場導向的服務。
Many household tasks are considered nonmarket activities because no money is exchanged. 許多家務活被視為非市場活動，因為其中沒有金錢交易。
His nonmarriage to his longtime partner surprised many friends. 他最終沒能與長期的伴侶結婚，這讓許多朋友感到驚訝。
The priest recorded the nonmarriage in the parish registry. 牧師在教區登記簿中記錄了這樁未能成的婚事。
The old law defined who was nonmarriageable based on age. 舊法律根據年齡定義了誰是不可以結婚的。
In the past, some people were considered nonmarriageable due to certain laws. 過去，由於某些法律規定，有些人被認為是不具備結婚資格的。
He belongs to a nonmarrying religious order. 他隸屬於一個不結婚的宗教團體。
Some people choose a nonmarrying lifestyle to focus on their careers. 有些人選擇不結婚的生活方式，以便專注於事業。
The students practiced nonmartial arts like yoga and dance. 學生們練習瑜伽和舞蹈等非武術類的運動。
The parade featured nonmartial music to celebrate the peace. 遊行播放了非軍事風格的音樂來慶祝和平。

meaning: 缺乏掌握；未能掌握某事。
sentences: His nonmastery of the local language made it hard to find a job. 他未能掌握當地語言，這使得找工作變得很困難。
The teacher noted the student's nonmastery of basic math skills. 老師注意到學生尚未掌握基礎的數學技能。

meaning: 不是物質的；除了物質之外
sentences: Happiness is a nonmaterial goal that many people seek. 快樂是許多人追求的一種非物質目標。
The award recognized her nonmaterial contributions to the community. 該獎項表彰了她對社區所做的非物質貢獻。
They lead a nonmaterialistic life, focusing on family and nature. 他們過著非唯物主義的生活，專注於家庭與大自然。
Her nonmaterialistic values changed how she spent her money. 她的非唯物觀點改變了她花錢的方式。
The philosopher discussed the nonmateriality of the human soul. 這位哲學家討論了人類靈魂的非物質性。
Modern physics explores the nonmateriality of certain energy forms. 現代物理學探索某些能量形式的非物質狀態。
The child received care from nonmaternal relatives like aunts and uncles. 這名孩子得到了叔叔阿姨等非母系親屬的照顧。
Scientists studied nonmaternal behavior in social animal groups. 科學家研究了社交動物群體中的非母性行為。
The book provides a nonmathematical explanation of the theory. 這本書對該理論提供了不涉及數學的解釋。
He enjoys nonmathematical hobbies like painting and gardening. 他喜歡繪畫和園藝等非數學類的愛好。
Even a nonmathematician can understand these simple statistics. 即使是不是數學家的人，也能理解這些簡單的統計數據。
The lecture was designed for the nonmathematician to follow easily. 這場講座是為非數學家設計的，以便讓他們輕鬆聽懂。
The court decided how to divide nonmatrimonial assets after the breakup. 法院決定了在分手後如何分配非夫妻共同財產。
They maintained a nonmatrimonial relationship for many years. 他們多年來一直維持著非夫妻的關係。
Light is a form of nonmatter that travels through space. 光是一種在空間中傳播的非物質形式。
The scientist explained the difference between matter and nonmatter. 科學家解釋了物質與非物質之間的區別。
The old clock uses a nonmechanical electronic system. 這座舊鐘使用的是非機械式的電子系統。
The technician found a nonmechanical fault in the wiring. 技術員在線路中發現了一個非機械性的故障。
The artist took a nonmechanistic approach to creating the sculpture. 這位藝術家採用非機械式的方法來創作這座雕塑。
The biologist preferred a nonmechanistic view of how cells grow. 這位生物學家更傾向於以非機械論的觀點來看待細胞的生長。

meaning: 不具有醫學性質；不直接涉及醫學。
sentences: The insurance policy covers nonmedical expenses like travel and housing. 該保險政策涵蓋了交通和住宿等非醫療費用。
She works in a nonmedical role at the local hospital. 她在當地醫院擔任非醫療性質的職位。
The herb is used for nonmedicinal purposes like cooking and dyeing. 這種藥草被用於烹飪和染色等非藥用用途。
The store sells nonmedicinal products like soap and candles. 這家商店販售肥皂和蠟燭等非藥用產品。
The researcher identified some nonmedullated nerve fibers in the sample. 研究人員在樣本中鑑定出了一些無髓鞘的神經纖維。
The diagram shows how nonmedullated cells are arranged in the tissue. 圖表顯示了無髓質細胞在組織中的排列方式。
The bird made a nonmelodious squawking sound. 那隻鳥發出了不悅耳的尖叫聲。
The singer's early recordings were somewhat nonmelodious. 這位歌手早期的錄音作品聽起來沒什麼旋律感。
Older sources sometimes write nonmember as an alternative form of non-member. 較早的資料有時會使用這個變體拼法。
Editors kept nonmember in the word bank so readers can recognize that variant spelling. 這筆資料保留下來，是為了讓讀者辨認這種變體拼法。

meaning: 沒有會員資格；不是會員的狀態或條件。
sentences: Nonmembership in the club means you cannot use the pool. 不是該俱樂部的會員意味著你不能使用游泳池。
He confirmed his nonmembership by showing he had no ID card. 他透過出示自己沒有身分卡來證明他並非會員。
The agency helps workers find nonmenial jobs in offices. 該機構幫助工人尋找辦公室裡的非卑微工作。
She felt proud to be promoted to a nonmenial position. 她對自己能被晉升到一個非卑微的職位感到自豪。

meaning: 不是精神上的（與頭腦有關）。
sentences: The doctor examined the patient for nonmental symptoms like pain. 醫生檢查了病人的疼痛等非精神性症狀。
The exercise has many nonmental benefits for physical health. 這項運動對身體健康有許多非心理方面的益處。
The school focuses on academic growth for nonmercantile reasons. 這所學校出於非營利的目的，專注於學術成長。
The small town kept its nonmercantile charm by avoiding big shopping malls. 這個小鎮避開了大型商場，保留了非商業化的魅力。

meaning: 不具有金屬化學或物理性質的元素，例如磷或氯。
sentences: Carbon is a common nonmetal found in all living things. 碳是所有生物體內常見的一種非金屬元素。
Unlike copper, oxygen is a nonmetal and does not conduct electricity well. 與銅不同，氧氣是一種非金屬，導電性能不佳。
The worker used a nonmetallic tool to avoid making sparks. 工人使用非金屬工具以避免產生火花。
The glasses have a nonmetallic frame that is very light. 這副眼鏡配有非金屬材質的鏡框，非常輕便。
The geologists found nonmetalliferous rock layers in the valley. 地質學家在山谷中發現了不含金屬的岩層。
This region is known for its nonmetalliferous soil, which is good for farming. 這個地區以其不含金屬成分的土壤聞名，非常適合耕種。
The factory produces nonmetallurgical products like plastic pipes. 這家工廠生產塑膠管等非冶金產品。
He found a nonmetallurgical job in a local bakery. 他在當地的麵包店找到了一份與冶金無關的工作。
The scientists studied nonmetamorphic rocks to find fossils. 科學家研究非變質岩以尋找化石。
Sandstone is often a nonmetamorphic rock formed from sand. 砂岩通常是由沙子形成的非變質岩。
The doctor gave a nonmetaphysical explanation for the patient's pain. 醫生對病人的疼痛給出了科學而非超自然的解釋。
She prefers to discuss nonmetaphysical topics like science and history. 她偏好討論科學和歷史等非哲學性質的話題。
The bright light in the sky was nonmeteoric and likely a satellite. 天空中那道亮光並非流星，很可能是一顆衛星。
They observed several nonmeteoric flashes during the storm. 他們在暴風雨期間觀察到了幾次非流星產生的閃光。
The loud sound was due to nonmeteorological causes, not thunder. 那聲巨響是由非氣象原因造成的，並非雷聲。
The data shows nonmeteorological changes in the ocean level. 數據顯示海洋水位出現了非氣象因素引起的變化。
The US still uses nonmetric units like inches and pounds. 美國仍在使用英吋和磅等非公制單位。
He found it hard to use nonmetric tools after living in Europe. 在歐洲生活過後，他覺得很難使用非公制工具。

meaning: 不受節拍器的限制；沒有以嚴格的基本節奏方法演奏或演唱。
sentences: The singer performed a nonmetrical chant at the start of the song. 歌手在歌曲開頭演唱了一段不受節拍限制的吟唱。
Modern dance often uses nonmetrical music to express feelings. 現代舞常使用無固定節奏的音樂來表達情感。
Life in nonmetropolitan areas is usually much quieter. 非大都市地區的生活通常安靜得多。
The government is building more hospitals in nonmetropolitan towns. 政府正在非大都市城鎮興建更多醫院。
The doctor confirmed that the skin rash was nonmicrobic. 醫生確認這處皮疹並非微生物感染所致。
The laboratory studied nonmicrobic particles in the air. 實驗室研究了空氣中不含微生物的微粒。
The damage to the car was nonmicroscopical and easy to see. 車輛的損傷並非微觀層面，很容易看見。
Grains of sand are nonmicroscopical and can be felt by hand. 沙粒並非肉眼不可見，可以用手感覺到。
These birds are nonmigratory and stay in the forest all winter. 這些鳥類不遷徙，整個冬天都待在森林裡。
The local fish population is nonmigratory, living in the lake year-round. 當地的魚群是不遷徙的，常年生活在湖中。
The group used nonmilitant ways to protest the new law. 該團體使用非激進的方式抗議新法律。
He is a nonmilitant leader who believes in peaceful talk. 他是一位相信和平談判的非武裝領導人。
The airport handles both military and nonmilitary flights. 這個機場同時處理軍事和非軍事航班。
She wears nonmilitary clothes when she is off duty. 她下班後穿著平民服裝。

meaning: 一個不是百萬富翁的人。
sentences: As a nonmillionaire, he has to save money for his vacation. 身為一個不是百萬富翁的人，他必須為度假存錢。
The park is open to everyone, including every nonmillionaire in town. 公園對所有人開放，包括鎮上每一位非百萬富翁的人。
The artist creates nonmimetic paintings that do not look like real objects. 這位藝術家創作的非模仿畫作，看起來不像真實的物體。
The dance included nonmimetic movements that were very abstract. 這段舞蹈包含了一些非常抽象的非模仿動作。
Water is often mixed with nonmineral substances in the lab. 實驗室裡常將水與非礦物質混合。
The scientist identified the sample as a nonmineral material. 科學家確認該樣本為非礦物材質。
The report focused on nonmineralogical features of the soil. 報告專注於土壤的非礦物學特徵。
He has many nonmineralogical interests, such as music and sports. 他有很多非礦物學方面的興趣，例如音樂和運動。
The project required a nonminimal amount of effort from the team. 該項目需要團隊投入不小的努力。
The storm caused nonminimal damage to the local farms. 暴風雨對當地農場造成了不小的損害。
The meeting was led by a nonministerial official from the city. 會議是由一位非部長級的市府官員主持。
They handled nonministerial tasks like filing papers and answering calls. 他們處理公文和接聽電話等非部長級的事務。
The patient's health declined due to the nonministration of medicine. 由於未能施予藥物，病人的健康狀況惡化了。
The residents complained about the nonministration of public services in their area. 居民抱怨其地區公共服務的缺失。
The recovery was a slow and nonmiraculous process. 康復是一個緩慢且並不神奇的過程。
He offered a practical, nonmiraculous solution to the financial problem. 他為這個財務問題提供了一個務實而不神奇的解決方案。
The teacher praised the nonmischievous students who sat quietly during the assembly. 老師表揚了在集會時安靜坐著、不淘氣的學生。
We are looking for a gentle, nonmischievous pet for our young daughter. 我們想為小女兒找一隻溫和、不調皮的寵物。
Oil and water are nonmiscible liquids that will separate when left alone. 油和水是不互溶的液體，靜置後會分層。
The lab assistant accidentally mixed two nonmiscible chemicals in the beaker. 實驗室助理不小心在燒杯中混合了兩種無法互溶的化學物質。

meaning: 不屬於或不屬於傳教士（宗教傳播者）。
sentences: The clinic was established by a nonmissionary organization to provide free medical care. 這家診所是由一個非宗教性質的組織建立的，旨在提供免費醫療服務。
She works at a nonmissionary school that welcomes students from all backgrounds. 她在一所非教會學校工作，歡迎來自各種背景的學生。
The hospital requires special beds for nonmobile patients to prevent pressure sores. 醫院需要為無法移動的病患提供特殊病床，以防止褥瘡。
We need a large truck to transport these nonmobile pieces of heavy equipment. 我們需要一輛大卡車來運輸這些無法移動的重型設備。
Please design a nonmodal window so users can still click the background. 請設計一個非強制回應視窗，讓使用者仍然可以點擊背景。
The software displays a nonmodal warning at the top of the screen. 該軟體在螢幕頂部顯示一個非模態的警告訊息。

meaning: 具有過去時代的特徵；不現代。
sentences: The village has a charming, nonmodern atmosphere with its cobblestone streets. 這個村莊擁有迷人的非現代氛圍，街道鋪滿了鵝卵石。
We decided to replace the nonmodern heating system in our house to save energy. 我們決定更換家裡不符合現代標準的暖氣系統以節省能源。
The dentist found a cavity on one of her nonmolar teeth. 牙醫在她的一顆非臼齒上發現了蛀牙。
Dogs use their nonmolar teeth to tear meat apart. 狗利用牠們的非臼齒來撕裂肉塊。
Salt is a nonmolecular compound that forms a solid crystal lattice. 鹽是一種形成堅固晶格的非分子化合物。
The professor explained the difference between molecular and nonmolecular substances. 教授解釋了分子物質和非分子物質之間的區別。
The new policy will have a nonmomentary impact on our daily operations. 新政策將對我們的日常營運產生長遠的影響。
He felt a deep, nonmomentary sadness when he heard the bad news. 聽到這個壞消息時，他感到一種深深的、並非轉瞬即逝的悲傷。
The country transitioned into a nonmonarchical government after the revolution. 革命後，該國過渡為非君主制政府。
They studied the political structures of several nonmonarchical nations in Europe. 他們研究了歐洲幾個非君主制國家的政治結構。

meaning: 一個不是君主主義者的人。
sentences: As a nonmonarchist, he strongly opposed the expensive coronation ceremony. 作為一個非君主主義者，他強烈反對昂貴的加冕儀式。
The debate was heated because the crowd was divided into royal supporters and nonmonarchists. 辯論非常激烈，因為人群分成了皇室支持者和非君主主義者。
The historical building was originally a nonmonastic residence for the local lord. 這棟歷史建築最初是當地領主的非修道院住所。
She chose to live a nonmonastic life after spending three years in the temple. 在寺廟度過三年後，她選擇過非修道院的世俗生活。
His nonmonist philosophy argues that the universe is made of multiple independent elements. 他的非一元論哲學認為宇宙是由多個獨立的元素組成的。
The professor introduced a nonmonist approach to understanding human consciousness. 教授介紹了一種非一元論的方法來理解人類意識。
Some species of birds are completely nonmonogamous and have multiple partners every season. 某些種類的鳥類完全不是一夫一妻制，牠們每個季節都會有多個伴侶。

meaning: 不是職業性的；與職業無關

Older sources sometimes write nonoffender as an alternative form of non-offender. 較早的資料有時會使用這個變體拼法。
Editors kept nonoffender in the word bank so readers can recognize that variant spelling. 這筆資料保留下來，是為了讓讀者辨認這種變體拼法。
Older sources sometimes write nonoffensive as an alternative form of non-offensive. 較早的資料有時會使用這個變體拼法。
Editors kept nonoffensive in the word bank so readers can recognize that variant spelling. 這筆資料保留下來，是為了讓讀者辨認這種變體拼法。

As a nonomad, he found the idea of moving every month exhausting. 身為一個定居者，他覺得每個月搬家一次的想法非常令人疲憊。

The festival features both orchestral and nonorchestral music. 該音樂節既有管弦樂也有非管弦樂。

The laboratory analyzed several nonorganic compounds in the soil. 實驗室分析了土壤中的幾種無機化合物。

Her desk was a mess, showing a complete nonorganization of her files. 她的辦公桌一團糟，顯示出她的文件完全缺乏整理。
He was the only nonoriental student in the language class. 他是語言班上唯一的非東方人學生。
The company is looking for both Oriental and nonoriental partners. 公司正在尋找東方和非東方的合作夥伴。
The car still has some nonoriginal parts that were replaced last year. 這輛車仍有一些去年更換的非原廠零件。
He realized his idea was nonoriginal after searching on the internet. 在網路上搜尋後，他意識到自己的想法並非原創。
These nonornamental trees are planted mainly for their timber. 這些非觀賞性的樹木主要是為了木材而種植的。
The building's exterior is plain and nonornamental. 這棟建築的外觀樸素且不具裝飾性。
The scientist used nonorthodox methods to solve the complex problem. 這位科學家使用了非正統的方法來解決這個複雜的問題。
Her nonorthodox views on education often sparked heated debates. 她對教育的非正統觀點經常引發激烈的辯論。

The community values nonoutlawry and expects everyone to respect the local legal system. 社群重視守法狀態，並期望每個人都能尊重當地的法律體系。
His return to nonoutlawry meant he could finally walk the streets without fear of arrest. 他恢復合法身份意味著他終於可以走在大街上，而不必擔心被捕。

meaning: 不是所有者的人，尤其是在商業企業。

meaning: 一個不是天主教徒的人。
sentences: In the 17th century, a nonpapist might face legal restrictions in certain European regions. 在十七世紀，非天主教徒在某些歐洲地區可能會面臨法律限制。

meaning: 無與倫比，無與倫比；獨特的。
sentences: The chef's chocolate cake is truly nonpareil in its rich flavor. 這位主廚做的巧克力蛋糕口味濃郁，實在是無可匹敵。

She bought a nonparticipating life insurance policy to save money. 她買了一份不分紅的人壽保險來省錢。

meaning: 不參加某些活動或事件的事實。
sentences: His continuous nonparticipation in team meetings became a serious issue. 他持續不參與團隊會議，已經成了一個嚴重的問題。

meaning: 沒有黨派傾向；公正無偏見。

meaning: 不包含在配額內或不受配額限制。
sentences: The report uses nonquota to describe a related feature. 報告用這個詞來描述某種相關特徵。
Readers may encounter nonquota in descriptive or specialist writing. 讀者可能會在描述性或專業文本中看到這個詞。

meaning: 與人的種族無關或基於人類的種族
sentences: The company strictly follows a nonracial hiring policy. 這家公司嚴格遵守不分種族的招聘政策。
They are striving to build a truly nonracial society. 他們正努力建立一個真正沒有種族歧視的社會。
The technician placed the sample in a nonradiable box. 技術人員將樣本放入一個不可輻射的盒子裡。
Ensure that the testing equipment remains nonradiable during the experiment. 確保測試設備在實驗期間保持不可輻射的狀態。
The new antenna design is nonradiating in certain directions. 這個新的天線設計在某些方向是不輻射的。
We need a nonradiating heat source for this delicate project. 針對這個精細的專案，我們需要一個不具輻射性的熱源。
The politician took a nonradical approach to economic reform. 這位政治家採取了不激進的方式進行經濟改革。
She prefers nonradical solutions to everyday problems. 她更喜歡用不激進的方法來解決日常問題。
As a nonrailroader, he found the train operations very confusing. 身為一個非鐵路員工，他覺得火車的運作非常令人困惑。
The event is open to both train staff and any nonrailroader. 這個活動對火車工作人員和非鐵路員工都開放。
The radar system was switched to a nonranging mode. 雷達系統被切換到不測距的模式。
They installed a nonranging sensor to monitor the temperature. 他們安裝了一個不測距的感測器來監控溫度。
The nonratability of this unique asset makes it hard to sell. 這項獨特資產不可評級的屬性使其難以出售。
The committee discussed the nonratability of the new software. 委員會討論了這款新軟體無法評級的問題。
These items are nonratable because they lack standard measurements. 這些物品因為缺乏標準尺寸而是不可評級的。
The insurance company classified the old building as nonratable. 保險公司將這棟舊建築歸類為不可評級。
We watched a nonrated movie at the independent film festival. 我們在獨立電影節上看了一部未評級的電影。
The bank holds many nonrated bonds in its portfolio. 該銀行在其投資組合中持有許多未評級的債券。
The nonratifying countries refused to sign the climate agreement. 那些不批准協議的國家拒絕簽署這份氣候協定。
The nonratifying members left the meeting early. 那些不批准的成員提早離開了會議。
Older sources sometimes write nonrational as an alternative form of non-rational. 較早的資料有時會使用這個變體拼法。
Editors kept nonrational in the word bank so readers can recognize that variant spelling. 這筆資料保留下來，是為了讓讀者辨認這種變體拼法。

meaning: 一個不是理性主義者的人。
sentences: The speaker described himself as a nonrationalist in his latest speech. 演講者在最新的演講中形容自己是個非理性主義者。
As a nonrationalist, she relies more on intuition than logic. 作為一個非理性主義者，她更依賴直覺而不是邏輯。
The chaotic filing system remained completely nonrationalized. 這個混亂的檔案系統依然完全沒有合理化。
They struggled to understand his nonrationalized behavior during the meeting. 他們很難理解他在會議中那些未經合理化的行為。
We found a nonrayed flower growing near the river. 我們在河邊發現了一朵沒有放射狀花瓣的花。
The fish features a smooth, nonrayed dorsal fin. 這種魚具有光滑且無鰭條的背鰭。
His total nonreaction to the loud noise surprised everyone. 他對那巨大噪音完全無反應，讓大家都很驚訝。
The experiment failed due to the unexpected nonreaction of the chemicals. 實驗因為化學物質意外地無反應而失敗。
The scientist stored the acid in a nonreactive glass bottle. 科學家將酸液存放在不會起反應的玻璃瓶中。
Make sure to use a nonreactive pan when cooking tomatoes. 煮番茄時請務必使用不具反應性的鍋具。

meaning: 無法做出反應的人；一個沒有反應的人。
sentences: He was a complete nonreactor when they announced the surprise party. 當他們宣佈驚喜派對時，他是一個完全沒有反應的人。
In this allergy test, she was classified as a nonreactor. 在這次過敏測試中，她被歸類為無反應者。
The library aims to encourage every nonreader to pick up a book. 圖書館旨在鼓勵每個不讀書的人拿起一本書。
As a former nonreader, he now enjoys finishing a novel every week. 身為一個以前不讀書的人，他現在很享受每週看完一本小說。
He grew up in a nonreading household where there were no books on the shelves. 他在一個不讀書的家庭長大，書架上沒有任何書。
The study analyzed the habits of the nonreading population in rural areas. 這項研究分析了農村地區不讀書的人群的習慣。
The movie uses nonrealistic colors to create a dreamlike atmosphere. 這部電影使用了不切實際的色彩來營造如夢似幻的氛圍。
His painting style is nonrealistic and focuses more on emotions than details. 他的繪畫風格是不切實際的，比起細節，更注重情感的表達。
The dream felt so vivid that he was shocked by its nonreality when he woke up. 那個夢感覺非常生動，以至於他醒來時對其不真實感感到震驚。
The movie explores the nonreality of digital characters in virtual worlds. 這部電影探討了虛擬世界中數位角色的不真實性。
His nonrealization of the danger led him to walk into the dark forest alone. 他沒意識到危險，導致他獨自走進了黑暗的森林。
The project failed due to our nonrealization of how much time it would actually take. 專案失敗是因為我們沒有意識到實際需要花費多少時間。
The store refused to accept the return due to the customer's nonreasonable demands. 由於顧客不合理的要求，商店拒絕接受退貨。
His nonreasonable behavior at the party made everyone feel uncomfortable. 他在聚會上不合理的行為讓每個人都感到不舒服。
It is difficult to have a productive discussion with a nonreasoner who ignores facts. 與一個忽視事實、不講道理的人進行有效的討論是很困難的。
He is known as a nonreasoner who always lets his emotions dictate his decisions. 他是個出名的不講道理的人，總是讓情緒決定他的抉擇。
As a nonrebel, he always followed the school rules and never got into trouble. 作為一個不叛逆的人，他總是遵守校規，從不惹麻煩。
The group consisted of one radical student and several nonrebels who preferred peace. 這個小組由一名激進學生和幾名偏好和平、不叛逆的人組成。
She was a nonrebellious child who listened to her parents' advice. 她是個不叛逆的孩子，很聽父母的建議。
The students remained nonrebellious even after the principal announced the new strict rules. 即使在校長宣布了新的嚴格規定後，學生們依然沒有表現出叛逆。
The company apologized for the nonreceipt of your monthly payment notification. 公司對您未收到每月付款通知表示歉意。
Please contact our support team if you experience nonreceipt of the confirmation email. 如果您沒有收到確認郵件，請聯繫我們的支援團隊。
The device is currently in a nonreceiving state and cannot pick up any signals. 該設備目前處於不接收狀態，無法讀取任何訊號。
We need to fix the nonreceiving antenna before the broadcast starts. 我們需要在廣播開始前修好那個不接收訊號的天線。
The doctor asked about any nonrecent injuries that might be affecting my back now. 醫生詢問了可能影響我現在背部狀況的舊傷。
These documents contain nonrecent data that is no longer useful for our current report. 這些文件包含的數據不是最近的，對我們現在的報告已經沒有用了。
The nonreception of the radio signal was caused by the heavy mountain range. 由於山脈厚重，無線電訊號完全無法接收。
I am frustrated by the nonreception of my messages on this old phone. 我對這支舊手機無法接收訊息感到很沮喪。

meaning: 不是休息或與休息無關。
sentences: The teacher organized nonrecess activities to keep the students busy during the long afternoon. 老師安排了課堂活動，讓學生在漫長的下午保持忙碌。
We have to focus on nonrecess tasks before we can take a break. 我們必須先專注於非休息任務，然後才能休息。
If you are a nonrecipient of this grant, you can still apply for other loans. 如果你不是這筆補助金的受領人，你仍然可以申請其他貸款。
The email was accidentally sent to several nonrecipients who should not have seen the data. 這封郵件被誤發給了幾位不該看到這些數據的非收件人。

meaning: 不是互惠的；不以實物形式返還。
sentences: Their relationship was nonreciprocal, as she gave much more support than she received. 他們的關係並非互惠的，因為她給予的支持遠多於她所得到的。
The treaty was criticized for being nonreciprocal and favoring only one country. 該條約因缺乏互惠性且僅有利於一個國家而受到批評。
The factory uses a nonreciprocating engine that operates with a steady rotation. 工廠使用一種非往復式引擎，以穩定的旋轉運作。
He felt hurt by her nonreciprocating attitude toward his friendly gestures. 他對她不回應他的友好表現感到受傷。
The nonreciprocity of the trade agreement led to a lot of complaints from local farmers. 貿易協定的非互惠性質導致了當地農民的許多抱怨。
Psychologists often study the effects of nonreciprocity in long-term friendships. 心理學家經常研究長期友誼中缺乏互惠所產生的影響。
The student's nonrecital of the poem resulted in a lower grade for the oral exam. 學生未能背誦出那首詩，導致口試成績較低。
We were disappointed by the guest speaker's nonrecital of his famous speech. 我們對客座演講者未能朗誦他著名的演講稿感到失望。
The environmental agency focused on nonreclamation projects such as forest preservation. 環保署專注於森林保護等與土地復墾無關的計畫。
This budget is strictly for nonreclamation expenses in the coastal area. 這筆預算嚴格用於沿海地區與土地復墾無關的開支。
Although he likes his privacy, he is a nonrecluse who enjoys attending social events. 儘管他喜歡保有隱私，但他並非隱士，很享受參加社交活動。
My neighbor is a friendly nonrecluse who often invites the whole street for dinner. 我的鄰居是個友善且不避世的人，經常邀請整條街的人一起吃晚餐。

meaning: 不涉及利得或損失的確認。
sentences: The company benefited from the nonrecognition rules during the corporate merger. 公司在企業合併期間受益於不確認損益的規定。
He consulted an accountant to understand the nonrecognition status of his property exchange. 他諮詢了會計師，以了解他的財產交換是否符合不確認損益的狀態。
The small school remained nonrecognized by the government for several years. 這所小學校好幾年都沒得到政府的認可。
She felt frustrated that her hard work was nonrecognized by her manager. 她對經理不認可她的辛勤工作感到很沮喪。
The soldier practiced using a nonrecoil rifle to improve his accuracy. 士兵練習使用無後座力步槍以提高準確度。
Engineers are developing a nonrecoil mechanism for the new transport vehicle. 工程師正在為新型運輸車開發無後座力機制。
His nonrecollection of the events at the party suggested he had too much to drink. 他對派對上的事情毫無記憶，這顯示他喝得太多了。
Despite the lawyer's questions, the witness maintained her nonrecollection of the suspect's face. 儘管律師不斷詢問，證人仍堅稱她想不起嫌疑人的長相。
The committee's nonrecommendation for the project led to its cancellation. 委員會對該計畫未予推薦，導致其被取消。
After reviewing the application, the manager issued a formal nonrecommendation. 在審查申請後，經理正式發出了不推薦通知。
The long period of nonreconciliation between the two families caused much stress. 兩家人長期缺乏和解，造成了很大的壓力。
Despite several meetings, the dispute ended in nonreconciliation. 儘管開了幾次會，這場爭議最終仍未達成和解。

meaning: 一種融資形式的或與之相關的，通常是債務融資，其中貸款人在違約時的追索權僅限於抵押資產。
sentences: The company signed a nonrecourse loan to protect its other assets from risk. 該公司簽署了一項無追索權貸款，以保護其其他資產免受風險影響。
Under a nonrecourse agreement, the bank can only seize the mortgaged property. 在無追索權協議下，銀行只能沒收抵押的財產。

meaning: 不可恢復；永久損壞或遺失。
sentences: The technician explained that the data on the broken hard drive was nonrecoverable. 技術人員解釋說，損壞硬碟上的數據已無法恢復。
Many factory costs are nonrecoverable even if production stops. 即使停止生產，許多工廠成本也是無法收回的。

meaning: 不涉及恢復；工業過程的一部分，其中可重複使用的組件等未被回收。
sentences: The new waste treatment system uses a nonrecovery method for certain plastics. 新的廢物處理系統對某些塑料採用不回收法。
Engineers are trying to reduce the nonrecovery rate of precious metals during mining. 工程師們正努力降低採礦過程中貴重金屬的未回收率。
The designer chose a nonrectangular table to fit the unique shape of the room. 設計師選擇了一張非長方形的桌子，以適應房間的獨特形狀。
Most of the tiles in the bathroom are nonrectangular and have six sides. 浴室裡的大多數磁磚都不是長方形的，而是有六個邊。
The clerk noticed several nonrectified errors in the monthly report. 店員注意到月報中有幾處未糾正的錯誤。
Leaving the software bug nonrectified could cause security issues later. 讓軟體錯誤保持未修正狀態可能會在日後引起安全問題。
The doctor was concerned about the patient's nonrecuperation after the surgery. 醫生對病人手術後未能康復感到擔憂。
Continued stress at work often leads to physical nonrecuperation during the weekend. 工作中的持續壓力常導致週末期間身體無法得到恢復。
The business had a large nonrecurrent expense due to a one-time repair. 該企業因為一次性的修理而產生了一筆大額的非經常性支出。
The doctor assured the patient that the skin rash was nonrecurrent. 醫生向病人保證，這種皮疹不會復發。

meaning: 不反覆發生；僅發生一次。
sentences: The bonus is a nonrecurring payment that we only receive this year. 這筆獎金是一次性發放的，我們今年才領到。
We need to separate nonrecurring items from our regular monthly budget. 我們需要將非經常性項目與日常每月預算分開。

meaning: 缺乏救贖；未能贖回某物。
sentences: The nonredemption of the coupons before the expiry date was a waste of money. 在到期日前未能贖回禮券是一種金錢浪費。
The bank warned about the nonredemption of bonds that had reached maturity. 銀行對已到期債券未被贖回的情況發出了提醒。
The lawyer argued that the nonredressing of the error led to further damages. 律師辯稱，未能糾正這項錯誤導致了進一步的損害。
Continuous nonredressing of grievances can cause unrest in a community. 持續不補償委屈可能會引發社區不安。
Sucrose is a nonreducing sugar commonly used in many dessert recipes. 蔗糖是一種非還原糖，常用於許多甜點食譜中。
The filter is made of a nonreducing material that does not react with the liquid. 該過濾器由非還原性材料製成，不會與 liquid 發生反應。

meaning: 不屬於或不屬於參考（在各種意義上）。
sentences: The students are allowed to borrow nonreference books for two weeks. 學生獲准借閱非參考類圖書兩週。
The manager organized the nonreference files into a separate folder. 經理將非參考性質的文件整理到一個獨立的文件夾中。
These nonrefillable pens should be thrown away once the ink runs out. 這些不可填充的筆在墨水用完後就應該扔掉。
The hotel provides nonrefillable water bottles in every guest room. 飯店在每間客房都提供不可重複填充的瓶裝水。
As a nonreflector, he rarely thinks about his past mistakes or future goals. 作為一個不愛自我反省的人，他很少思考過去的錯誤或未來的目標。
The teacher tried to encourage the nonreflector students to write in their journals. 老師試圖鼓勵那些不善於反思的學生寫日記。
The public was disappointed by the nonreformation of the corrupt police department. 公眾對腐敗警局未能進行改革感到失望。
Economic nonreformation in the region led to long-term poverty. 該地區經濟未能改革導致了長期的貧困。
The scientist studied the nonrefraction of light when it passes through certain gases. 科學家研究了光線穿過某些氣體時不發生折射的現象。
Clear images in the experiment were a result of light nonrefraction. 實驗中清晰的影像是光線未折射的結果。

meaning: 不是冷媒或與冷媒無關。
sentences: The factory uses a nonrefrigerant gas to clean the delicate machine parts. 工廠使用非冷媒氣體來清潔精密機器零件。
Please make sure that this cooling system uses nonrefrigerant liquids. 請確保這個冷卻系統使用的是非冷媒液體。

meaning: 不加油，或在不加油的情況下行駛。
sentences: The pilot set a new record for the longest nonrefueling flight across the ocean. 飛行員創造了跨洋飛行中不加油的最長紀錄。
This electric car is capable of a three-hundred-mile nonrefueling trip. 這輛電動車能夠在不補給能源的情況下行駛三百英里。

meaning: 沒有反駁；未能反駁某事。
sentences: The lawyer argued that the nonrefutation of the evidence proved his client's innocence. 律師辯稱，未能反駁該證據證明了他的當事人的清白。
His nonrefutation of the rumors led many people to believe they were true. 他沒有反駁那些謠言，導致許多人相信那是真的。
His nonregardance of the safety warnings led to a minor accident. 他忽視安全警告的行為導致了一場小意外。
The teacher noticed the student's nonregardance of the basic classroom rules. 老師注意到了該學生對基本教室規則的漠視。
The judge made a decision nonregarding the personal opinions of the lawyers. 法官在不考慮律師個人意見的情況下做出了決定。
She continued her work nonregarding the loud noise from the construction site. 她不顧建築工地的巨大噪音，繼續她的工作。
Some types of nerve cells in the human brain are nonregenerating. 人腦中某些類型的神經細胞是不可再生的。
The forest uses nonregenerating resources that must be managed carefully. 這片森林使用了必須小心管理的不可再生資源。
The patient was diagnosed with nonregenerative anemia and needed a blood transfusion. 病人被診斷出患有再生不良性貧血，需要進行輸血。
This type of battery is nonregenerative and must be replaced once it is empty. 這種電池是不再生的，一旦電量耗盡就必須更換。

meaning: 不是董事會成員的人，尤其是史密森學會的成員
sentences: A nonregent may still attend the open session of the board meeting. 非董事會成員的人仍可以參加董事會議的公開環節。
He served as a nonregent advisor for the museum's expansion project. 他擔任該博物館擴建工程的外部顧問，並非正式董事。
The children enjoyed a nonregimented afternoon of free play in the park. 孩子們在公園享受了一個沒有約束、自由玩耍的下午。
The artist preferred a nonregimented lifestyle without a fixed daily schedule. 這位藝術家偏好沒有規律、不受管制的自由生活方式。
Nonregistered users can only view the main page of the forum. 未註冊的用戶只能瀏覽論壇的主頁面。
The police towed away the nonregistered vehicle that was parked on the street. 警方拖走了停在街道上的那輛未登記車輛。
The lawyer explained the nonregistrability of the generic trademark to the client. 律師向客戶解釋了這個通用商標無法註冊的原因。
Certain technical designs face nonregistrability under current local laws. 某些技術設計在當地現行法律下具有不可註冊性。
This specific domain name is nonregistrable due to ongoing copyright issues. 由於版權問題，這個特定的網域名稱是不可註冊的。
Common terms are often considered nonregistrable as official trademarks. 通用術語通常被認為是不能註冊為正式商標的。
Nonregistration of the marriage may lead to legal problems in the future. 未辦理結婚登記可能會導致未來的法律問題。

She was entirely nonresisting when the nurse gently took her arm for the injection. 當護理師輕輕拉起她的手臂打針時，她完全沒有抗拒。
The students used a nonresistive wire for the physics experiment. 學生們在物理實驗中使用了一根無電阻的導線。
This material is considered nonresistive under extremely low temperatures. 在極低溫下，這種材料被認為是不具電阻性的。
The nonresolvability of the conflict led to a permanent split in the team. 衝突無法解決導致了團隊永久決裂。
We had to close the support ticket due to the nonresolvability of the software bug. 由於軟體漏洞無法解決，我們不得不關閉該客服表單。
The error message indicated a nonresolvable system failure. 錯誤訊息顯示這是一個無法解決的系統故障。
They realized their differences were nonresolvable and decided to end the partnership. 他們意識到彼此的分歧無法解決，於是決定結束合作關係。
The speech was nonresonant with the younger audience, who felt disconnected from the topic. 這場演講沒有引起年輕觀眾的共鳴，他們覺得與這個話題脫節。
He tapped the metal pipe, but it produced a flat, nonresonant sound. 他敲了敲金金屬管，但它發出了一種平淡、沒有共鳴的聲音。
His behavior at the company dinner was highly nonrespectable. 他在公司晚宴上的行為非常不體面。
The neighborhood was once considered nonrespectable, but it has changed a lot recently. 這個社區曾經被認為是不正派的，但最近改變了很多。
The workers wore masks to protect themselves from nonrespirable dust particles. 工人們戴著口罩，以保護自己免受不可吸入粉塵顆粒的傷害。
The factory must ensure that nonrespirable toxic gases are safely vented. 工廠必須確保安全排放無法呼吸的有毒氣體。
Her consistent nonresponsibility led to her eventual dismissal from the team. 她一貫的不負責任最終導致她被團隊解僱。
The contractor claimed nonresponsibility for the damage caused by the storm. 承包商聲稱對風暴造成的損害不負責任。
The court criticized the company for its nonrestitution of the stolen funds. 法院批評該公司沒有歸還被盜用的資金。
The nonrestitution of the borrowed equipment delayed our project. 未能歸還借用的設備延誤了我們的專案。

meaning: 缺乏（身體或像徵性的）約束。
sentences: The child's nonrestraint in the moving vehicle is extremely dangerous. 孩童在行駛中的車輛裡沒有受到安全約束是非常危險的。
His complete nonrestraint when spending money quickly emptied his bank account. 他花錢時完全沒有節制，很快就掏空了銀行帳戶。
Members have nonrestricted access to the gym facilities at all hours. 會員可以隨時不受限制地使用健身房設施。
The files were moved to a nonrestricted folder so everyone could view them. 這些檔案被移到了一個不受限制的資料夾，以便大家都能查看。

meaning: 不受限制；不受限制的條件。
sentences: The new policy guarantees nonrestriction of free speech on campus. 新政策保證校園內的言論自由不受限制。
They enjoyed the nonrestriction of working from anywhere in the world. 他們享受著可以在世界各地工作的無拘無束。

meaning: 不具有限制性；不施加限制
sentences: The doctor advised him to wear loose, nonrestrictive clothing after the surgery. 醫生建議他在手術後穿著寬鬆、不具限制性的衣服。
The software operates under a nonrestrictive license for educational use. 該軟體在教育用途上以非限制性授權運作。
The nonresumption of train services caused massive delays for commuters. 火車服務未能恢復，給通勤者造成了嚴重的延誤。
We apologize for the nonresumption of the broadcast after the power outage. 對於停電後未能恢復廣播，我們深表歉意。
The story explores the permanent loss and nonresurrection of an ancient kingdom. 這個故事探討了一個古老王國永久的衰亡與無法復甦。
The nonresurrection of the canceled TV show left many fans disappointed. 被取消的電視節目未能復活，讓許多粉絲感到失望。
The patient had signed a do-not-resuscitate order, legally ensuring nonresuscitation. 病人簽署了放棄急救同意書，在法律上確保了不予急救。
The family discussed the ethics of nonresuscitation with the attending physician. 家屬與主治醫師討論了放棄急救的倫理問題。
The company has a strict nonretaliation policy for employees who report misconduct. 針對舉報不當行為的員工，公司有嚴格的禁止報復政策。
He promised nonretaliation against the players who complained about his coaching style. 他承諾不會對那些抱怨他執教風格的球員進行報復。

meaning: 缺乏保留；未能保留某物。
sentences: The nonretention of heat in the building makes it very cold in winter. 建築物無法保溫，使得冬天非常寒冷。
The soil's nonretention of water caused the crops to dry out quickly. 土壤無法保水，導致農作物很快就乾枯了。
He complained about his nonretentive memory after forgetting the grocery list again. 再次忘記購物清單後，他抱怨自己過目即忘的記性。
The nonretentive soil in the garden requires frequent watering during the summer. 花園裡不保水的土壤在夏天需要經常澆水。
Her nonreticence about her past mistakes made the interview very candid. 她對過去錯誤的直言不諱，讓這場面談顯得很真誠。
The politician's sudden nonreticence surprised the reporters at the press conference. 這位政治家在記者會上突然變得很健談，讓在場記者感到驚訝。
The doctor explained that the blurry vision was due to a nonretinal issue in the lens. 醫生解釋說，視力模糊是由於晶狀體而非視網膜的問題引起的。
Researchers are studying nonretinal pathways that help the brain process light. 研究人員正在研究幫助大腦處理光線的非視網膜路徑。

meaning: 與退休無關或與退休無關。
sentences: You can withdraw funds from your nonretirement account at any time without penalty. 您可以隨時從非退休帳戶中提款，而不會受到罰款。
The bank offers different interest rates for retirement and nonretirement savings. 銀行針對退休和非退休儲蓄提供不同的利率。
The nonretiring professor continued to teach three classes well into his eighties. 這位不退休的教授直到八十多歲仍繼續教授三門課程。
Despite her age, she remained nonretiring and started a new business last year. 儘管年事已高，她依然沒有退休，並在去年創立了一家新公司。
The criminal used a nonretraceable phone to make the anonymous calls. 罪犯使用無法追蹤的電話撥打匿名電話。
Some digital transactions are designed to be nonretraceable for privacy reasons. 為了隱私，某些數位交易被設計成無法追溯路徑。
His nonretractation of the false claims led to a lengthy legal battle. 他拒絕收回那些虛假指控，導致了漫長的法律訴訟。
Despite the pressure from the board, the manager's nonretractation remained firm. 儘管面臨董事會的壓力，經理仍堅持不撤回聲明。
Unlike cats, dogs have nonretractile claws that stay out all the time. 與貓不同，狗的爪子是不可伸縮的，一直都露在外面。
The surgeon identified a nonretractile piece of tissue during the operation. 手術過程中，外科醫生發現了一塊無法縮回的組織。
The nonretraction of the landing gear caused the pilot to return to the airport. 起落架未能收回，導致飛行員返回機場。
Doctors monitored the nonretraction of the patient's muscle after the injury. 醫生在受傷後監測患者肌肉無法收縮的情況。
The company's policy of nonretrenchment gave the employees a sense of job security. 公司不裁員的政策讓員工很有工作安全感。
During the economic crisis, the city's nonretrenchment of public services was praised. 在經濟危機期間，該市未縮減公共服務的舉措受到了稱讚。
The new tax law is nonretroactive and only applies to future earnings. 新稅法不具追溯效力，僅適用於未來的收入。
Most contract changes are nonretroactive unless both parties agree otherwise. 除非雙方另有約定，否則大多數合約變更都不具有追溯力。

meaning: 只允許空氣或液體沿著一個方向流動，不允許其返回。（閥門的）
sentences: Please install a nonreturn valve to prevent water from flowing back into the pump. 請安裝一個止回閥，以防止水流回幫浦。
The plumber checked the nonreturn pipe to ensure the heating system worked correctly. 水電工檢查了單向管，以確保暖氣系統運作正常。
These glass bottles are nonreturnable, so you should put them in the recycling bin. 這些玻璃瓶是不能退還的，所以你應該把它們放進回收桶。
The store has a strict policy that all sale items are nonreturnable. 商店有嚴格的規定，所有特價商品均不得退換。
The nonrevaluation of the property led to lower tax payments for the owner. 房產未經重新估價，導致屋主繳納的稅款較低。
Economists debated the impact of the currency's nonrevaluation on international trade. 經濟學家討論了貨幣未重估對國際貿易的影響。
She chose a nonrevealing dress for the formal dinner party. 她選了一件保守不暴露的禮服參加正式晚宴。
The spokesperson gave a nonrevealing answer to the reporter's specific question. 發言人對記者的具體問題給出了一個不透口風的回答。
The nonrevelation of the secret plan kept the competitors in the dark. 秘密計畫未被揭露，使得競爭對手全然不知情。
Many fans were disappointed by the nonrevelation of the hero's identity in the finale. 許多粉絲對大結局中英雄身份未獲揭曉感到失望。
He chose a path of nonrevenge, preferring to forgive rather than fight back. 他選擇了不復仇的道路，寧願原諒也不願反擊。
The community promoted a culture of nonrevenge to end the cycle of violence. 社區推廣不報復的文化，以結束暴力循環。
The city is trying to reduce nonrevenue water lost through leaking pipes. 該市正努力減少因水管滲漏而流失的無收入水量。
Airline staff often fly on nonrevenue tickets when there are empty seats. 航空公司員工在有空位時，經常使用不列入營收的機票搭機。
The technician ensured the machine was in nonreverse mode before starting it. 技術員在啟動機器前確保其處於非反轉模式。
The sequence of the numbers remained in their original, nonreverse order. 數字序列保持原始的、未顛倒的順序。
The court's initial decision remained nonreversed after the second hearing. 經過第二次聽證會後，法院最初的判決仍未被推翻。
He was glad to see the nonreversed polarity in the electrical circuit. 他很高興看到電路中的極性沒有被反轉。
Once you heat the plastic to this temperature, the chemical change is nonreversible. 一旦將塑料加熱到這個溫度，化學變化就是不可逆的。
The loss of data was nonreversible because no backup had been made. 由於沒有備份，數據的損失是無法挽回的。
The nonreversing motor only spins in a clockwise direction. 這台不反轉的馬達僅按順時針方向旋轉。
This escalator is a nonreversing model and only moves upwards. 這部電扶梯是不可逆轉型號，只能向上移動。
The nonreversion of the land to its former owner caused a legal dispute. 土地未歸還給前業主，引發了法律糾紛。
Scientists noted the nonreversion of the species to its wild form over generations. 科學家注意到，該物種在數代後仍未恢復到其原始野生形態。
Deleting files permanently makes the process nonrevertible. 永久刪除檔案會使該過程不可恢復。
The chemical reaction caused a nonrevertible change in the material. 化學反應導致材料發生了不可恢復的變化。
Certain administrative decisions are nonreviewable by the local court. 某些行政決定是地方法院無法審核的。
The final score given by the judge is nonreviewable according to the rules. 根據規則，裁判給出的最終分數是無法審核的。

meaning: 不是修訂版的；未能修改或修改。
sentences: This copy is a nonrevision of the textbook, so it contains the same errors. 這一本並非教科書的修訂版，因此包含同樣的錯誤。
The board's nonrevision of the outdated policy caused confusion among the staff. 委員會未能修改過時的政策，導致員工之間出現混亂。

meaning: 缺乏復興；未能復活某物。
sentences: The nonrevival of the traditional festival disappointed many local residents. 傳統節日未能復興讓許多當地居民感到失望。
Doctors were concerned about the nonrevival of the patient's natural breathing. 醫生對病人未能恢復自主呼吸感到擔憂。
The lawyer confirmed the nonrevocation of the agreement by both parties. 律師確認雙方均未撤銷該協議。
We need a document to prove the nonrevocation of your professional license. 我們需要一份文件來證明您的執業執照未被撤銷。
The soldiers remained nonrevolting during the coup and followed orders. 士兵們在政變期間未參加叛亂並服從命令。
Even during the protest, most of the crowd was nonrevolting and stayed calm. 即使在抗議期間，大多數群眾也沒有參加叛亂並保持冷靜。
The company introduced a nonrevolutionary but useful update to the software. 公司對軟體進行了並非革命性但卻很有用的更新。
Most of his ideas were nonrevolutionary and followed existing trends. 他的大多數想法都不是革命性的，而是遵循現有趨勢。

meaning: 非循環，特別是（金融）不是循環信貸或循環貸款。
sentences: The bank offered him a nonrevolving loan with a fixed repayment date. 銀行向他提供了一筆有固定還款日期的非循環貸款。
A nonrevolving credit line cannot be used again once it is fully paid off. 非循環授信額度一旦結清就不能再次使用。
Please give me a nonrhetorical answer so I can understand the facts. 請給我一個非修辭性的直接回答，好讓我了解事實。
The teacher asked a nonrhetorical question that required a specific answer. 老師提出了一個需要具體答案的非修辭性問題。
The modern poem consists of nonrhymed lines that focus on imagery. 這首現代詩由不押韻的詩行組成，重點在於意象。
Blank verse is a common form of nonrhymed poetry in English literature. 素體詩是英國文學中常見的一種不押韻詩歌形式。
Children sometimes find it hard to write nonrhyming verses for class. 孩子們有時覺得在課堂上寫不押韻的詩句很困難。
The lyrics were nonrhyming but still had a strong emotional impact. 歌詞雖然不押韻，但仍然具有很強的情感衝擊力。
The patient complained about a nonrhythmic heartbeat during the checkup. 病人在檢查時主訴心跳不規則。
We heard a nonrhythmic tapping sound coming from the old water pipes. 我們聽到舊水管發出沒有節奏的敲擊聲。
The club offers special activities for nonriding members during the weekend. 俱樂部在週末為不騎馬的會員提供特別活動。
He preferred a nonriding role in the parade to avoid getting tired. 他更喜歡在遊行中擔任不騎馬的角色，以避免疲勞。
The new packaging is made of a nonrigid material that bends easily. 新包裝由一種容易彎曲的非剛性材料製成。
The manager adopted a nonrigid approach to the office dress code. 經理對辦公室的著裝規範採取了不呆板的靈活做法。
The police tried to distinguish between a nonrioter and those causing trouble. 警方試圖區分非暴徒與那些製造麻煩的人。
As a nonrioter, he was allowed to pass through the security checkpoint. 作為一名非暴徒，他被允許通過安全檢查站。
The government limited water usage for nonriparian landowners in the area. 政府限制了該地區非沿岸土地所有者的用水量。
A nonriparian state might still have interests in how the river is managed. 非沿岸國家可能仍然對河流的管理方式感興趣。
They preferred a nonritualistic wedding ceremony held in a small garden. 他們更喜歡在小花園裡舉行一場不具儀式感的婚禮。
The therapist suggested a nonritualistic way to start the morning. 治療師建議用一種不具儀式感的方式開始早晨。
Although they work in the same field, they are nonrival colleagues. 雖然他們在同一個領域工作，但他們是互不競爭的同事。
Street lighting is a nonrival good because one person's use doesn't exclude others. 路燈是一種非競爭性商品，因為一個人的使用不會排除他人使用。
They decided to keep their relationship strictly nonromantic and professional. 他們決定保持純粹的非浪漫專業關係。
The movie is a nonromantic comedy about two coworkers in a laboratory. 這部電影是一部關於實驗室裡兩位同事的非浪漫喜劇。
The computer screen is fixed on a nonrotatable stand for safety. 為了安全，電腦螢幕固定在一個不可旋轉的支架上。
Make sure the nonrotatable part is securely locked into place during assembly. 組裝時請確保不可旋轉的部件已牢固鎖定到位。
The machine has a nonrotating blade that cuts through the metal sheets. 這台機器有一個不旋轉的刀片，可以用來切割金屬板。
This type of nonrotating chair is better for long hours of desk work. 這種不旋轉的椅子更適合長時間的桌案工作。
The engineer designed a nonrotative joint to connect the two main pipes. 工程師設計了一個非旋轉接頭來連接這兩根主管。
This nonrotative engine part requires less maintenance than moving parts. 這個非旋轉的引擎零件比活動零件需要的維護更少。
The table has a nonround shape that fits perfectly in the room's corner. 這張桌子是非圓形的，完美地契合在房間角落裡。
He looked for nonround stones to build the flat base of the wall. 他尋找非圓形的石頭來建造牆壁平整的基座。
Dealing with a major power outage is a nonroutine task for the crew. 處理重大停電對工作人員來說是一項非例行性任務。
The doctor ordered some nonroutine tests to check for rare medical conditions. 醫生訂購了一些非例行檢查，以查看是否有罕見的身體狀況。
Many nonroyal families attended the public festival in the park. 許多平民家庭參加了公園裡的公共節慶。
The museum displays several items that belonged to nonroyal citizens. 博物館展示了幾件屬於普通百姓的物品。
As a staunch nonroyalist, he argued for a democratic government. 作為一名堅定的非保皇主義者，他主張建立民主政府。
The nonroyalist group organized a meeting to discuss political reforms. 非保皇黨團體組織了一次會議來討論政治改革。
These nonrubber gloves are better for people with skin allergies. 這些非橡膠手套對皮膚過敏的人比較好。
The engineer chose a nonrubber material for the new seal. 工程師為新的密封件選擇了一種非橡膠材料。
Horses are nonruminant animals, unlike cows or sheep. 馬是非反芻動物，與牛或羊不同。
The vet explained the digestive system of nonruminant pets. 獸醫解釋了非反芻寵物的消化系統。

meaning: 偶蹄目非反芻動物的前亞目。
sentences: Biologists list Nonruminantia in reference works on classification. 分類參考資料會列出這個名稱。
The museum label mentions Nonruminantia when explaining the specimen's group. 標本標籤在說明所屬類群時也可能提到這個名稱。

meaning: 長襪等：採用互鎖縫線製成，以防止形成流線。
sentences: She bought a pair of nonrun stockings for the long flight. 她買了一雙防脫紗長襪，準備搭乘長途飛機。
These nonrun tights are very durable and last a long time. 這些防勾絲褲襪非常耐穿，可以用很久。
The doctor diagnosed a nonrupture condition after reviewing the heart scan. 醫生在查看心臟掃描後，診斷出一種非破裂性的病況。
Treatment for a nonrupture cardiac issue often involves daily medication. 治療非破裂性心臟問題通常需要每日服藥。
Most of the job opportunities are found in nonrural areas. 大多數的工作機會都出現在非農村地區。
Residents in nonrural districts often have better access to public transport. 非鄉村地區的居民通常能更方便地使用大眾運輸。
We used nonrustable screws for the outdoor wooden deck. 我們在戶外木地板上使用了不生鏽的螺絲。
The kitchen sink is made of a nonrustable metal alloy. 廚房水槽是由一種不生鏽的合金製成的。
The factory operates on a nonsabbatic schedule during the busy season. 在旺季期間，工廠按照非安息日的時程運作。
He chose a nonsabbatic day for the meeting to ensure everyone could attend. 他選擇了一個非安息日進行會議，以確保每個人都能參加。
This nonsaccharine sweetener is derived from natural fruit extracts. 這種非糖精甜味劑萃取自天然水果。
The lab tested the drink to confirm it contained nonsaccharine ingredients. 實驗室測試了這款飲料，以確認它含有非糖精成分。
The community leader held a nonsacerdotal position in the local organization. 社區領袖在當地組織中擔任非神職人員的職位。
He offered nonsacerdotal advice based on his legal experience. 他根據自己的法律經驗提供了非宗教性的建議。
The couple chose a nonsacramental ceremony for their wedding. 這對新人選擇了非聖禮式的婚禮儀式。
The bread used in the meal was for nonsacramental purposes. 用餐時使用的麵包並非用於聖禮。

The safety lecture was designed to be easy for any nonsailor to understand. 這場安全講座設計得讓任何非水手的人都能輕易理解。
The damaged goods were marked as nonsalable and removed from the shelf. 受損的貨物被標記為不可銷售，並從架上移除。
Due to the new regulations, the old car models became nonsalable. 由於新法規的緣故，舊款車型變得無法銷售。
The company employs many nonsalaried workers who are paid by the hour. 公司聘用許多按時計酬的非月薪制員工。
Nonsalaried positions often offer more flexibility for part-time students. 非月薪職位通常為兼職學生提供更多彈性。

The manager realized that the constant noise was nonsalutary for productivity. 經理意識到持續的噪音對生產力沒有好處。
The letter felt cold due to the complete nonsalutation at the beginning. 這封信因為開頭完全沒有問候語而顯得冷淡。
A nonsalutation in a formal email might be seen as a sign of hurry. 正式郵件中缺少問候語可能會被視為匆忙的跡象。
The philosopher wrote about the state of nonsalvation in modern life. 這位哲學家論述了現代生活中缺乏救贖的狀態。
In some stories, a life of nonsalvation is the ultimate punishment. 在某些故事中，沒有救贖的生活是最終的懲罰。
The monk discussed the causes of nonsanctification in the secular world. 僧侶討論了世俗世界中無法成聖的原因。
His feelings of nonsanctification led him to seek a more spiritual path. 他感覺自己缺乏神聖感，促使他尋求更具精神層面的道路。
The two countries signed a nonsanction trade agreement to encourage cooperation. 這兩個國家簽署了一項不涉及制裁的貿易協定以鼓勵合作。
Lawyers discussed nonsanction legal measures during the meeting. 律師們在會議中討論了與制裁無關的法律措施。

Her nonsanguine outlook on the economy influenced her decision to save more money. 她對經濟不樂觀的看法影響了她存更多錢的決定。

meaning: 缺乏理智；神智不清醒的情況；作為：
sentences: The court questioned his nonsanity at the time the contract was signed. 法院質疑他在簽署合約時是否處於神智不清的狀態。
Chronic stress can sometimes lead to a temporary state of nonsanity. 長期壓力有時會導致暫時性的理智喪失。
This vegetable oil contains a small amount of nonsaponifiable matter. 這種植物油含有少量的不可皂化物質。
Chemists separated the nonsaponifiable fats from the mixture in the lab. 化學家在實驗室中從混合物中分離出了不可皂化的油脂。
The customer expressed nonsatisfaction with the repair service provided. 客戶對所提供的維修服務表示不滿意。
Constant nonsatisfaction with one's work can lead to burnout. 對自己的工作持續感到不滿意可能會導致倦怠。
Modern diets often emphasize eating more nonsaturated fats for heart health. 現代飲食通常強調攝取更多的不飽和脂肪以維護心臟健康。
The chemist tested the liquid to see if it was a nonsaturated solution. 化學家測試了這種液體，看它是否為不飽和溶液。
The artist chose a palette with low nonsaturation for a calm effect. 藝術家選擇了飽和度較低的色調以達到平靜的效果。
Scientists measured the nonsaturation of the chemical compound in the sample. 科學家測量了樣本中化學化合物的不飽和度。
Using an old air conditioner is a nonsaving choice for the family budget. 使用舊冷氣對家庭預算來說是一個不省錢的選擇。

He was assigned a nonsawing task in the furniture factory today. 他今天在家具廠被分配了一項不涉及鋸切的工作。
The workshop offers nonsawing classes for beginners who are afraid of power tools. 工作坊為害怕電動工具的初學者提供不涉及鋸子的課程。
The hotel shower has a safety valve to ensure nonscalding water temperatures. 飯店的淋浴間裝有安全閥，以確保水溫不會燙傷人。
Parents always check that the bath water is at a nonscalding level for babies. 父母總是會檢查洗澡水是否處於不會燙傷寶寶的溫度。

meaning: 這不會縮放（調整大小或適應度量）。
sentences: This software icon uses a nonscaling font to maintain clarity. 這款軟體的圖示使用不會縮放的字體以保持清晰度。
The map layer is set to a nonscaling mode to show the fixed physical size. 地圖圖層被設定為不縮放模式，以顯示固定的物理尺寸。
The politician's background was clean and nonscandalous throughout his career. 這位政治家在他的職業生涯中背景乾淨，沒有任何醜聞。
The newspaper reported the nonscandalous details of the celebrity's quiet wedding. 報紙報導了這位名流低調婚禮中不具爭議性的細節。
The textbook provides nonschematized photos instead of simple drawings. 這本教科書提供了未經圖解化的照片，而不是簡單的圖畫。
He preferred a nonschematized explanation that captured all the messy details. 他偏好不經圖解、能捕捉所有雜亂細節的解釋方式。
The leaders tried to maintain a nonschismatic atmosphere within the local church. 領導者們試圖在地方教會內維持一個非分裂的氛圍。
The group remained nonschismatic despite having different opinions on the project. 儘管對計畫有不同意見，該小組仍保持團結，沒有產生分裂。

Her nonscholastic interests include hiking and playing the guitar. 她的校外興趣包括健行和彈吉他。

meaning: 非科學或特定的非科學領域
sentences: Students can choose between science and nonscience subjects in the third year. 學生可以在三年級時選擇科學或非科學科目。

meaning: 不科學，或缺乏科學嚴謹性。
sentences: His nonscientific approach to fixing the car relied on trial and error. 他用不科學的方法修車，完全靠反覆嘗試。
The survey was criticized for using nonscientific sampling methods. 這項調查因使用不科學的抽樣方法而受到批評。
The lecture was designed to be understood by any nonscientist in the audience. 這場講座的設計是為了讓聽眾中任何不是科學家的人都能聽懂。
As a nonscientist, he found the technical details of the report hard to follow. 作為一名非科學家，他覺得報告中的技術細節很難理解。
The first ten minutes of the game were nonscoring for both teams. 比賽的前十分鐘兩隊都沒有得分。
This practice match is a nonscoring event meant for training only. 這場練習賽是不計分的活動，僅用於訓練。
The mechanic recommended a nonscraping method to clean the delicate engine parts. 技師建議使用一種不刮傷表面的方法來清潔精密的引擎零件。
The new kitchen tool is designed for nonscraping use on non-stick pans. 這款新廚具設計用於不刮傷不沾鍋的塗層。
The priest explained why some traditional customs are actually nonscriptural. 牧師解釋了為什麼有些傳統習俗實際上並不符合聖經。
The theological debate focused on whether the new rules were scriptural or nonscriptural. 神學辯論集中在這些新規則是符合聖經還是不符合聖經。

meaning: 不是聖經主義者或與聖經主義者無關。
sentences: He adopted a nonscripturalist view when analyzing the ancient history of the region. 在分析該地區的古代歷史時，他採取了非聖經主義者的觀點。
The professor's nonscripturalist approach to literature focused on social context. 這位教授研究文學的非聖經主義方法側重於社會背景。
The manager's decisions often passed with nonscrutiny from the board. 經理的決定通常在董事會沒有審查的情況下就通過了。
Public nonscrutiny of the new law led to many unexpected problems. 大眾對新法律缺乏監督，導致了許多意想不到的問題。

meaning: 不隨季節變化；恆定的，永久的。
sentences: This store sells nonseasonal items like basic white t-shirts all year round. 這家店全年都販售像基本款白Ｔ恤這類不受季節影響的商品。

He preferred a life of nonseclusion and enjoyed meeting neighbors every day. 他偏好不隱居的生活，喜歡每天與鄰居見面。
The hotel offers a feeling of nonseclusion by placing rooms near the busy lobby. 這家飯店將客房設在繁忙的大廳附近，給人一種融入人群而非隔絕的感覺。
The company's policy of nonsecrecy allows employees to see all salary data. 公司不保密的政策允許員工查看所有薪資數據。
Government nonsecrecy is essential for a healthy and open society. 政府的資訊公開對於健康且開放的社會至關重要。
Her nonsecret hobby of collecting stamps is well known to all her friends. 她收集郵票的公開愛好是所有朋友都知道的事。
Please share the nonsecret parts of the meeting with the rest of the team. 請與團隊其他成員分享會議中非秘密的部分。
She spent most of her day on nonsecretarial tasks like marketing and sales. 她的大部分時間都花在行銷和銷售等非秘書性質的工作上。
The job requires some nonsecretarial skills, such as basic accounting. 這份工作需要一些非文書類的技能，例如基礎會計。
The doctor was concerned about the nonsecretion of certain enzymes in the stomach. 醫生很擔心胃部某些酵素缺乏分泌的情況。

The company adopted a nonsecretive policy regarding its financial reports. 該公司對其財務報告採取了不隱瞞的政策。
She is known for her nonsecretive nature and always shares her thoughts. 她以直率的性格聞名，總是會分享她的想法。
The lab results showed that the tumor was nonsecretory and did not produce hormones. 實驗室結果顯示該腫瘤是非分泌性的，不會產生荷爾蒙。

The charity provides food to everyone through a nonsectarian program. 該慈善機構透過一個無宗派色彩的計畫為所有人提供食物。

This nonsectional sofa is one large piece and cannot be taken apart. 這款非組合式沙發是一個完整的大件，無法拆開。
The report was a nonsectional document that covered all topics in a single flow. 這份報告是一篇不分章節的文件，一氣呵成地涵蓋了所有主題。
The government implemented a nonsectorial tax reform that affected all businesses. 政府實施了一項影響所有企業的不分部門稅制改革。
We need nonsectorial cooperation to improve the city's overall economy. 我們需要跨部門的合作來改善城市的整體經濟。
The private school follows a nonsecular curriculum focused on religious teachings. 這所私立學校遵循以宗教教義為核心的非世俗課程。
Many nonsecular holidays are celebrated with traditional ceremonies at the temple. 許多宗教節日都會在寺廟舉行傳統儀式來慶祝。

meaning: 不安全，或與安全不直接相關
sentences: He works in a nonsecurity role, managing the office supplies instead of the gate. 他從事非安保工作，負責管理辦公用品而非大門。

Doctors recommend a nonsedentary lifestyle to improve heart health. 醫生建議採取非久坐的生活方式來改善心臟健康。
The protest was peaceful and focused on nonseditious demands for better pay. 這場抗議活動很和平，重點在於要求提高薪資等非煽動性的訴求。
The court ruled that the pamphlet was nonseditious and did not threaten the state. 法院裁定這本小冊子不具煽動性，並未威脅到國家。

The school board promoted nonsegregation to ensure students of all backgrounds learn together. 學校委員會推廣不隔離政策，以確保所有背景的學生能一起學習。
The success of the neighborhood depends on the nonsegregation of its residents. 社區的成功取決於居民之間沒有種族或身分隔離。

meaning: 非癲癇發作的事件或症狀。
sentences: The patient experienced a nonseizure event caused by low blood sugar. 病人經歷了一次由低血糖引起的非癲癇發作事件。
Medical tests confirmed that the child's fainting spell was a nonseizure. 醫學檢查證實該名孩童的昏厥並非癲癇發作。
The nonselected applicants will receive an email notification by Friday. 未被選中的申請人將在週五前收到電子郵件通知。
We still need to find a use for the nonselected materials in the warehouse. 我們仍需為倉庫中未被選用的材料尋找用途。
His nonselection for the national team was a huge disappointment to his fans. 他未被選入國家隊，這讓他的球迷感到非常失望。
The nonselection of our city for the Olympics meant we saved a lot of money. 我們的城市未被選為奧運主辦地，這意味著我們節省了大量資金。
This nonselective weed killer will destroy every plant it touches. 這種無選擇性的除草劑會摧毀它接觸到的每一株植物。
The university has a nonselective admissions policy and accepts most students. 這所大學採取不篩選的招生政策，錄取大部分的學生。
The immune system is trained to attack nonself organisms like bacteria. 免疫系統受過訓練，會攻擊細菌等非自體的生物。
In biology, the body must distinguish between self and nonself cells. 在生物學中，身體必須區分自體細胞與非自體細胞。
Her nonselfregarding actions earned her the respect of the entire neighborhood. 她無私的行為贏得了整個鄰里的尊敬。
True charity involves a nonselfregarding desire to help others. 真正的慈善涉及一種不考慮私利的助人欲望。
The shop kept a few nonselling items as part of its permanent display. 這家店保留了一些非賣品作為永久陳列的一部分。
Staff focused on inventory during the nonselling hours of the early morning. 員工在清晨不對外銷售的時段專注於盤點庫存。
The candidate's nonsenatorial behavior during the debate surprised the voters. 候選人在辯論中不符合參議員身份的行為讓選民感到驚訝。
He held several nonsenatorial positions before running for the high office. 在競選高階職位之前，他曾擔任過幾個非參議院的職務。
Don't listen to office gossip; it's mostly complete nonsense. 不要聽信辦公室的閒言碎語；那大多完全是胡說八道（廢話）。
His explanation for being late earlier managing to be absolute nonsense. 他剛才對遲到的解釋竟然（能）是徹頭徹尾的胡言亂語（廢話）。
It would be nonsensible to go hiking in such heavy rain. 在這麼大的雨中去健行是不明智的。
Making a big purchase without research is a nonsensible decision. 不做研究就大筆消費是個不明智的決定。
The toddler told a nonsensical story about a flying blue cow. 那個幼兒講了一個關於飛天藍牛的荒誕故事。
It is nonsensical to blame the cat for the broken computer. 把電腦損壞歸咎於貓是沒有意義的。
The nonsensicality of the new law caused a lot of confusion. 這項新法律的荒謬性引起了很大的混亂。
We laughed at the pure nonsensicality of the movie's ending. 我們對電影結尾純粹的無意義感感到好笑。
He was talking nonsensically after being hit on the head. 他頭部受撞擊後，說起話來胡言亂語。
The computer program behaved nonsensically due to a software bug. 因為程式錯誤，電腦軟體的運作變得莫名其妙。
The nonsensicalness of his argument made it easy to ignore. 他的論點毫無意義，因此很容易被忽視。
She pointed out the nonsensicalness of the instructions provided by the store. 她指出了商店提供的說明書有多麼荒誕。

meaning: 胡言亂語的行為；如此產生的廢話。
sentences: The nonsensification of the original message happened during the translation. 原始訊息在翻譯過程中變成了胡言亂語。
He criticized the nonsensification of political debates in recent years. 他批評近年來政治辯論變得毫無意義的現象。

meaning: 有意或無意地視為、轉變為或創造胡言亂語。
sentences: Don't nonsensify the facts just to win the argument. 不要為了贏得爭論而把事實胡亂扭曲。
The static on the line managed to nonsensify her voice. 電話線路中的靜電干擾使她的聲音聽起來模糊不清。
This nonsensitive skin cream is safe for most people to use. 這種非過敏性的乳霜對大多數人來說都是安全的。
Use a nonsensitive microphone for recording loud drum sounds. 使用不敏感的麥克風來錄製響亮的鼓聲。
The nonsensitiveness of the sensor caused it to miss the movement. 感應器的遲鈍導致它沒能察覺到動作。
Her nonsensitiveness to criticism helped her succeed in the harsh industry. 她對批評的不敏感幫助她在這個競爭激烈的行業中取得成功。
The lab used nonsensitized paper for the initial light tests. 實驗室在初步的光學測試中使用了未感光的紙張。
He remained nonsensitized to the allergen even after multiple exposures. 即使經過多次接觸，他對該過敏原依然沒有產生過敏反應。
Mathematical concepts are often considered nonsensorial abstractions. 數學概念通常被認為是非感官的抽象事物。
He focused on nonsensorial data to make a completely objective decision. 他專注於非感官數據，以做出完全客觀的決定。
The artist preferred a nonsensuous style that focused on logic and form. 這位藝術家偏好一種專注於邏輯與形式而非感官享受的風格。
Philosophers often discuss nonsensuous beauty found in pure thought. 哲學家經常討論純粹思考中所發現的非感官之美。

meaning: 一個不會說話的人；一個啞巴。

sentences: The magazine is written in nonspecialist language for a general audience. 該雜誌以非專業的語言編寫，供一般讀者閱讀。

We need to address the nonspecificity of these medical tests. 我們需要解決這些醫療檢測的非專一性問題。
Please return the form even if the date is nonspecified. 即使日期未指定，也請繳回表格。
The workers left the site at a nonspecified time in the afternoon. 工人們在下午一個未指定的時間離開了工地。
The meal was nonspectacular but filled us up after the hike. 這頓飯並不壯觀，但讓遠足後的我們吃得很飽。
Her results in the race were nonspectacular this year. 她今年在比賽中的表現平平。
Purples are nonspectral colors because they are not in the rainbow. 紫色系是非光譜色，因為它們不在彩虹中。

The news report focused on nonspeculation and hard facts. 新聞報導專注於非推測性的內容和確鑿的事實。

The scientist gave a nonspeculative answer based on recent data. 科學家根據最近的數據給出了一個非推測性的回答。
The earth is slightly nonspherical because it bulges at the middle. 地球略呈非球形，因為它在中間隆起。

The baby used a nonspill bottle during the car ride. 寶寶在乘車時使用了防溢奶瓶。
I need a nonspill lid for my coffee cup in the office. 在辦公室裡，我的咖啡杯需要一個防溢蓋。

The satellite remained in a nonspinning position in space. 衛星在太空中保持著不旋轉的位置。
He threw a nonspinning ball to the other player on the field. 他把一個不旋轉的球扔給了球場上的另一位球員。
This type of leaf is nonspinose and smooth to the touch. 這種葉子沒有刺，摸起來很光滑。

meaning: 精神不振；無生命，無生命。
sentences: The doctor noticed his state of nonspirit after the long illness. 醫生注意到他在長期生病後精神不振的狀態。

This new fabric is advertised as being completely nonspottable. 這種新布料被宣傳為完全不會沾染污漬。
She looked for a nonspottable material for the kitchen curtains. 她在為廚房窗簾尋找一種不易弄髒的材料。
These nonsprouting seeds should be removed from the tray. 這些不發芽的種子應該從托盤中移除。
The farmer noticed some nonsprouting patches in the potato field. 農夫注意到馬齡薯田裡有一些不發芽的地方。
The laboratory technician identified a nonstainable component in the tissue sample. 實驗室技術員在組織樣本中發現了一個不可染色的成分。
Certain types of bacteria are nonstainable using this specific method. 某些類型的細菌使用這種特定方法是無法染色的。
This nonstaining oil is perfect for lubricating sewing machines. 這種不留污漬的油非常適合用來潤滑縫紉機。
We chose a nonstaining detergent to protect the delicate white rug. 我們選擇了一種不會染色的清潔劑來保護那塊脆弱的白色地毯。
The glossy surface of the photo is nonstampable because the ink won't dry. 照片的光滑表面無法蓋印，因為墨水不會乾。
Please use a different form as this one is nonstampable due to its texture. 請使用不同的表格，因為這張表格的質地無法加蓋印章。
The mechanic had trouble finding a replacement for the nonstandard bolt. 技工很難找到那個不標準螺栓的替代品。
Using nonstandard English in a formal essay might lower your grade. 在正式作文中使用不標準的英語可能會降低你的分數。
The school uses nonstandardized tests to evaluate student creativity. 學校使用非標準化的測驗來評估學生的創造力。
Collecting data from nonstandardized sources can lead to inconsistent results. 從非標準化的來源收集數據可能會導致結果不一致。
The poet chose a nonstanzaic form for her latest long poem. 這位詩人為她最新的長詩選擇了一種不分節的形式。
Nonstanzaic verse often reads more like a continuous flow of thought. 不分節的詩句讀起來通常更像是一種連續的思想流動。
The market sells both grains and various nonstaple vegetables. 這個市場既賣穀物，也賣各種非主食類的蔬菜。

The scientist isolated the nonstarch components from the flour sample. 科學家從麵粉樣本中分離出了非澱粉成分。

meaning: 一個沒有成功機會的專案。
sentences: The proposal to build a pool in the office was a complete nonstarter. 在辦公室蓋游泳池的提議完全是一個沒有成功機會的想法。

meaning: 沒有開始，或與某件事的開始無關。
sentences: The nonstarting players sat on the bench and cheered for their team. 沒上場先發的球員坐在長凳上為他們的球隊加油。

Use a nonsticky frying pan to cook the eggs more easily. 使用不沾鍋可以更輕鬆地煎蛋。

meaning: 不要求使用者彎腰；應用於砌磚工人的鷹架，鷹架的高度會隨著建造的牆壁而升高。
sentences: Builders prefer using nonstooping scaffolds to reduce back pain during work. 建築工喜歡使用不需彎腰的鷹架，以減少工作期間的背痛。
The new garden tool has a nonstooping handle for elderly users. 這款新園藝工具為老年使用者設計了不需要彎腰的長柄。

meaning: 不停歇；沒有中斷或中斷。
sentences: We took a nonstop flight from New York to London to save time. 為了節省時間，我們搭乘了從紐約直飛倫敦的航班。

Nonstriated tissues are found in many internal organs of the body. 無橫紋組織存在於人體的許多內部器官中。

Editors kept nonstriker in the word bank so readers can recognize that variant spelling. 這筆資料保留下來，是為了讓讀者辨認這種變體拼法。
Management tried to ensure the safety of nonstriking workers during the protest. 管理階層試圖在抗議期間確保非罷工員工的安全。
Nonstriking employees continued to operate the factory as usual. 未參加罷工的員工繼續照常運作工廠。

I bought a nonstriped shirt to match my patterned tie. 我買了一件純色無條紋的襯衫，用來搭配我的花紋領帶。
The earthquake only caused nonstructural damage to the office building. 地震只對辦公大樓造成了非結構性的損壞。
Decorations like curtains and rugs are considered nonstructural elements of a room. 窗簾和地毯等裝飾被認為是房間的非結構性元素。
The gym is open to both student and nonstudent members of the community. 體育館對社區中的學生和非學生會員開放。
A nonstudent group organized a local festival in the park. 一個非學生團體在公園組織了一場當地節慶。
Even a nonstudious teenager can find interest in science through hands-on experiments. 即使是不愛讀書的青少年，也能透過動手實驗對科學產生興趣。
He had a nonstudious attitude toward history but loved math. 他對歷史的態度並不勤奮，但非常喜歡數學。
The movie features nonstylized action scenes to make the story feel more real. 這部電影採用非風格化的動作場面，讓故事感覺更加真實。
The artist used a nonstylized approach to capture the landscape exactly as it appeared. 藝術家採用非風格化的手法，精確捕捉風景呈現出的原貌。
The focus shifted to a nonsubject that was irrelevant to the main discussion. 重點轉移到了一個與主要討論無關的非主題事項上。

The judge looked for nonsubjective evidence to make a fair decision. 法官尋找非主觀的證據來做出公正的裁決。
Scientific reports should be based on nonsubjective data and observations. 科學報告應基於非主觀的數據和觀察。

meaning: 這並不訂閱（信仰、期刊等）。
sentences: The nonsubscribing members of the church did not sign the new statement of faith. 該教會中不認同新信仰聲明的成員沒有簽署該文件。

meaning: 沒有補貼；未能補貼某事。
sentences: The policy of nonsubsidy for fossil fuels encouraged the use of clean energy. 不補貼化石燃料的政策鼓勵了清潔能源的使用。

sentences: The two countries agreed on several nontariff trade rules last month. 這兩個國家上個月就幾項非關稅貿易規則達成協議。
Import quotas are a common type of nontariff barrier to trade. 進口配額是貿易中常見的一種非關稅壁壘。
This silver ring is coated with a nontarnishable layer to keep it shiny. 這枚銀戒塗有一層不會失去光澤的塗層，以保持其亮度。
The lab uses nontarnishable metals for the sensitive equipment. 實驗室使用不會氧化變色的金屬製作精密設備。
She bought a set of nontarnishing spoons for the family dinner. 她買了一套不會失去光澤的湯勺供家人聚餐使用。
Gold is a nontarnishing metal that stays bright for a long time. 黃金是一種不會變色的金屬，能長時間保持光亮。
The scientist identified the compound as a nontautomeric form. 科學家鑑定該化合物為非互變異構形式。
This nontautomeric molecule remains stable under heat. 這種非互變異構分子在受熱時仍保持穩定。
The chemical structure is nontautomerizable due to its atoms. 由於其原子的排列，該化學結構是不可互變的。
He studied why certain molecules are nontautomerizable in this liquid. 他研究了為什麼某些分子在這種液體中是不可互變的。
The city budget includes both tax and nontax revenues. 城市預算包括稅收和非稅收收入。
Parking tickets are considered a type of nontax payment to the city. 停車罰單被視為交給城市的一種非稅金費用。
The accountant discussed the nontaxability of certain insurance payouts. 會計師討論了某些保險給付不需納稅的條件。
International treaties often define the nontaxability of diplomatic income. 國際條約通常會定義外交收入免稅的資格。
Some government grants are nontaxable for small business owners. 對小企業主來說，某些政府補助金是不需繳稅的。
You should list your nontaxable income on a separate form. 你應該在另一張表格上列出你的免稅收入。
The researchers used a nontaxonomic approach to group the plants by their height. 研究人員使用非分類學的方法，根據高度對這些植物進行分組。
This study focuses on the nontaxonomic characteristics of the local wildlife. 這項研究著重於當地野生動物在分類學之外的特徵。
Kindness is often considered a nonteachable trait that comes from within. 仁慈通常被認為是一種源自內心、無法透過教學獲得的特質。
Some skills are nonteachable and can only be acquired through years of experience. 有些技能是教不出來的，只能透過多年的經驗來獲得。
The school board includes one nonteacher to represent the parents' interests. 學校董事會包含一名非教職人員，以代表家長的利益。
As a nonteacher, she found it difficult to manage a large classroom of students. 身為一個沒有教學經驗的人，她覺得管理一整個教室的學生很困難。
The university employs a large nonteaching staff to handle administrative duties. 這所大學僱用了大量的非教學人員來處理行政事務。
Friday is a nonteaching day for the professors to focus on their research. 星期五是教授們不需授課的日子，讓他們能專注於研究。
The manual provides a nontechnical summary for the general public. 這本手冊為一般大眾提供了非技術性的摘要。
He explained the complex medical procedure in simple, nontechnical language. 他用簡單且非專業的語言解釋了複雜的手術過程。
Many people still enjoy nontechnological hobbies like gardening or painting. 許多人仍然喜歡園藝或繪畫等非科技類的嗜好。
The farmer used nontechnological methods to protect his crops from the cold. 這位農夫使用非科技的方法來保護他的作物免受寒害。
As a nonteetotaler, he enjoys a glass of red wine with his dinner. 身為一個不滴酒不沾的人，他喜歡在晚餐時喝一杯紅酒。
The party host made sure to provide drinks for both teetotalers and nonteetotalers. 派對主辦人確保為滴酒不沾者和飲酒者都提供了飲料。
His nontelegraphic style of writing makes the story much easier to follow. 他那非電報式的寫作風格讓故事更容易理解。
Please provide a nontelegraphic description of the incident in your report. 請在報告中對該事件提供非電報式的詳細描述。
Evolution is often described as a nonteleological process with no ultimate goal. 進化通常被描述為一個沒有最終目標的非目的論過程。
The philosopher argued for a nonteleological view of the natural world. 這位哲學家主張對自然界持有一種非目的論的觀點。
The manager requested nontelephonic updates via the company's app. 經理要求透過公司的應用程式進行非電話形式的更新。
Nontelephonic communication is sometimes better for keeping records. 非電話溝通有時更利於保存記錄。
Mathematicians often deal with nontemporal truths that do not change over time. 數學家經常處理那些不會隨時間改變、超越時間的真理。
The monk sought to focus his mind on nontemporal spiritual matters. 這位僧侶試圖將心靈專注於超越世俗時間的精神事務。
The report uses nontemporizing to describe a related feature. 報告用這個詞來描述某種相關特徵。
Readers may encounter nontemporizing in descriptive or specialist writing. 讀者可能會在描述性或專業文本中看到這個詞。
A nontenant is not allowed to enter the apartment building without an invitation. 非租客在沒有邀請的情況下不得進入這棟公寓大樓。
The landlord asked the nontenant to leave the property immediately. 房東要求那名非租客立即離開該物業。

meaning: 被告辯稱他/她不擁有該土地，並已確認。
sentences: The lawyer used nontenure as a defense in the property dispute case. 律師在財產糾紛案件中以「不擁有該土地」作為辯護理由。
His claim of nontenure was supported by old land registry records. 他關於不擁有該土地的主張得到了舊土地登記紀錄的支持。
The university offers many nontenurial positions for young researchers. 這所大學為年輕研究人員提供許多非終身制的職位。
He is working on a nontenurial contract that lasts for three years. 他正根據一份為期三年的非終身制合約工作。
The glossary explains that nonterm means That which is not a term. 詞彙表會說明這個詞的意思。
Readers may encounter nonterm in specialist books or historical writing. 讀者可能會在專業書籍或較早的文獻中看到這個詞。

meaning: 這並沒有終止；無休無止。
sentences: A nonterminating decimal goes on forever without stopping. 無休無止的循環小數會永遠持續下去而不會停止。
The computer got stuck in a nonterminating process and became hot. 電腦卡在一個無休止的程序中，變得發燙。
Scientists are searching for signs of nonterrestrial life on distant planets. 科學家正在遙遠的行星上尋找地外生命的跡象。
The deep-sea fish looked like a nonterrestrial creature from a science fiction movie. 這條深海魚看起來就像科幻電影裡的非陸地生物。
Some species of birds are nonterritorial and do not defend a specific area. 某些種類的鳥類不具領土性，不會守衛特定的區域。
The two countries signed a nonterritorial agreement to share maritime resources. 兩國簽署了一項非領土性的協議，以共享海洋資源。
The nonterritoriality of the tribe allows them to move freely across the plains. 該部落不具領土性的特徵使他們能夠在平原上自由移動。
Researchers noted the nonterritoriality of the wolves in this specific region. 研究人員注意到該特定區域的狼群缺乏領土意識。
The family received a nontestamentary gift from their uncle while he was still alive. 這家人在叔叔還在世時收到了他的一份非遺囑贈與。
Life insurance proceeds are often considered nontestamentary assets. 人壽保險金通常被視為非遺囑資產。
The presentation included many nontextual elements like charts and videos. 簡報包含了許多非文字元素，例如圖表和影片。
Students are encouraged to use nontextual sources for their history projects. 老師鼓勵學生在歷史專題中使用非文字的資料來源。
The film was released for nontheatrical use in schools and hospitals. 這部電影被發行用於學校和醫院等非戲院用途。
They organized a nontheatrical screening of the movie in the community center. 他們在社區中心組織了一場該電影的非戲院放映。
Many people find comfort in a nontheistic approach to life and ethics. 許多人在不信仰神靈的生活和倫理方式中找到了慰藉。
The group holds nontheistic meetings to discuss science and nature. 該團體舉行非神論會議來討論科學和自然。
The exhibit included several nonthematic pieces from the artist's early years. 展覽包括幾件該藝術家早年的非主題性作品。
He bought a pack of nonthematic stickers to decorate his laptop. 他買了一包非主題性的貼紙來裝飾他的筆電。
The report examined the conflict from a purely nontheological viewpoint. 該報告從純粹非神學的觀點審視了這場衝突。
There are many nontheological reasons why people visit this ancient temple. 人們參觀這座古廟有許多非神學的原因。
The library has a large collection of nontheosophical literature. 圖書館收藏了大量的非神智學文獻。
She prefers nontheosophical explanations for the mysteries of the universe. 她偏好對宇宙奧秘的非神智學解釋。
The doctor explained that the procedure was nontherapeutic and purely cosmetic. 醫生解釋說這項手術沒有治療作用，純粹是美容性質。
Nontherapeutic drugs are often used in laboratory experiments. 非治療性藥物常用於實驗室實驗。
He didn't want to be seen as a nonthinker who never asks questions. 他不想被看作是一個從不提問、不愛動腦筋的人。
The educator warned that the school system might produce nonthinkers. 教育家警告說，學校體制可能會培養出不思考的人。

meaning: 沒有經過深思熟慮就完成了
sentences: Breathing is usually a nonthinking action that happens automatically. 呼吸通常是一種自動發生的、不假思索的動作。
He made a quick, nonthinking comment that accidentally hurt his friend's feelings. 他說出了一句快速、沒經過深思熟慮的話，無意中傷害了朋友的感情。
The surgeon confirmed that the patient's pain was nonthoracic in nature. 外科醫生確認病人的疼痛本質上不屬於胸部。
Nonthoracic injuries were treated in a separate ward of the clinic. 非胸部受傷在診所的獨立病房中接受治療。
The glossary explains that nonthoroughfare means rare or specialized English term. 詞彙表會說明這個詞的意思。
Readers may encounter nonthoroughfare in specialist books or historical writing. 讀者可能會在專業書籍或較早的文獻中看到這個詞。
This machine requires a nonthreaded screw to hold the parts together. 這台機器需要一個無螺紋螺絲來將零件固定在一起。
The plumber installed a nonthreaded connector to fix the leaky pipe. 水電工安裝了一個無螺紋連接器來修復漏水的管子。
The scientist studied the nontidal areas of the river bank. 科學家研究了河岸不受潮汐影響的區域。
Plants in nontidal wetlands do not need to survive salty water. 非潮汐濕地的植物不需要在鹹水中生存。
The farmer left the nontillable slopes for the goats to graze. 農夫把無法耕種的山坡留給山羊吃草。
They decided to build the new barn on a piece of nontillable land. 他們決定在一段無法耕種的土地上建造新的穀倉。
The hikers reached a nontimbered ridge and saw the whole valley. 登山者到達了一處沒有林木的山脊，看見了整個山谷。
It is easier to walk across the nontimbered parts of the hill. 在小山沒有樹木遮蔽的地方走路比較容易。
The lab confirmed the iron ore was a nontitaniferous variety. 實驗室確認該鐵礦石是不含鈦的品種。
Miners avoid the nontitaniferous layers of the rock during extraction. 礦工在開採過程中會避開不含鈦的岩層。
She holds a nontitular leadership role within the local community. 她在當地社區擔任沒有正式頭銜的領導職務。
The manager gave him many nontitular responsibilities after the promotion. 經理在升職後給了他許多不具名義的職責。
Late arrival is a nontolerated behavior during the final exam. 期末考試期間不容許遲到行為。
The school maintains a list of nontolerated actions for all students. 學校為所有學生列出了一份不被容忍的行為清單。
The report focuses on nontopographical factors like climate and soil. 報告側重於氣候和土壤等非地形因素。
We discussed nontopographical reasons for the change in the local economy. 我們討論了導致當地經濟變化的非地形原因。
The small cafe is a popular spot for nontourists living in the area. 這間小咖啡館是居住在該地區的非遊客喜愛的去處。
As a nontourist, he knows the best time to visit the local market. 身為在地人，他知道造訪當地市場的最佳時間。
The art teacher only uses nontoxic glue for the children's projects. 美術老師只在兒童美勞課上使用無毒膠水。
Make sure the cleaning spray you buy is nontoxic to pets. 確保你購買的清潔噴霧對寵物無毒。

meaning: 不涉及或不涉及牽引力。
sentences: The technician checked the nontraction parts of the elevator motor. 技術人員檢查了電梯馬達中與牽引力無關的零件。
The test measured nontraction forces acting on the train wheels. 測試測量了作用於火車輪子上的非牽引力。
The committee discussed nontrade issues such as environmental safety. 委員會討論了環境安全等非貿易議題。
These items are for personal use and fall into the nontrade category. 這些物品僅供個人使用，屬於非貿易類別。
Even a nontrader can see that the market prices are rising. 即使不是交易員，也能看出市場價格正在上漲。
The video explains financial concepts in simple terms for the nontrader. 這段影片用簡單的術語為非專業人士解釋金融概念。

meaning: 不傳統；與傳統無關，非傳統。
sentences: The family decided to have a nontraditional dinner on Christmas Day. 這家人決定在聖誕節吃一頓非傳統的晚餐。
He uses a nontraditional method to solve difficult math problems. 他使用一種非傳統的方法來解決困難的數學問題。
The movie has a nontragic ending that everyone enjoyed. 這部電影有一個皆大歡喜的非悲劇結局。
We were relieved to hear the nontragic news from the hospital. 聽到醫院傳來這個不具悲劇性的消息，我們鬆了一口氣。
We planted nontrailing flowers in the window box this year. 我們今年在窗台花箱裡種了不會垂懸的花。
This nontrailing plant is perfect for small indoor spaces. 這種不會爬蔓的植物非常適合室內小空間。
The policy clearly states the nontransferability of the insurance plan. 該保單清楚說明了這項保險計劃的不可轉讓性。

The coupon is nontransferable and cannot be given to a friend. 該優惠券不可轉讓，不能送給朋友使用。
All staff ID cards are nontransferable for security reasons. 出於安全原因，所有員工識別卡均不可轉讓。

meaning: 沒有違規行為；不違法的行為。
sentences: Living a life of nontransgression brings peace of mind to many people. 過著遵紀守法的生活讓許多人感到心安。
The report praised the team for their nontransgression of safety protocols. 報告表揚了團隊沒有違反任何安全協議。
The paint provides a nontransient color that will not fade in the sun. 這種油漆提供的顏色是持久的，不會在陽光下褪色。
Moving to this city was a nontransient decision for our family. 搬到這個城市對我們家來說是一個長期的決定。
The office has a nontransitional layout that is designed for efficiency. 辦公室採用了非過渡性的佈局，旨在提高效率。
She prefers nontransitional furniture with a very classic look. 她更喜歡具有非常經典外觀的非過渡性家具。
Medical tests showed the nontranslocation of the tumor to other organs. 醫學檢查顯示腫瘤沒有移位到其他器官。
The scientist studied the nontranslocation of proteins during the cell cycle. 科學家研究了細胞週期中蛋白質沒有發生易位的現象。
A broken cable caused the nontransmission of the radio signal. 電纜斷裂導致無線電信號無法傳輸。
The filter ensures the nontransmission of harmful rays. 過濾器確保有害射線不會被傳輸過來。
The nontransparency of the envelope keeps the letter private. 信封的不透明特性保護了信件的私密性。
Customers complained about the nontransparency of the service fees. 客戶抱怨服務費用的不透明。

meaning: 不透明；缺乏透明度；不透明。
sentences: The windows were covered with a nontransparent film for privacy. 窗戶上貼了一層不透明的薄膜以保護隱私。
Use a nontransparent container to store the light-sensitive liquid. 使用不透明的容器來存放對光敏感的液體。
The budget includes nontransportation items like food and housing. 預算包括了食物和住房等非運輸項目。
They offer nontransportation assistance for the elderly in the community. 他們為社區老人提供與交通無關的協助。
The computer uses a nontransposing process to handle the database. 電腦使用一種不轉置的程序來處理數據庫。
He followed a nontransposing sequence to arrange the music notes. 他按照一個不轉置的順序來排列音符。
The nontransposition of the characters in the code was essential. 代碼中的字符沒有發生換位是至關重要的。
We confirmed the nontransposition of the elements in the final mixture. 我們確認了最終混合物中的元素沒有發生易位。
As a nontraveler, she finds joy in exploring her own neighborhood. 作為一個不愛旅行的人，她從探索自己的社區中找到樂趣。
The marketing campaign targets both the frequent traveler and the nontraveler. 這次行銷活動的目標對象包括常客和不旅行的人。
He prefers a nontraveling lifestyle so he can be with his kids. 他更喜歡不需出差的生活方式，這樣他就能陪伴孩子。
The company hired a nontraveling consultant to work in the main office. 公司聘請了一位在總部工作的非出差顧問。
The activist insisted that her protests were nontreasonable. 該活動人士堅稱她的抗議行為並非叛國。
Sharing public information is a nontreasonable act. 分享公開信息並非叛國行為。
This nontreated wood will change color naturally over time. 這種未經處理的木材會隨著時間自然改變顏色。
The study compared the nontreated group with the patients taking medicine. 該研究將未接受治療的組別與服藥的患者進行了比較。
The doctor explained the role of nontreatment during the consultation. 醫師說明時會提到這個部位或概念的作用。
The training diagram labels nontreatment beside the related anatomy. 教學圖示也可能把這個名稱標在相關解剖部位旁邊。

meaning: 不屬於條約或與條約無關。
sentences: The group signed a nontreaty document to show their cooperation. 該團體簽署了一份非條約文件以顯示他們的合作。
These are nontreaty obligations that the country still follows. 這些是該國仍在遵循的非條約義務。
The property has a strict nontrespass policy to protect the wildlife. 該領地有嚴格的禁止擅闖政策以保護野生動物。
Good fences help maintain the nontrespass of private gardens. 良好的籬笆有助於維持私人花園的不受侵擾。

meaning: 不屬於或不涉及司法審判。
sentences: The lawyers met for a nontrial discussion before the case started. 律師們在案件開始前進行了一次非審判性的討論。
Most nontrial evidence must be submitted to the court in advance. 大多數非審判期間的證據必須提前提交給法院。
The program provides water for both tribal and nontribal farms. 該計劃為部落和非部落農場都提供用水。
Many nontribal people live in the modern cities of that region. 許多非部落人士生活在該地區的現代城市中。

meaning: 一個不是部落成員的人。
sentences: The village welcomes any nontribesman who wants to learn their language. 這個村莊歡迎任何想學習他們語言的非部落成員。
The council allowed a nontribesman to speak at the public meeting. 委員會允許一位非部落成員在公開會議上發言。
The independent state remained nontributary to the empire for centuries. 這個獨立的國家幾個世紀以來都沒有向帝國進貢。
They discovered a nontributary water source deep underground. 他們在地下深處發現了一個不屬於任何水系的獨立水源。

meaning: 沒有嘗試過某種產品或消遣性毒品等東西的人。
sentences: As a nontrier of coffee, she found the taste of the espresso too bitter. 作為一個從未喝過咖啡的人，她覺得這杯濃縮咖啡的味道太苦了。

meaning: 蒙脫石族富含鐵的黏土礦物
sentences: The geologists found layers of nontronite in the rock samples from Mars. 地質學家在火星岩石樣本中發現了綠脫石岩層。
