This software has both tutorial and nontutorial modes for different users. 這款軟體為不同的使用者提供了教學與非教學兩種模式。
The child suffered from a nontyphoidal Salmonella infection after eating the chicken. 孩子吃下雞肉後感染了非傷寒沙門氏菌。
Nontyphoidal strains usually cause milder stomach issues compared to other types. 與其他類型相比，非傷寒菌株通常只會引起較輕微的腸胃問題。
His physical reaction to the new medication was highly nontypical. 他對這種新藥物的生理反應非常不典型。
The architect designed a nontypical roof for the modern office building. 建築師為這棟現代化辦公大樓設計了一個非典型的屋頂。
The nontypicalness of the weather this year surprised many local farmers. 今年天氣的異常情況讓許多當地農民感到驚訝。

The editor corrected several nontypographical errors in the original manuscript. 編輯修正了原稿中幾個非排版相關的錯誤。
They used nontypographical symbols to decorate the creative wedding invitation. 他們使用了一些非印刷字體的符號來裝飾這份充滿創意的婚禮請柬。
The team appreciated their manager's nontyrannical leadership style. 團隊很欣賞經理不專制的領導風格。
They established a nontyrannical government immediately after the revolution. 他們在革命後立即建立了一個非暴政的政府。
Unlike smartphones, virtual reality headsets are still a nonubiquitous technology. 與智慧型手機不同，虛擬實境頭戴裝置仍然是一項尚未普及的技術。

The doctor confirmed that the stomach pain was caused by a nonulcerous condition. 醫生確認胃痛是由非潰瘍性疾病引起的。
She bought a special medical cream to treat the nonulcerous skin irritation. 她買了一種特殊的藥膏來治療非潰瘍性的皮膚刺激。
Proteins in the blood are usually nonultrafilterable molecules due to their large size. 由於體積龐大，血液中的蛋白質通常是不可超濾的分子。
The lab technician carefully separated the ultrafilterable and nonultrafilterable substances. 實驗室技術員小心地將可超濾與不可超濾的物質分離開來。
The surgeon found a nonumbilical hernia during the routine medical examination. 外科醫生在例行健康檢查時發現了一個非臍疝氣。
They relied on a nonumbilical power source for the autonomous underwater robot. 他們為這台自主水下機器人使用了非繫繩式的電源。
The snail has a nonumbilicate shell with a perfectly smooth outer surface. 這隻蝸牛的殼沒有臍孔，外表面非常光滑。
Researchers classified the new mushroom species by its distinctive nonumbilicate cap. 研究人員根據其獨特的無臍狀凹陷菌蓋來對這種新蘑菇進行分類。
Several nonumbrellaed people were running through the sudden rain. 好幾個沒帶傘的人在突如其來的雨中奔跑。

The historian found a nonuncial inscription on the stone wall. 歷史學家在石牆上發現了一處非安色爾體的銘文。
The student practiced writing nonuncial letters in his notebook. 學生在筆記本上練習書寫非安色爾體字母。
The library workshop is open to both undergraduate and nonundergraduate students. 這場圖書館工作坊對大學部學生及非大學部學生皆開放。
Nonundergraduates must pay a completely different tuition fee for this advanced course. 非大學部學生修這門進階課程必須繳交完全不同的學費。
The handwriting on the old letter is almost nonunderstandable. 這封舊信上的字跡幾乎無法理解。
The complex instructions were completely nonunderstandable to the beginners. 這些複雜的說明對初學者來說完全無法理解。
A look of nonunderstanding crossed his face during the lecture. 演講中，他的臉上露出了不解的神情。
Her nonunderstanding of the rules led to several mistakes. 她對規則的不理解導致了幾次錯誤。

The student stared nonunderstandingly at the difficult math problem. 學生不解地盯著那道數學難題。
Some nonunderstood aspects of the virus are still being studied. 這種病毒一些尚未被理解的特徵仍在研究中。
The reason for the machine's sudden failure remains nonunderstood. 機器突然故障的原因仍然不被理解。
The scientist observed a nonundulatory pattern in the light particles. 科學家在光粒子中觀察到了一種非波動的模式。
The surface remained nonundulatory despite the constant pressure. 儘管有持續的壓力，表面依然保持不波動的狀態。
The paint dried with a nonuniform texture on the wall. 牆上的油漆乾燥後紋理不均勻。
The city has nonuniform rules for parking in different districts. 這座城市不同區域的停車規則不統一。
The nonuniformist argued that major floods shaped the local landscape. 非均變論者主張大洪水塑造了當地的地貌。
Scientific debate between the uniformist and the nonuniformist continues. 均變論者與非均變論者之間的科學辯論仍在繼續。
The researcher proposed a nonuniformitarian explanation for the rock layers. 研究人員對這些岩層提出了一種非均變論的解釋。
Many early scientists held nonuniformitarian views about Earth's history. 許多早期的科學家對地球歷史持有非均變論的觀點。
The nonuniformity of the soil made it difficult to grow crops. 土壤的不均勻性使得種植農作物變得困難。
Engineers must account for the nonuniformity of the materials used in the bridge. 工程師必須考慮到橋樑所用材料的不均勻性。
The soup heated nonuniformly in the microwave, so some parts were cold. 湯在微波爐裡受熱不均勻，所以有些地方是冷的。
The wind blew nonuniformly across the field during the storm. 暴風雨期間，風在田野上吹得並不均勻。

meaning: 不屬於工會；沒有加入工會。

sentences: The growth of nonunionism changed the local labor market. 非工會主義的增長改變了當地的勞動力市場。

She took several nonuniversity courses to improve her skills. 她修了幾門非大學課程來提升自己的技能。

We bought simple nonupholstered chairs for the dining room. 我們為飯廳買了簡單的無軟墊椅子。

sentences: The pianist struggled to play the rapid nonuplet correctly. 鋼琴家努力想把那段快速的九連音彈奏正確。

Many people prefer the quiet life in nonurban areas. 許多人喜歡非城市地區的寧靜生活。
The nonurban landscape was filled with rolling hills and farms. 非城市景觀中充滿了起伏的丘陵和農場。
Patients with nonurgent issues can wait longer for an appointment. 問題不緊急的病人可以等較久再預約。
Please handle the nonurgent emails after you finish the main report. 請在完成主報告後再處理那些不緊急的郵件。
The printer broke down due to long periods of nonusage. 這台印表機因為長期不使用而故障了。

sentences: The software interface should be simple enough for a nonuser to understand. 軟體介面應該要簡單到連沒用過的人也能理解。

sentences: The study compared a group of drug users with a nonusing control group. 這項研究將一群藥物使用者與一個不吸毒的對照組進行比較。

The biopsy confirmed that the cells were of nonuterine origin. 活體組織切片證實這些細胞並非源自子宮。

She values the nonutilitarian aspects of art, such as beauty and emotion. 她重視藝術中非功利的層面，例如美感與情感。

There are still many nonutilized resources in our local community. 我們的在地社區中仍有許多尚未開發利用的資源。

meaning: 缺乏言語；透過言語以外的方式溝通。
sentences: The actor used nonutterance and gestures to convey deep sadness. 演員透過不說話和手勢來表達深沉的哀傷。

meaning: 沒有接種疫苗；未接種疫苗。
sentences: The school requires a medical reason for any case of nonvaccination. 學校要求對任何未接種疫苗的情況提供醫療證明。

The doctor recommended a nonvaginal ultrasound for the patient. 醫生建議病人進行非陰道式的超音波檢查。

Certain gases are nonvalent and do not react with other chemicals. 某些氣體是零價的，不會與其他化學物質發生反應。

The engineer proposed a nonvalve design to simplify the cooling system. 工程師提出了一種不含閥門的設計，以簡化冷卻系統。
This pump uses a nonvalve mechanism to move fluids efficiently. 這台泵浦使用不涉及閥門的機制來有效移動流體。

meaning: 表達式（尤其是函數）在指定集合或整個域上的任何位置的值均非零。
sentences: The mathematical proof depends on the nonvanishing property of the function. 這個數學證明取決於該函數非零的特性。
Ensure that the denominator is a nonvanishing expression in your calculation. 在計算中，請確保分母是一個非零的表達式。
The speed of light is a nonvariable factor in many scientific equations. 在許多科學等式中，光速是一個不變的常數。
We kept the temperature nonvariable throughout the entire experiment. 我們在整個實驗過程中保持溫度不變。
This version of the software is the nonvariant, standard release. 這個版本的軟體是標準版，而非變體。
The linguist studied the nonvariant forms of the ancient dialect. 語言學家研究了這種古代方言中沒有變異的形式。
The nonvariation in the product's quality has helped build customer trust. 產品品質始終如一，有助於建立客戶的信任。
We observed a surprising nonvariation in the bird's nesting habits. 我們觀察到這種鳥類的築巢習性竟然完全沒有變化。
Moss is a type of nonvascular plant that grows in damp places. 苔蘚是一種生長在潮濕地方的非維管束植物。
The cornea is a nonvascular tissue, meaning it has no blood vessels. 角膜是一種非血管組織，意即它內部沒有血管。
The lord only collected taxes from his vassals, leaving the nonvassal farmers alone. 領主只向他的封臣徵稅，不干涉那些非封臣的農民。
As a nonvassal, he was not required to provide military service to the king. 作為一名非封臣，他不需要向國王提供軍事服務。
The patient moved his fingers, showing he was in a nonvegetative state. 病人移動了手指，顯示他並非處於植物人狀態。
Doctors use several tests to confirm that the brain injury is nonvegetative. 醫生使用多項測試來確認大腦損傷並非屬於植物人性質。
The rash turned out to be a nonvenereal skin infection. 診斷結果顯示，這紅疹只是普通的皮膚感染，並非性病。
Some symptoms might look suspicious but are actually nonvenereal in nature. 某些症狀看起來可能令人懷疑，但實際上本質上並非性傳染病。
Older sources sometimes write nonvenomous as an alternative form of non-venomous. 較早的資料有時會使用這個變體拼法。
Editors kept nonvenomous in the word bank so readers can recognize that variant spelling. 這筆資料保留下來，是為了讓讀者辨認這種變體拼法。

This specific injection should be given into nonvenous tissue for better absorption. 為了更好的吸收，這種特定的注射應打在非靜脈組織中。
The nonventilation of the basement caused a strong smell of mold to develop. 地室缺乏通風導致霉味變得很重。
Workers complained that the nonventilation in the factory made it hard to breathe. 工人們抱怨工廠無法通風，讓他們呼吸困難。
Older sources sometimes write nonverbal as an alternative form of non-verbal. 較早的資料有時會使用這個變體拼法。

The baker shaped the white frosting into a soft, nubiform design on the cake. 麵包師傅將蛋糕上的白色糖霜擠成柔軟的雲狀圖案。
We watched the nubiform smoke rise slowly from the chimney. 我們看著雲狀的煙從煙囪裡緩緩升起。
The scientists analyzed the nubigenous moisture to understand the storm. 科學家分析了源自雲層的濕氣，以了解這場風暴。
Legend says the mountain lake was formed by nubigenous waters. 傳說這座高山湖泊是由雲層降下的水所形成的。
The thick fog began to nubilate the path ahead, making it hard to drive. 濃霧開始讓前方的道路變得模糊不清，導致駕駛困難。
Heavy smoke from the fire will nubilate the sky in the afternoon. 大火產生的濃煙將在下午遮蔽天空。
The sudden nubilation of the valley reduced visibility to almost zero. 山谷突然陰雲密布，導致能見度幾乎降至零。
The strong medicine caused a temporary nubilation of his mind. 那種強效藥物導致他的心智短暫陷入困惑。

meaning: 已達適婚年齡；可結婚（主要是年輕女子）。[從17世紀開始]
sentences: In the traditional village, nubile women attended the spring festival to meet potential husbands. 在傳統村莊裡，適婚女子會參加春季慶典來認識未來的丈夫。
The royal family arranged a grand party for their nubile daughter. 皇室為他們已達適婚年齡的女兒舉辦了一場盛大的派對。
The legal age of nubility varies significantly across different countries. 許多國家的法定適婚年齡有很大的差異。
Historically, a woman's nubility was often decided by her parents. 在歷史上，女性的適婚狀態通常是由她的父母決定的。
The hikers struggled to see the path through the nubilous mountain air. 登山客在雲霧繚繞的山間空氣中，難以看清路徑。
Her memory of the event was nubilous and lacked specific details. 她對那次事件的記憶很模糊，缺乏具體細節。
The report uses Nubilum to describe a related feature. 報告用這個詞來描述某種相關特徵。
Readers may encounter Nubilum in descriptive or specialist writing. 讀者可能會在描述性或專業文本中看到這個詞。
The doctor checked the patient for any nucal rigidity during the physical exam. 醫生在體檢時檢查病人是否有頸部僵硬的情況。
The therapy focuses on relieving nucal tension caused by long hours at a desk. 該療法專注於緩解因長時間伏案工作引起的頸部張力。
The willow tree is covered in soft nucaments during the early spring. 初春時，柳樹上掛滿了柔軟的柔荑花序。
Wind carries pollen from the nucaments to other trees in the forest. 風將花序上的花粉吹向森林中的其他樹木。

meaning: 結出一粒堅果狀的果實。
sentences: The botanist identified the plant by its nucamentaceous seed pods. 植物學家藉由堅果狀的種莢辨認出了這種植物。
Some trees produce nucamentaceous fruits that are eaten by local wildlife. 某些樹木會結出堅果狀的果實，供當地野生動物食用。
Scientists studied the nucellar tissue to understand how the seed develops. 科學家研究珠心組織，以了解種子是如何發育的。
The nucellar cells provide essential nutrients to the growing plant embryo. 珠心細胞為生長中的植物胚胎提供必要的養分。

meaning: 包圍並保護胚胎並位於珠被內部的組織。
sentences: The nucellus serves as the central part of the ovule in flowering plants. 珠心是開花植物胚珠的核心部分。
Nutrients pass through the nucellus to reach the developing seed. 養分穿過珠心以到達發育中的種子。
The glossary explains that nucha means spinal cord. 詞彙表會說明這個詞的意思。
Readers may encounter nucha in specialist books or historical writing. 讀者可能會在專業書籍或較早的文獻中看到這個詞。

meaning: 屬於或關於頸背或頸背的。
sentences: The athlete suffered a nuchal ligament strain during the wrestling match. 這名運動員在摔跤比賽中頸韌帶受傷。
A nuchal scan is often performed during pregnancy to check the baby's health. 懷孕期間通常會進行頸部透明帶掃描，以檢查胎兒的健康狀況。
Sitting with poor posture for too long can lead to chronic nuchalgia. 姿勢不良坐得太久會導致慢性的頸部疼痛。
The patient visited the clinic complaining of severe nuchalgia and headaches. 病人因嚴重的頸痛和頭痛前往診所就醫。
The region's economy relies heavily on nuciculture, especially walnut farming. 該地區s的經濟在很大程度上依賴堅果種植，特別是核桃栽培。
New techniques in nuciculture have significantly increased the yearly harvest. 堅果栽培的新技術顯著提升了每年的收穫量。
The report uses nuciferous to describe a related feature. 報告用這個詞來描述某種相關特徵。
Readers may encounter nuciferous in descriptive or specialist writing. 讀者可能會在描述性或專業文本中看到這個詞。
The small, nuciform seeds were scattered across the forest floor. 這些微小、形狀像堅果的種子散落在森林地表。
The architect designed a nuciform structure for the new garden pavilion. 建築師為新的花園涼亭設計了一個堅果形狀的構造。
The researcher extracted nucin from the walnut shells in the lab. 研究人員在實驗室裡從核桃殼中提取出這種物質。
They added a small amount of nucin to the dye mixture. 他們在染料混合物中加入少量的胡桃木萃取物。
Squirrels are nucivorous animals that spend the autumn gathering food. 松鼠是食核動物，秋天時會忙著採集食物。
The nucivorous birds use their strong beaks to crack open hard shells. 這些食堅果的鳥類利用強健的喙部來啄開堅硬的外殼。
The lab results showed changes in the nucleal structure of the cells. 實驗室結果顯示細胞的核結構發生了變化。
Proper nucleal function is essential for the healthy growth of any organism. 正常的細胞核功能對於任何生物的健康生長都至關重要。
Scientists are studying the potential of nuclear energy for future. 科學家正研究未來核（核）能的潛力。
The international treaty aims to limit the spread of nuclear arms. 國際條約旨在限制核子武器的擴散。

meaning: 核的古老形式（“與核有關”）。
sentences: The researcher studied the nucleary structure of the cell during the experiment. 研究人員在實驗中研究了細胞的核結構。
Early researchers explored the nucleary regions of various organisms. 早期的研究人員探索了各種生物的核區域。

meaning: 能夠裂解核酸核苷酸亞基之間的磷酸二酯鍵的幾種酵素中的任何一種。
sentences: The researcher added nuclease to the sample to break down the DNA. 研究人員在樣本中加入核酸酶以分解去氧核糖核酸。
Nuclease plays a vital role in repairing damaged genetic material in cells. 核酸酶在修復細胞中受損的遺傳物質方面起著至關重要的作用。
Red blood cells in humans are not nucleate when they are fully mature. 人類的紅血球在完全成熟時是不具細胞核的。
The doctor identified several nucleate cells in the patient's blood sample. 醫生在病人的血液樣本中發現了幾個有核細胞。

meaning: 小區域內相變的第一階段。
sentences: The formation of ice crystals begins with a process called nucleation. 冰晶的形成始於一個被稱為成核的過程。
Dust particles in the air can act as sites for water vapor nucleation. 空氣中的塵埃顆粒可以作為水蒸氣成核的位點。

meaning: 成核或輔助成核的材料。
sentences: Silver iodide is often used as a nucleator to encourage clouds to produce rain. 碘化銀常用作成核劑，以促使雲層降雨。
The chemist searched for a more efficient nucleator to speed up the reaction. 化學家正在尋找更有效的成核劑，以加速反應過程。
Atoms have small, dense nuclei that contain protons and neutrons. 原子的核心有微小且緻密的原子核，其中包含質子和中子。
The biologist counted the nuclei in the tissue sample to check for abnormalities. 生物學家計算組織樣本中的細胞核數量，以檢查是否有異常。
The report uses nucleiferous to describe a related feature. 報告用這個詞來描述某種相關特徵。
Readers may encounter nucleiferous in descriptive or specialist writing. 讀者可能會在描述性或專業文本中看到這個詞。
The doctor observed a small, nucleiform structure under the microscope. 醫生在顯微鏡下觀察到一個微小的核狀結構。
Certain types of bacteria may exhibit a nucleiform appearance during their growth cycle. 某些種類的細菌在生長週期中可能會呈現出核狀的外觀。

meaning: 細胞核中發現的一種富含磷的蛋白質，後來特別是核組蛋白或核魚精蛋白；此外，細胞核中存在的任何類似化合物。
sentences: Scientists isolated nuclein from the white blood cells of the patients. 科學家從病人的白血球中分離出了核素。
The study focuses on how nuclein interacts with other components in the cell. 這項研究集中於核素如何與細胞中的其他成分相互作用。
The chemist used nucleinase to speed up the reaction in the test tube. 化學家使用核酸酶來加速試管中的反應。
Researchers are investigating the activity of nucleinase in different cell types. 研究人員正在調查核酸酶在不同細胞類型中的活性。

meaning: 核酸和白蛋白的複合物
sentences: The presence of nucleoalbumin in the sample suggests a breakdown of cell nuclei. 樣本中存在核白蛋白，顯示細胞核發生了分解。
Careful analysis revealed that nucleoalbumin is a major component of this tissue. 仔細的分析顯示，核白蛋白是該組織的主要成分。
The patient was diagnosed with nucleoalbuminuria after a routine urine test. 病人在常規尿檢後被診斷出患有核白蛋白尿。
Doctors are monitoring the levels of protein to manage the nucleoalbuminuria. 醫生正在監測蛋白質水平以治療核白蛋白尿。
The nerve impulses travel in a nucleofugal direction toward the target muscles. 神經衝動以離核方向傳導至目標肌肉。
During cell division, certain fibers exhibit a nucleofugal pattern. 在細胞分裂過程中，某些纖維呈現出離核模式。

meaning: 組蛋白和核酸的複合物
sentences: The researchers studied the structure of nucleohistone to understand gene regulation. 研究人員研究了核組蛋白的結構，以了解基因調節。
Abnormally high levels of nucleohistone were detected in the blood samples. 在血液樣本中檢測到異常高水平的核組蛋白。
The nucleohyaloplasm provides a fluid environment for the activities within the cell nucleus. 核子透明質為細胞核內的活動提供了液體環境。
Staining the cell allowed the scientists to see the nucleohyaloplasm more clearly. 為細胞染色讓科學家能更清楚地看到核子透明質。
Researchers describe nucleohyaloplasma as the clear substance surrounding the chromatin. 研究人員將核子透明質描述為包圍染色質的透明物質。
Changes in the density of nucleohyaloplasma can indicate cellular stress. 核子透明質密度的變化可能預示著細胞壓力。

meaning: 原核細胞內遺傳物質定位的不規則形狀區域
sentences: Unlike eukaryotes, bacteria store their genetic material in a nucleoid. 與真核生物不同，細菌將遺傳物質儲存在類核中。
The microscope image clearly shows the DNA clustered within the nucleoid. 顯微鏡圖像清楚地顯示 DNA 聚集在類核內。
The researchers analyzed the composition of the nucleoidioplasma in the bacterial cells. 研究人員分析了細菌細胞中類核漿的組成。
Specialized dyes are used to highlight the nucleoidioplasma for observation. 使用專門的染料來標記類核漿以便觀察。
The nucleolar region is responsible for the production of ribosomes. 核仁區域負責核糖體的產生。
Doctors observed significant changes in nucleolar size in the cancerous cells. 醫生觀察到癌細胞中核仁的大小發生了顯著變化。
Each of the nucleolated cells was carefully counted by the technician. 技術員仔細計算了每一個具核仁的細胞。
This species of algae has small, nucleolated structures that are easy to identify. 這種藻類具有易於辨認的微小核仁結構。
Older sources sometimes write nucleole as an alternative form of nucleolus. 較早的資料有時會使用這個變體拼法。
Editors kept nucleole in the word bank so readers can recognize that variant spelling. 這筆資料保留下來，是為了讓讀者辨認這種變體拼法。
Several prominent nucleoli were visible within each cell nucleus. 每個細胞核內都可以看到幾個明顯的核仁。
The number of nucleoli in a cell can change depending on its activity level. 細胞中核仁的數量會根據其活動程度而改變。
The specialist pointed out a tiny nucleolinus inside the larger structure. 專家指出在大結構內部有一個微小的核仁內小體。
Scientists are still studying the exact function of the nucleolinus in cell growth. 科學家仍在研究核仁內小體在細胞生長中的確切功能。
The nucleolocentrosome appears as a distinct spot during certain stages of the life cycle. 在生命週期的某些階段，核仁中心體表現為一個明顯的點。
Researchers used advanced imaging to track the movement of the nucleolocentrosome. 研究人員使用先進的影像技術來追蹤核仁中心體的運動。
The technician noticed several nucleoloid bodies scattered throughout the cytoplasm. 技術員注意到胞質中散布著幾個類核仁體。
These nucleoloid structures might be mistaken for actual nuclei under low magnification. 在低倍率下，這些類核仁結構可能會被誤認為是真正的細胞核。

meaning: 細胞核內明顯的圓形物體。
sentences: The nucleolus is the largest structure found inside the nucleus of a cell. 核仁是細胞核內發現的最大結構。
High protein production often leads to an enlargement of the nucleolus. 高蛋白質產量通常會導致核仁增大。
Radiation can trigger nucleolysis, leading to the death of the affected cells. 輻射會引發核溶解，導致受影響的細胞死亡。
The process of nucleolysis was observed as the tissue began to decay. 當組織開始腐爛時，觀察到了核溶解的過程。
The scientist identified several nucleomicrosome particles within the nuclear matrix. 科學家在核基質中識別出幾個核微粒。
Further tests are needed to determine the chemical makeup of each nucleomicrosome. 需要進一步的測試來確定每個核微粒的化學成分。
Protons and neutrons are both types of nucleon found in an atom. 質子和中子都是原子中發現的核子。
The total mass of the atom is determined by the number of each nucleon. 原子的總質量是由每種核子的數量決定的。
Each nucleone in the nucleus contributes to the overall stability of the atom. 原子核中的每個核子都有助於原子的整體穩定性。
The energy released depends on the arrangement of every nucleone. 釋放的能量取決於每個核子的排列方式。
Students interested in energy production often choose to study nucleonics. 對能源生產感興趣的學生通常會選擇學習核子學。
The university offers a specialized course on the principles of nucleonics. 這所大學提供一門關於核子學原理的專業課程。
Some cellular components move in a nucleopetal direction during the repair process. 一些細胞成分在修復過程中會向核方向移動。
The nucleopetal migration of proteins is essential for the cell's survival. 蛋白質的向核遷移對細胞的生存至關重要。
The biology teacher pointed to the nucleoplasm on the diagram. 生物老師指著圖表上的核質。
Scientists are studying the proteins found within the nucleoplasm. 科學家正在研究核質內發現的蛋白質。

meaning: 與核質有關或由核質組成。
sentences: We need to analyze the nucleoplasmatic fluid under the microscope. 我們需要在顯微鏡下分析核質液體。
The recent study focused on nucleoplasmatic changes during cell division. 最近的研究重點是細胞分裂期間的核質變化。
The virus affects the nucleoplasmic structure of the host cell. 這種病毒會影響宿主細胞的核質結構。
He carefully extracted a sample of the nucleoplasmic material. 他小心翼翼地提取了核質物質的樣本。

meaning: 核酸和蛋白質的任何複合物。
sentences: The lab technician prepared a solution containing the specific nucleoprotein. 實驗室技術員配製了含有特定核蛋白的溶液。
Understanding nucleoprotein interactions is crucial for genetic research. 了解核蛋白相互作用對於基因研究至關重要。

meaning: 一種有機分子，其中含氮雜環鹼基（或核鹼基）（可以是雙環嘌呤或單環嘧啶）與五碳戊糖（DNA中的脫氧核糖或RNA中的核糖）共價連接。當磷酸基與戊糖共價連接時，它形成核苷酸。
sentences: The pharmacy student learned how to synthesize a nucleoside. 藥學系學生學習了如何合成核苷。
This new drug acts as a nucleoside analog to stop the viral infection. 這種新藥作為一種核苷類似物來阻止病毒感染。

meaning: 構成DNA或RNA生物聚合物分子的單體。每個核苷酸由一個含氮雜環鹼基（或核鹼基）組成，可以是雙環嘌呤或單環嘧啶；五碳戊糖（DNA中的脫氧核糖或RNA中的核糖）；和磷酸基。
sentences: Each nucleotide contains a sugar, a phosphate, and a base. 每個核苷酸都包含一個糖、一個磷酸鹽和一個鹼基。
The genetic test looks for a specific missing nucleotide in the sequence. 基因檢測會在序列中尋找特定的缺失核苷酸。
The nucleus of the atom contains protons and neutrons at its center. 原子核包含中心的質子和中子。
A small group of dedicated researchers formed the nucleus of the project. 一小群盡職的研究人員構成了該專案的核心（中心）。

meaning: 由原子序數和原子質量指定的原子核。
sentences: The radioactive nuclide is safely stored in a lead container. 放射性核素安全地存放在鉛製容器中。
We measured the half-life of this particular nuclide during the physics experiment. 我們在物理實驗中測量了這種特定核素的半衰期。
The professor explained the nuclidic mass of various elements. 教授解釋了各種元素的核素質量。
You can find the nuclidic properties listed in the reference table. 你可以在參考表中找到列出的核素特性。

meaning: 蛤科的一個分類屬－非常小的鹹水蛤。
sentences: Biologists list Nucula in reference works on classification. 分類參考資料會列出這個名稱。
The museum label mentions Nucula when explaining the specimen's group. 標本標籤在說明所屬類群時也可能提到這個名稱。
The glossary explains that Nuculacea means rare or specialized English term. 詞彙表會說明這個詞的意思。
Readers may encounter Nuculacea in specialist books or historical writing. 讀者可能會在專業書籍或較早的文獻中看到這個詞。

meaning: 含有多於一顆核或種子的核果或漿果果。
sentences: A grape is a classic example of a nuculanium in botany. 葡萄是植物學中多核果的經典例子。
The botanist classified the newly discovered plant's fruit as a nuculanium. 植物學家將新發現植物的果實歸類為多核果。

meaning: 複合水果的一部分；小堅果；一個小堅果。
sentences: Each nucule falls to the ground when the fruit is fully ripe. 當果實完全成熟時，每個小堅果都會掉落到地上。
The bird cracked open the hard nucule to eat the seed inside. 鳥兒啄開堅硬的小堅果，吃掉裡面的種子。
Biologists list nuculid in reference works on classification. 分類參考資料會列出這個名稱。
The museum label mentions nuculid when explaining the specimen's group. 標本標籤在說明所屬類群時也可能提到這個名稱。

meaning: Nuculida目中的一個分類科—堅果蛤。
sentences: Biologists list Nuculidae in reference works on classification. 分類參考資料會列出這個名稱。
The museum label mentions Nuculidae when explaining the specimen's group. 標本標籤在說明所屬類群時也可能提到這個名稱。
The plant produces a small, nuculiform seed structure. 這種植物會產生一種小巧的堅果狀種子結構。
I found a strange nuculiform shell on the beach this morning. 今天早上我在海灘上找到了一個奇怪的核狀貝殼。
The center of the crystal has a distinct nuculoid shape. 水晶的中心有一個明顯類似原子核的形狀。

The kind woman offered her nurtureship to the abandoned kitten until it was strong enough to be adopted. 那位善良的女士悉心教養這隻被遺棄的小貓，直到牠強壯到可以被領養。

meaning: 北冕座貝塔(BetaCoronaeBorealis)，北冕座中的一顆雙星。

meaning: 飲食主要由堅果組成的人。
sentences: Being a nutarian, he makes sure to include almonds and walnuts in every meal. 身為一個以堅果為主食的人，他確保每餐都包含杏仁和核桃。

sentences: The sensors detected the satellite beginning to nutate as it entered the upper atmosphere. 感應器測得衛星在進入高層大氣時開始不由自主地搖擺。

sentences: The Earth's nutation is a small periodic variation in the orientation of its axis. 地球的章動是指其地軸指向的一種微小週期性變化。
